summary: The first chapter of the Bhagavad Gita - Arjuna Vishada Yoga introduces the setup, the setting, the characters and the circumstances that led to the epic battle of Mahabharata, fought between the Pandavas and the Kauravas. It outlines the reasons that led to the revelation of the of Bhagavad Gita. As both armies stand ready for the battle, the mighty warrior Arjuna, on observing the warriors on both sides becomes increasingly sad and depressed due to the fear of losing his relatives and friends and the consequent sins attributed to killing his own relatives. So, he surrenders to Lord Krishna, seeking a solution. Thus, follows the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita.

verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच ।
धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः ।
मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय ॥ १॥
verses.transliteration:
Dhritarashtra Uvacha:
Dharmakshetre Kurukshetre Samaveta Yuyutsavah,
Mamakah Pandavaschaiva Kimakurvata Sanjaya.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Dhritarashtra ne kaha:

'Hey Sanjaya! Dharma bhoomi Kurukshetra mein yuddh ki ichchha rakhne wale mere putra aur Pandu ke putra ekatrit hue hain. Batao, unhone wahan kya kiya?'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Andhe raja Dhritarashtra yuddh bhoomi mein upasthit nahi the, isliye ve Sanjaya se Kurukshetra ka haal puchte hain.

Unke shabdon mein ek chinta aur pakshpaat dono dikhte hain. Ve 'mere putra' aur 'Pandu ke putra' kahkar dono pakshon ko alag dekh rahe hain.

Yeh prashn Bhagavad Gita ki poori kahani ka aarambh karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab hum apne aur paraye ka bhed karte hain, tabhi adhiktar sangharsh shuru hote hain. Samata aur nyay ki drishti jeevan mein bahut mahatvapurn hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा ।
आचार्यमुपसंगम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ २॥
verses.transliteration:
Sanjaya Uvacha:
Drishtva Tu Pandavanikam Vyudham Duryodhanastada,
Acharyam Upasangamya Raja Vachanam Abravit.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Sanjaya ne kaha:

Pandavo ki vyavasthit aur shaktishaali sena ko dekhkar Raja Duryodhan apne guru Dronacharya ke paas gaya aur unse baat karne laga.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yuddh shuru hone se pehle Duryodhan ne Pandavo ki sena ko dekha.

Sena ki mazboot vyuh-racna dekhkar use sthiti ki gambhirta ka ehsaas hua. Isliye vah turant apne guru Dronacharya ke paas gaya aur apni baat rakhne laga.

Yeh shlok dikhata hai ki Duryodhan ke mann mein atmavishwas ke saath-saath chinta bhi thi.
verses.lifeLesson: Badi chunautiyon ka saamna karte samay buddhimaan log salah aur margdarshan lene se nahi hichkichate.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणाम्
आचार्य महतीं चमूम् ।
व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण
तव शिष्येण धीमता ॥ ३॥
verses.transliteration:
Pashyaitam Panduputranam
Acharya Mahatim Chamum,
Vyudham Drupadaputrena
Tava Shishyena Dhimata.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Duryodhan ne Dronacharya se kaha:

'Hey Acharya, Pandu putron ki is vishal sena ko dekhiye, jo aapke hi buddhimaan shishya, Drupad ke putra (Dhrishtadyumna) ne sajayi hai.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Duryodhan apne guru Dronacharya ka dhyaan Pandavo ki sena ki taraf dilata hai.

Woh khaas taur par batata hai ki sena ki rachna Dhrishtadyumna ne ki hai.

Dhrishtadyumna Dronacharya ka shishya tha, lekin baad mein Pandavo ki taraf se yudh kar raha tha.

Duryodhan yeh baat thodi chaturai se bolta hai, taaki Dronacharya ko yaad dilaye ki unka hi shishya ab unke viruddh khada hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Gyaan dene wale ko hamesha taiyaar rehna chahiye ki uska shishya apna alag raasta chun sakta hai. Sachcha gyaan kisi ek paksh ka nahi hota.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि ।
युयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Atra shuraa maheshvaasaa bheemaarjunasamaa yudhi.
Yuyudhaano viraatashcha drupadashcha mahaarathah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Is sena mein mahaan dhanurdhaari aur shoorveer hain, jo yuddh mein Bhima aur Arjun ke samaan hain — jaise Yuyudhana, Virata aur mahaarathi Raja Drupada.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Duryodhana Dronacharya ko Pandava-paksh ke shaktishaali yoddhaon ki taraf ishara karta hai.

Woh Yuyudhana, Virata aur Drupada jaise veeron ka naam lekar batata hai ki saamne ki sena kamzor nahi hai.

Isse uski chinta aur yuddh ki gambhirta dono dikhte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab saamne ki taakat ko bhi saaf dekha jaata hai, tab faisle zyada samajhdari se liye jaate hain.

verses.sanskrit:
धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान् ।
पुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुंगवः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Dhrishtaketushchekitaanah kaashiraajashcha veeryavaan.
Purujit kuntibhojashcha shaibyashcha narapungavah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Dhrishtaketu, Chekitana, balavaan Kashiraj, Purujit, Kuntibhoj aur naron mein shreshth Shaibya bhi yahan maujood hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Is shlok mein Duryodhana ek ke baad ek Pandava-paksh ke yoddhaon ke naam ginaata hai.

Uska uddeshya Dronacharya par yah prabhav daalna hai ki saamne sirf ek ya do nahi, balki kai anubhavi veer khade hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Kabhi-kabhi ek problem ka solution tabhi milta hai jab hum uske har pehlu ko pehchaan lete hain.

verses.sanskrit:
युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान् ।
सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yudhaamanyushcha vikraanta uttamaujaashcha veeryavaan.
Saubhadro draupadeyaashcha sarva eva mahaarathah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parakrami Yudhāmanyu, balavaan Uttamauja, Subhadra ke putra Abhimanyu aur Draupadi ke putra — ye sab mahaarathi hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan Duryodhana aur bhi aise yoddhaon ka zikr karta hai jo yuddh mein bahut kushal hain.

Abhimanyu aur Draupadi ke putron ka naam lekar woh dikhata hai ki Pandava-paksh mein naye aur prabhavi yoddha bhi jude hue hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Sangathan mein har sadasya ki apni shakti hoti hai, aur wahi milkar badi taakat banati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम ।
नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Asmaakam tu vishishta ye taannibodha dvijottama.
Naayakaa mama sainyasya samjñaartham taanbravimi te.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Dvijottam, hamaare paksh ke jo pramukh yoddha hain unhe bhi jaan lijiye. Aapki jaankari ke liye main apni sena ke senaptiyon ke naam bata raha hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Ab Duryodhana Dronacharya se seedhe apne paksh ke yoddhaon ka parichay karata hai.

Woh baat ko aise pesh karta hai jaise sirf information de raha ho, lekin asal mein uska uddeshya apni sena ki taakat dikhana hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Achhe communication mein sirf bolna nahi, balki sahi samay par sahi baat kehna bhi zaroori hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
भवान्भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्च समितिञ्जयः ।
अश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सौमदत्तिस्तथैव च ॥
verses.transliteration:
Bhavaanbhishmashcha karnashcha kripashcha samitinjayah.
Ashvatthaamaa vikarnashcha saumadattistathaiva cha.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aap khud, Bhishma, Karna, vijayi Kripaacharya, Ashwatthama, Vikarna aur Somadatta ke putra — sab yahan hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Is shlok mein Duryodhana apne paksh ke sabse mahatvapurn yoddhaon ki list deta hai.

Yeh list dikhati hai ki Kaurava sena mein anubhav, naam aur yuddh-kala — sab kuch maujood tha.
verses.lifeLesson: Asli leadership apni team ki strengths ko pehchaan kar unka sahi istemal karne mein hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः ।
नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Anye cha bahavah shuraa madarthe tyaktajeevitah.
Naanaashastrapraharaṇaaḥ sarve yuddhavishaaradaah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aur bhi bahut se veer hain jo mere liye jeevan tak tyagne ko taiyaar hain. Unke paas tarah-tarah ke shastr hain aur ve sab yuddh mein nipun hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Duryodhana yeh batana chahta hai ki uski sena sirf kuch naamon tak simit nahi hai.

Uske paas kai aise yoddha hain jo poori tarah se yuddh ke liye taiyaar hain aur har tarah ke astr-shastr mein maahir hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab irade pakke aur taiyaari poori ho, tab mushkil kaam bhi sambhav lagne lagte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम् ।
पर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Aparyaaptam tadasmaakam balam bhishmaabhirakshitam.
Paryaaptam tvidam eteshaam balam bheemaabhirakshitam.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Bhishma ke dwaara surakshit hamaari sena aparyaapt hai, jabki Bhima ke dwaara surakshit unki sena paryaapt hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yah shlok Duryodhana ki mansik sthiti dikhata hai.

Woh ek taraf Bhishma par bharosa kar raha hai, aur doosri taraf Pandava-sena ki taakat ko bhi maanne ke liye majboor hai.

Ismein yuddh se pehle ki tanav aur tulnatmak soch saaf dikhti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sirf apni taakat dekhna kaafi nahi hota; maidaan mein utarne se pehle dono taraf ka sahi aakalan zaroori hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः ।
भीष्ममेवाभिरक्षन्तु भवन्तः सर्व एव हि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ayaneshu cha sarveshu yatha-bhaagam avasthitaah,
Bhishmameva abhirakshantu bhavantah sarva eva hi.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aap sab apne-apne sthano par sthir rahte hue har taraf se sirf Bhishma Pitaamah ki raksha kijiye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Duryodhan apne yoddhaon ko kahta hai ki ve apni jagah se na hilein aur Bhishma ki suraksha karein.
Is baat se pata chalta hai ki Bhishma ko sena ka sabse mahatvapurn stambh maana ja raha tha.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab kisi team ka central sahara majboot ho, to poori team zyada sangathit aur surakshit rehti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य सञ्जनयन्हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः ।
सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tasya sanjayan harsham kuruvriddhah pitaamahah,
Simhanaadam vinadya uchchaih shankham dadhmau pratapavaan.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kauravon ke vriddh aur pratapi pitamah Bhishma ne Duryodhan ko utsahit karne ke liye sher ki garaj jaisi aawaz mein apna shankh baja diya.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhishma ne zor se shankh baja kar yuddh ki shuruaat ka sanket diya.
Unki aawaz se Kaurav paksh mein utsaah aur josh aa gaya.
verses.lifeLesson: Kabhi-kabhi ek majboot aur aatmavishvasi sanket poori team ka manobal badha deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पणवानकगोमुखाः ।
सहसैवाभ्यहन्यन्त स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tatah shankhashcha bheryashcha panavaanaka-gomukhaah,
Sahasaiva abhyahanyanta sa shabdastumulo'bhavat.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Phir shankh, nagare, dhol aur shringi jaise vaadya ek saath baj uthe aur unka shabd bahut bhayankar ho gaya.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Bhishma ke shankh ke baad dono senaon mein alag-alag vaadya bajne lage.
Poora maidan ek bahut tez aur ghosh se bhar gaya.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab bahut saari shaktiyaan ek saath gati karti hain, to uska prabhav bahut tez aur spasht hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ ।
माधवः पाण्डवश्चैव दिव्यौ शङ्खौ प्रदध्मतुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tatah shvetairhayairyukte mahati syandane sthitau,
Madhavah Pandavashchaiva divyau shankhau pradadhmatu.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Uske baad safed ghodon se jute bade rath par baithe Madhav (Shri Krishna) aur Pandav Arjun ne bhi apne divya shankh baja diye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Kaurav sena ke shankh ke baad Ab Krishna aur Arjun ne bhi shankh bajaaya.
Isse yuddh ka mahaul aur bhi gambhir aur teevra ho gaya.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab samay aata hai, to sahi paksh ko bhi apni upasthiti aur tayyari dikhani padti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनञ्जयः ।
पौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्खं भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Paanchajanyam Hrishikeshau Devadattam Dhananjayah,
Paundram dadhmau mahashankham bhimakarma Vrikodarah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hrishikesha ne Panchajanya, Dhananjaya Arjun ne Devadatta aur bhayankar karm karne wale Bhim ne Paundra naam ka mahashankh bajaaya.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan Krishna, Arjun aur Bhim teeno apne-apne shankh baja kar yuddh ka sanket dete hain.
Yeh shlok unki ekjutta aur aatmavishwas ko dikhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachchi taakat tab dikhti hai jab sahi log ek lakshya ke liye saath khade hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ।
नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
Anantavijayam raja kuntiputro yudhishthirah,
Nakulah sahadevashcha sughosha-manipushpakau.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kunti-putra Raja Yudhishthir ne Anantavijaya naam ka shankh aur Nakul aur Sahadev ne kramashah Sughosh aur Manipushpak shankh bajaaye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Ab Pandava paksh ke anya mahatvapurn veeron ne bhi apne shankh baja diye.
Isse dikhata hai ki poori Pandava sena ek saath taiyar thi.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab har sadasya apna hissa poori nishtha se nibhata hai, tab poora dal aur majboot ho jata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
काश्यश्च परमेष्वासः शिखण्डी च महारथः ।
धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्चापराजितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Kashyashcha parameshvasaah Shikhandi cha mahaarathah,
Dhrishtadyumno Viratashcha Satyakishchaparaajitah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kashi ka shreshth dhanurdhari raja, Shikhandi, Dhrishtadyumna, Raja Virata aur ajey Satyaki bhi yahan upasthit the.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yahan Duryodhan aur Pandava paksh ke aur mahatvapurn yoddhaon ke naam aate hain.
Har naam yeh dikhata hai ki dono pakshon mein anek shaktishaali veer maujood the.
verses.lifeLesson: Kisi bhi bade kaam mein alag-alag kshamata wale log milkar hi safalta laate hain.

verses.sanskrit:
द्रुपदो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः पृथिवीपते ।
सौभद्रश्च महाबाहुः शङ्खान्दध्मुः पृथक्पृथक् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Drupado draupadeyashcha sarvashah prithivipate,
Saubhradrashcha mahabahuh shankhandadhmuh prithakprithak.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey raajan, Raja Drupad, Draupadi ke putra aur mahaabaahu Saubhadra (Abhimanyu) ne bhi alag-alag shankh bajaaye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pandava paksh ke anya yoddhaon ne bhi apni aawaz jod di.
Is se poore maidan mein ek saath ek bada aur prabhavshali ghosh sunai diya.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab sab log apni awaz aur prayaas jodte hain, tab unka prabhav aur bhi badh jata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
स घोषो धार्तराष्ट्राणां हृदयानि व्यदारयत् ।
नभश्च पृथिवीं चैव तुमुलोऽभ्यनुनादयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sa ghosho dhartarashtranaam hridayaani vyadaarayat,
Nabhashcha prithiveem chaiva tumulo'bhyanunaadayan.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Woh bhayankar ghosh aakash aur prithvi par goonj utha aur usne Dhritarashtra ke putron ke hridayon ko hila diya.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Itne saare shankhon aur vaadyaon ki aawaz se Kaurav paksh ke log andar se kaamp uthe.
Yeh yuddh ki gambhir shuruaat ka sanket tha.
verses.lifeLesson: Kabhi-kabhi bahari mahaul itna prabhavshali hota hai ki vah andar tak asar kar deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ व्यवस्थितान्दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान् कपिध्वजः ।
प्रवृत्ते शस्त्रसम्पाते धनुरुद्यम्य पाण्डवः ।
हृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Atha vyavasthitaan drishtva dhartarashtran kapidhvajah,
Pravritte shastrasampaate dhanurudyamya pandavah,
Hrishikesham tadaa vaakyam idam aaha mahipate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey maheepate, jab yuddh shuru hone hi wala tha aur Arjun ne Dhritarashtra ke putron ko vyavasthit dekha, tab usne dhanush uthaya aur Shri Krishna se ye baat kahi.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yuddh ke bilkul pehle Arjun ne saamne khadi sena ko dekha aur apna dhanush uthaya.
Usi samay woh Shri Krishna se baat karne ke liye taiyar hua.
verses.lifeLesson: Kisi bhi bade kadam se pehle sthiti ko dhyan se dekhna aur samajhna bahut zaroori hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये रथं स्थापय मेऽच्युत ॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Senayor ubhayor madhye
Ratham sthapaya me Achyuta.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'Hey Achyut! Kripya mera rath dono senaon ke beech mein le chaliye.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yuddh shuru hone se pehle Arjun apne rath ko dono senaon ke beech le jana chahta hai.

Woh sthiti ko dhyan se dekhna aur samajhna chahta hai ki uske saamne kaun-kaun khada hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Kisi bhi bade faisle se pehle poori sthiti ko samajhna bahut zaroori hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यावदेतान्निरीक्षेऽहं योद्धुकामानवस्थितान् ।
कैर्मया सह योद्धव्यमस्मिन् रणसमुद्यमे ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yavad etan nirekshe aham
Yoddhukaman avasthitan,
Kair maya saha yoddhavyam
Asmin rana samudyame.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main dekhna chahta hoon ki is yuddh mein ladne ke liye kaun-kaun yahan khada hai aur mujhe kin logon se yuddh karna hoga.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun yuddh se pehle apne virodhiyon ko dekhna chahta hai.

Woh samajhna chahta hai ki is maha-yuddh mein uske saamne kaun log khade hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Chunauti ka saamna karne se pehle uski poori jaankari lena buddhimani hai.

verses.sanskrit:
योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेऽहं य एतेऽत्र समागताः ।
धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्बुद्धेर्युद्धे प्रियचिकीर्षवः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yotsyamanan avekse aham
Ya ete atra samagatah,
Dhartarashtrasya durbuddher
Yuddhe priyachikirshavah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main un logon ko dekhna chahta hoon jo Duryodhan ka saath dene aur uski ichchha poori karne ke liye yahan yuddh mein aaye hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun un sab yoddhaon ko dekhna chahta hai jo Duryodhan ke paksh mein khade hain.

Abhi tak uska man sthir hai aur woh yuddh ko ek kartavya ke roop mein dekh raha hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Kisi bhi sangharsh ko samajhne ke liye uske peeche ke logon aur unke uddeshya ko samajhna bhi zaroori hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
एवमुक्तो हृषीकेशो गुडाकेशेन भारत ।
सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये स्थापयित्वा रथोत्तमम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sanjaya Uvacha:
Evam ukto Hrishikesho
Gudakeshena Bharata,
Senayor ubhayor madhye
Sthapayitva rathottamam.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Sanjaya ne kaha:

'Hey Bharat! Arjun ke aisa kehne par Shri Krishna ne unka uttam rath dono senaon ke beech mein khada kar diya.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna ne Arjun ki baat maani aur rath ko dono senaon ke beech le aaye.

Ab Arjun ko poora drishya saaf-saaf dikhne wala tha.
verses.lifeLesson: Ek achha margdarshak pehle humein sachchai dikhata hai, phir salah deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम् ।
उवाच पार्थ पश्यैतान्समवेतान्कुरूनिति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Bhishma Drona pramukhatah
Sarvesham cha mahikshitam,
Uvacha Partha pashyaitan
Samavetan Kurun iti.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Krishna ne Bhishma, Drona aur anya rajaon ke saamne rath rok kar kaha:

'Hey Parth, in sab Kauravon ko dekho.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna ne jaanboojhkar rath ko un logon ke saamne roka jo Arjun ke liye sabse adhik mahatvapurn the.

Yahin se Arjun ke mann mein bhavnaon ka toofan shuru hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachchai ka saamna karna kabhi-kabhi kathin hota hai, lekin wahi samajh ki shuruaat bhi hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रापश्यत्स्थितान्पार्थः पितॄनथ पितामहान् ।
आचार्यान्मातुलान्भ्रातॄन्पुत्रान्पौत्रान्सखींस्तथा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tatra apashyat sthitan Parthah
Pitrin atha pitamahan,
Acharyan matulan bhratrin
Putran pautran sakhins tatha.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Wahan Arjun ne apne pitamahon, guruon, mamaon, bhaiyon, putron, pautron aur mitron ko khada dekha.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yuddh bhoomi mein Arjun ko sirf shatru nahi dikhe.

Usne apne hi parivaar aur priya logon ko dono pakshon mein khada dekha.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab sangharsh apnon ke beech ho, tab faisle aur bhi kathin ho jaate hain.

verses.sanskrit:
श्वशुरान्सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि ।
तान्समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान्बन्धूनवस्थितान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shvashuran suhridash chaiva
Senayor ubhayor api,
Tan samikshya sa Kaunteyah
Sarvan bandhun avasthitan.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne dono senaon mein apne shvashuron, mitron aur anya sambandhiyon ko bhi khada dekha.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jab Arjun ne har taraf apne hi logon ko dekha, to uska hriday karuna se bharne laga.

Ab yeh yuddh uske liye sirf rajya ka nahi, balki apnon ke viruddh khade hone ka prashn ban gaya.
verses.lifeLesson: Rishta aur kartavya jab aamne-saamne aa jaayein, tab man mein gahra sangharsh utpann hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
कृपया परयाविष्टो विषीदन्निदमब्रवीत् ।
अर्जुन उवाच ।
दृष्ट्वेमं स्वजनं कृष्ण युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Kripaya parayavishto
Vishidann idam abravit,
Arjuna uvacha:
Drishtvemam svajanam Krishna
Yuyutsum samupasthitam.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Karuna se vyakul Arjun ne kaha:

'Hey Krishna! Apne hi sambandhiyon ko yuddh ke liye khada dekhkar mera man dukhi ho gaya hai.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Ab Arjun ke andar bhavnaon ka bhaar badhne lagta hai.

Woh apne saamne khade logon ko shatru nahi, balki apne parivaar ke roop mein dekh raha hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Samvedansheel hona kamzori nahi, balki insaniyata ki pehchaan hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति ।
वेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च जायते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sidanti mama gatrani
Mukham cha parishushyati,
Vepathush cha sharire me
Romaharshash cha jayate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Mere ang kamzor ho rahe hain, mera muh sookh raha hai, shareer kaamp raha hai aur romanch ho raha hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ke mann ka tanaav ab uske shareer par bhi dikhne lagta hai.

Uski maansik avastha itni prabhavit ho chuki hai ki sharirik lakshan saamne aane lagte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Maansik tanaav ka asar aksar shareer par bhi dikhai deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
गाण्डीवं स्रंसते हस्तात्त्वक्चैव परिदह्यते ।
न च शक्नोम्यवस्थातुं भ्रमतीव च मे मनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Gandivam sramsate hastat
Tvak chaiva paridahyate,
Na cha shaknomy avasthatum
Bhramativa cha me manah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Mera Gandiv dhanush haath se fisal raha hai, meri tvacha jal rahi hai aur mera man bhramit ho raha hai. Main khud ko sambhal nahi paa raha hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ki vyakulata aur badh jaati hai.

Uska aatmavishwas hilne lagta hai aur use lagta hai ki woh yuddh ke liye taiyar nahi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab man ashant ho, tab sabse shaktishaali vyakti bhi apne aap ko kamzor mehsoos kar sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
निमित्तानि च पश्यामि विपरीतानि केशव ।
न च श्रेयोऽनुपश्यामि हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे ॥
verses.transliteration:
Nimittani cha pashyami viparitani Keshava,
Na cha shreyo'nupashyami hatva svajanam ahave.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne Krishna se kaha:

'Hey Keshav! Mujhe har taraf ashubh sanket dikh rahe hain. Apne hi sambandhiyon ko yuddh mein maar kar mujhe koi bhi kalyan nazar nahi aa raha.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ka man ab poori tarah se yuddh ke viruddh hone laga hai.

Use lagta hai ki is yuddh ka parinaam chahe jo ho, apnon ki mrityu kisi bhi roop mein shubh nahi ho sakti.
verses.lifeLesson: Koi bhi faisla lene se pehle uske dooragami parinaamon par vichar karna zaroori hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च ।
किं नो राज्येन गोविन्द किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na kankshe vijayam Krishna na cha rajyam sukhani cha,
Kim no rajyena Govinda kim bhogair jivitena va.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'Hey Krishna! Mujhe na vijay chahiye, na rajya aur na hi sukhon ki ichchha hai. Hey Govind! Jab apne hi log na rahen, to rajya aur jeevan ka kya arth hai?'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun samajhta hai ki jis rajya aur sukh ke liye yeh yuddh ho raha hai, agar usmein apne hi log na bachen to us vijay ka koi mahatva nahi rahega.

Uske liye rishton ki keemat rajya se bhi badhkar hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan ki asli khushi sirf dhan ya safalta mein nahi, balki apnon ke saath mein hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च ।
त इमेऽवस्थिता युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yesham arthe kankshitam no rajyam bhogah sukhani cha,
Ta ime avasthita yuddhe pranams tyaktva dhanani cha.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jinke liye hum rajya, sukh aur bhogon ki ichchha rakhte hain, wahi log apni jaan aur dhan ki parwah kiye bina yuddh ke maidan mein khade hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ko ehsaas hota hai ki jin logon ke saath woh apni khushiyan baantna chahta tha, wahi log ab uske saamne yuddh ke liye khade hain.

Yeh soch uske dukh ko aur gehra kar deti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jin logon ke liye hum mehnat karte hain, unki keemat hamesha yaad rakhni chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
आचार्याः पितरः पुत्रास्तथैव च पितामहाः ।
मातुलाः श्वशुराः पौत्राः श्यालाः सम्बन्धिनस्तथा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Acharyah pitarah putras tathaiva cha pitamahah,
Matulah shvashurah pautrah shyalah sambandhinas tatha.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yahan mere guru, pita-tulya bade, putra, pitamah, mama, sasur, pote, saale aur anya sambandhi sab maujood hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun apne saamne khade logon ko ek sena ke roop mein nahi dekh raha.

Use har taraf apne parivaar aur sambandhi hi nazar aa rahe hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Rishta aur apnapan insaan ke hriday ko gehra prabhavit karte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
एतान्न हन्तुमिच्छामि घ्नतोऽपि मधुसूदन ।
अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Etan na hantum icchami ghnato'pi Madhusudana,
Api trailokya rajyasya hetoh kim nu mahikrite.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Madhusudan! Main inhe maarna nahi chahta, chahe ye mujhe maar dein. Teenon lokon ka rajya milne par bhi main inka vadh nahi karna chahta, phir keval prithvi ke rajya ki to baat hi kya hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ka moh aur karuna itni badh gayi hai ki woh kisi bhi keemat par apnon ka vadh nahi karna chahta.

Uske liye rajya se zyada mahatvapurn uske sambandh hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Kuch cheezein dhan, pad aur shakti se bhi adhik moolyavaan hoti hain.

verses.sanskrit:
निहत्य धार्तराष्ट्रान्नः का प्रीतिः स्याज्जनार्दन ।
पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान्हत्वैतानाततायिनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Nihatya Dhartarashtran nah ka pritih syaj Janardana,
Papam eva ashrayed asman hatvaitan atatayinah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Janardan! Dhritarashtra ke putron ko maar kar humein kya prasannata milegi? Inhe maarne se humein paap hi lagega.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ko lagta hai ki yeh yuddh jeetne ke baad bhi uske mann ko shanti nahi milegi.

Use dar hai ki apnon ka vadh karne ka pashchatap uske jeevan bhar saath rahega.
verses.lifeLesson: Koi bhi karya karne se pehle uske naitik aur aatmik prabhav ko samajhna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मान्नार्हा वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान्स्वबान्धवान् ।
स्वजनं हि कथं हत्वा सुखिनः स्याम माधव ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tasman narha vayam hantum Dhartarashtran svabandhavan,
Svajanam hi katham hatva sukhinah syama Madhava.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Madhav! Isliye humein apne hi bandhujanon ko nahi maarna chahiye. Apne hi logon ko maar kar hum kaise sukhi reh sakte hain?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun baar-baar isi baat par laut raha hai ki apnon ka vadh kisi bhi roop mein uske liye sweekarya nahi hai.

Uske liye yeh yuddh ek parivaarik tragedy ban chuka hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab faisle rishton ko prabhavit karte hon, tab unhe aur adhik samvedansheelata se lena chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यप्येते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः ।
कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं मित्रद्रोहे च पातकम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yadyapy ete na pashyanti lobhopahata chetasah,
Kulakshaya kritam dosham mitra drohe cha patakam.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'Yeh log lobh se andhe ho chuke hain, isliye inhe kul ke vinash ka dosh aur apnon ke prati droh karne ka paap nazar nahi aa raha.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun maanta hai ki Duryodhan aur uske saathi lalach ke kaaran sahi aur galat ka antar bhool chuke hain.

Unhe sirf rajya ki ichchha dikh rahi hai, lekin uske parinaam mein hone wale parivaar ke vinash aur paap ka ehsaas nahi ho raha.
verses.lifeLesson: Lalach aksar insaan ki soch ko dhundhla kar deta hai aur use galat faisle lene par majboor kar sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मान्निवर्तितुम् ।
कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं प्रपश्यद्भिर्जनार्दन ॥
verses.transliteration:
Katham na jneyam asmabhih papad asman nivartitum,
Kulakshaya kritam dosham prapashyadbhir Janardana.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'Hey Janardan! Jab hum kul ke vinash se hone wale doshon ko jaante hain, to phir humein is paap se bachne ka prayas kyon nahi karna chahiye?'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun Krishna se tark karta hai ki agar kisi karya ke bure parinaam pehle se pata hon, to buddhimaan vyakti ko us raaste par nahi chalna chahiye.

Woh maanta hai ki kul ka vinash bahut bada paap hai aur usse bachna hi uchit hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ka mahatva tabhi hai jab hum uske anusaar apne karmon ka chayan bhi karein.

verses.sanskrit:
कुलक्षये प्रणश्यन्ति कुलधर्माः सनातनाः ।
धर्मे नष्टे कुलं कृत्स्नमधर्मोऽभिभवत्युत ॥
verses.transliteration:
Kulakshaye pranashyanti kuladharmah sanatanah,
Dharme nashte kulam kritsnam adharmo'bhibhavaty uta.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'Jab kul ka vinash hota hai, tab uske purane dharmik sanskar aur paramparaayein bhi nasht ho jaati hain. Aur jab dharma samaapt ho jaata hai, tab adharma poore kul par haavi ho jaata hai.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ko chinta hai ki yuddh ke kaaran sirf logon ki mrityu nahi hogi, balki poore parivaar ki parampara, moolya aur sanskar bhi toot jayenge.

Uske anusaar dharma ke kamzor hone par samaj mein avyavastha aur adharma badhne lagta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Parivaar aur samaj ke moolya aur achhe sanskar agli peedhiyon tak pahunchana bahut mahatvapurn hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अधर्माभिभवात्कृष्ण प्रदुष्यन्ति कुलस्त्रियः ।
स्त्रीषु दुष्टासु वार्ष्णेय जायते वर्णसङ्करः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Adharmabhibhavat Krishna pradushyanti kulastriyah,
Strishu dushtasu Varshneya jayate varna-sankarah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne Krishna se kaha:

'Hey Krishna! Jab adharma badh jaata hai, tab parivaar ki mahilaon aur poore kul ki maryada prabhavit hone lagti hai. Aur jab parivaarik moolya toot jaate hain, tab samaj mein avyavastha aur uljhan badhne lagti hai.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ko dar hai ki yeh yuddh sirf logon ki jaan nahi lega, balki parivaaron ki neev bhi hila dega.

Us samay parivaar ki paramparaon aur sanskaron ko sambhalne mein mahilaon ki bahut mahatvapurn bhoomika maani jaati thi. Arjun ka maanna hai ki jab yuddh ke kaaran parivaar toot jaayenge, tab aane wali peedhiyon tak uska bura prabhav pahunch sakta hai.

Woh Krishna ko samjha raha hai ki yeh sangharsh keval rajya ke liye nahi, balki poore samajik santulan ko prabhavit kar sakta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab samaj aur parivaar ke moolya kamzor padte hain, to uska prabhav aane wali peedhiyon par bhi padta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सङ्करो नरकायैव कुलघ्नानां कुलस्य च ।
पतन्ति पितरो ह्येषां लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sankaro narakayaiva kulaghnanam kulasya cha,
Patanti pitaro hyesham lupta-pindodaka-kriyah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'Aisi samajik avyavastha kul ka naash karne walon aur unke poore parivaar ke liye dukh ka kaaran banti hai. Purvajon ke prati jo kartavya nibhaye jaate hain, ve bhi dheere-dheere samaapt ho jaate hain.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ka maanna hai ki jab parivaar toot jaata hai, tab sirf vartamaan hi prabhavit nahi hota.

Purvajon se judi paramparaayein, sanskar aur dharmik kartavya bhi dheere-dheere khatam hone lagte hain. Us samay log maante the ki purvajon ka samman aur unke prati kartavya nibhana bahut mahatvapurn hai.

Arjun ko lagta hai ki yeh yuddh un sab paramparaon ko tod dega jo peedhiyon se chalti aa rahi hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni jadon aur paramparaon se juda rehna humein apni pehchaan aur moolyon se jod kar rakhta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
दोषैरेतैः कुलघ्नानां वर्णसङ्करकारकैः ।
उत्साद्यन्ते जातिधर्माः कुलधर्माश्च शाश्वताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Doshair etaih kulaghnanam varna-sankara-karakaih,
Utsadyante jati-dharmah kula-dharmash cha shashvatah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'In sab doshon ke kaaran kul ki paramparaayein aur samaj ke sthapit moolya dheere-dheere nasht ho jaate hain.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun baar-baar isi baat par zor de raha hai ki yeh yuddh keval kuch logon ki mrityu tak seemit nahi rahega.

Uske anusaar, jab parivaar bikharte hain to unke saath unki paramparaayein, sanskar aur jeevan jeene ke siddhant bhi kamzor pad jaate hain.

Woh Krishna ko batana chahta hai ki ek yuddh kabhi-kabhi talwar se zyada samaj ki aatma ko chot pahunchata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Achhe sanskar aur moolya kisi bhi samaj ki sabse badi virasat hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन ।
नरके नियतं वासो भवतीत्यनुशुश्रुम ॥
verses.transliteration:
Utsanna-kula-dharmanam manushyanam Janardana,
Narake niyatam vaso bhavatity anushushruma.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'Hey Janardan! Humne suna hai ki jin logon ke parivaarik dharm aur paramparaayein nasht ho jaati hain, unhe lambi avadhi tak dukh aur kashton ka saamna karna padta hai.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun purani paramparaon aur shastraon mein suni hui baaton ka ullekh kar raha hai.

Uska maanna hai ki jab parivaar ka dharma aur uski maryada samaapt ho jaati hai, tab uska prabhav sirf ek vyakti par nahi, balki poori peedhi par padta hai.

Isi liye woh yuddh ke parinaamon ko lekar bahut chintit hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Aaj ke faisle kabhi-kabhi aane wali peedhiyon ke jeevan ko bhi prabhavit karte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम् ।
यद्राज्यसुखलोभेन हन्तुं स्वजनमुद्यताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Aho bata mahat papam kartum vyavasita vayam,
Yad rajya-sukha-lobhena hantum svajanam udyatah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'Haaye! Hum kitna bada paap karne ja rahe hain. Rajya aur sukh ke lobh mein hum apne hi logon ko maarne ke liye taiyar khade hain.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Apne guruon, pitamahon, bhaiyon aur sambandhiyon ko saamne dekhkar Arjun ka hriday dukh se bhar gaya hai.

Ab use lag raha hai ki rajya paane ki ichchha ne sabko ek doosre ke viruddh khada kar diya hai. Woh sochta hai ki agar vijay ki keemat apnon ki jaan hai, to aisi vijay ka kya mahatva hai.

Isi karan Arjun is yuddh ko ek mahaan paap ke roop mein dekhne lagta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Lalach aur swarth kabhi-kabhi humein aise faisle lene par majboor kar dete hain jinka baad mein gehra pashchatap hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि मामप्रतीकारमशस्त्रं शस्त्रपाणयः ।
धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yadi mam apratikaram ashastram shastra-panayah,
Dhartarashtrah rane hanyus tan me kshemataram bhavet.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'Agar main bina shastra uthaye aur bina pratirodh kiye khada rahun, aur Kaurav mujhe maar dein, to bhi mujhe wahi zyada uchit lagega.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Is samay Arjun poori tarah se bhavnaon mein doob chuka hai.

Uska mann yuddh karne ke liye taiyar nahi hai. Use lagta hai ki apnon ka vadh karne se behtar hai ki vah khud hi mar jaaye.

Yeh Arjun ki maansik uljhan aur karuna ki parakashtha ko darshata hai. Isi sthiti mein usse Krishna ke margdarshan ki sabse zyada zaroorat hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab bhavnaayein bahut zyada prabhavit kar deti hain, tab humein shaant man se margdarshan aur vivek ki zaroorat hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
एवमुक्त्वार्जुनः सङ्ख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् ।
विसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sanjaya Uvacha:
Evam uktva Arjunah sankhye rathopastha upavishat,
Visrijya sa-sharam chapam shoka-samvigna-manasah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Sanjaya ne kaha:

'Itna kehkar Arjun ne apna dhanush aur baan chhod diye aur gehre shok se vyakul hokar rath mein baith gaya.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun jo Mahabharat ka sabse mahaan yoddha maana jaata tha, is samay apne hi vicharon aur bhavnaon ke bojh se toot gaya.

Usne yuddh karne ki ichchha chhod di, apna Gandiv neeche rakh diya aur nirash hokar rath mein baith gaya.

Yahin par Arjun Vishad Yog samaapt hota hai. Arjun ki yeh uljhan hi Bhagavad Gita ke divya updesh ka kaaran banti hai, jahan Krishna usse jeevan, kartavya, atma aur dharma ka gyaan dete hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Kabhi-kabhi jeevan ki sabse badi seekh aur badlav ki shuruaat tab hoti hai jab hum apni uljhan aur kamzori ko imaandari se sweekar karte hain.

summary: The second chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Sankhya Yoga. This is the most important chapter of the Bhagavad Gita as Lord Krishna condenses the teachings of the entire Gita in this chapter. This chapter is the essence of the entire Gita. Sankhya Yoga can be categorized into 4 main topics - 1. Arjuna completely surrenders himself to Lord Krishna and accepts his position as a disciple and Krishna as his Guru. He requests Krishna to guide him on how to dismiss his sorrow. 2. Explanation of the main cause of all grief, which is ignorance of the true nature of Self. 3. Karma Yoga - the discipline of selfless action without being attached to its fruits. 4. Description of a Perfect Man - One whose mind is steady and one-pointed.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
तं तथा कृपयाविष्टमश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणम् ।
विषीदन्तमिदं वाक्यमुवाच मधुसूदनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sanjaya Uvacha:
Tam tatha kripayavishtam ashrupurna-akulekshanam,
Vishidantam idam vakyam uvacha Madhusudanah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Sanjaya ne kaha:

'Arjun karuna aur shok se poori tarah vyakul ho chuka tha. Uski aankhen aansuon se bhari hui thi aur vah gehre dukh mein dooba hua tha. Tab Bhagwan Krishna ne usse yeh vachan kahe.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Pehle adhyay ke ant tak Arjun apna dhanush chhodkar rath mein baith gaya tha. Apne guruon, pitamahon aur sambandhiyon ko saamne dekhkar uska mann kamzor pad gaya tha.

Vah samajh nahi pa raha tha ki uska kartavya kya hai. Isi samay Krishna dekhte hain ki Arjun sirf bhaavnaon mein beh raha hai aur sachchai ko spasht roop se nahi dekh pa raha.

Ab Bhagavad Gita ka asli updesh yahin se shuru hota hai, jab Krishna Arjun ko uski uljhan se bahar nikalne ka prayas karte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab hum dukh aur uljhan mein hote hain, tab sahi margdarshan hamari poori soch badal sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
कुतस्त्वा कश्मलमिदं विषमे समुपस्थितम् ।
अनार्यजुष्टमस्वर्ग्यमकीर्तिकरमर्जुन ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Kutas tva kashmalam idam vishame samupasthitam,
Anarya-jushtam asvargyam akirtikaram Arjuna.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Bhagwan Krishna ne kaha:

'Hey Arjun! Is kathin samay mein tumhe yeh moha aur nirasha kahan se aa gayi? Yeh ek veer aur uchch vicharon wale vyakti ke yogya nahi hai. Isse na tumhara kalyan hoga aur na hi tumhari kirti badhegi.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna Arjun ko jagaane ki koshish kar rahe hain. Unhe lagta hai ki Arjun apni asli pehchaan aur kartavya ko bhool gaya hai.

Yeh yuddh ka sabse mahatvapurn samay hai, lekin Arjun nirasha aur bhay mein doob gaya hai. Krishna use yaad dilate hain ki mushkil paristhitiyon mein himmat khona kisi veer vyakti ko shobha nahi deta.

Krishna ka uddeshya Arjun ko daantna nahi, balki uske andar ki shakti ko jagana hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Kathin paristhitiyon mein haar maan lena samasya ka samadhan nahi hota. Himmat aur vivek se hi raasta nikalta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते ।
क्षुद्रं हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ परन्तप ॥
verses.transliteration:
Klaibyam ma sma gamah Partha naitat tvayy upapadyate,
Kshudram hridaya-daurbalyam tyaktvottishtha Parantapa.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Bhagwan Krishna ne kaha:

'Hey Parth! Is prakar ki kamzori tumhe shobha nahi deti. Hriday ki is chhoti si durbalta ko chhod do aur uth khade ho, hey shatruon ko harane wale veer!'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna Arjun ko uski asli pehchaan yaad dila rahe hain.

Arjun ek mahaan yoddha hai, jisne anek kathin paristhitiyon ka saamna kiya hai. Lekin is samay vah apni bhaavnaon ke bojh se dab gaya hai.

Krishna use samjha rahe hain ki bhavnaayein swabhavik hain, lekin unke kaaran apne kartavya se peeche hat jaana sahi nahi hai. Ve chahte hain ki Arjun apni antar ki shakti ko pehchaane aur phir se dridh bane.
verses.lifeLesson: Aatmavishwas aur sahas aksar wahi se shuru hote hain jahan hum apni kamzori ko pehchankar usse upar uthne ka faisla karte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
कथं भीष्ममहं सङ्ख्ये द्रोणं च मधुसूदन ।
इषुभिः प्रतियोत्स्यामि पूजार्हावरिसूदन ॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Katham Bhishmam aham sankhye Dronam cha Madhusudana,
Ishubhih pratiyotsyami pujarhau arisudana.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'Hey Madhusudan! Main yuddh mein Bhishma Pitamah aur Guru Dronacharya par baan kaise chala sakta hoon? Ve dono mere liye poojaniya hain.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ki sabse badi samasya yeh hai ki uske saamne aam shatru nahi khade hain.

Bhishma Pitamah ne bachpan se uski raksha ki thi aur Dronacharya ne use dhanurvidya sikhayi thi. Arjun un dono ka bahut samman karta hai.

Isi liye uska mann maanta hi nahi ki vah apne guru aur buzurgon ke viruddh hathiyaar uthaaye. Yeh uske hriday aur kartavya ke beech ka sangharsh hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan mein kai baar aise faisle aate hain jahan bhavna aur kartavya ek doosre ke saamne khade ho jaate hain.

verses.sanskrit:
गुरूनहत्वा हि महानुभावान्
श्रेयो भोक्तुं भैक्ष्यमपीह लोके ।
हत्वार्थकामांस्तु गुरूनिहैव
भुञ्जीय भोगान् रुधिरप्रदिग्धान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Gurun ahatva hi mahanubhavan
Shreyo bhoktum bhaikshyam apiha loke,
Hatvartha-kamams tu gurun ihaiva
Bhunjiy bhogan rudhira-pradigdhan.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'In mahaan guruon ko maarne se achha hai ki main bhiksha maang kar jeevan bita loon. Agar inhe maar kar rajya aur sukh praapt bhi ho jaaye, to vah sab unke khoon se range hue honge.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ke liye yeh sirf yuddh nahi, balki naitik sankat hai.

Use lagta hai ki agar usne apne guruon aur buzurgon ko maar kar rajya jeeta, to us vijay mein koi khushi nahi hogi. Har sukh use unki yaad dilayega.

Isi liye vah kehta hai ki aisi vijay se achha hai saadhaaran jeevan jeena, lekin apnon ke khoon ka bojh na uthana.
verses.lifeLesson: Safalta tabhi maayne rakhti hai jab use paane ka raasta bhi naitik aur uchit ho.

verses.sanskrit:
न चैतद्विद्मः कतरन्नो गरीयो
यद्वा जयेम यदि वा नो जयेयुः ।
यानेव हत्वा न जिजीविषामस्-
तेऽवस्थिताः प्रमुखे धार्तराष्ट्राः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na chaitad vidmah kataran no gariyo,
Yad va jayema yadi va no jayeyuh,
Yan eva hatva na jijivishamas
Te avasthitah pramukhe Dhartarashtrah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'Humein yeh bhi nahi pata ki hamare liye kya behtar hai — jeetna ya haarna. Jin logon ko maar kar hum jeena bhi nahi chahte, wahi Dhritarashtra ke putra hamare saamne khade hain.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun itni gehri uljhan mein hai ki ab use jeet aur haar dono hi bekaar lagne lage hain.

Agar vah jeet gaya, to apnon ko kho dega. Aur agar haar gaya, to sab kuch kho dega. Dono sthitiyon mein use dukh hi dikh raha hai.

Yeh shlok dikhata hai ki jab mann bahut zyada uljhan mein ho, tab insaan ko sahi aur galat ka faisla karna kitna mushkil lag sakta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab mann uljhan se bhar jaaye, tab turant faisla karne ke bajaay gyaan aur margdarshan ki talaash karni chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
कार्पण्यदोषोपहतस्वभावः
पृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसम्मूढचेताः ।
यच्छ्रेयः स्यान्निश्चितं ब्रूहि तन्मे
शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Karpaṇya-doshopahata-svabhavah
Prcchami tvam dharma-sammudha-cetah,
Yac chreyah syan nishchitam bruhi tan me
Shishyas te'ham shadhi mam tvam prapannam.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'Mera mann uljhan aur kamzori se bhar gaya hai. Mujhe samajh nahi aa raha ki sahi kya hai aur galat kya hai. Kripya mujhe wahi bataiye jo mere liye sabse adhik kalyankari ho. Main aapka shishya hoon aur aapki sharan mein aaya hoon.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Is shlok mein Arjun pehli baar poori vinamrata ke saath Krishna se margdarshan maangta hai.

Use ehsaas ho jata hai ki woh apni buddhi se sahi faisla nahi kar paa raha. Isliye woh Krishna ko apna guru maan kar unse gyaan maangta hai.

Yahi Bhagavad Gita ka asli aarambh hai, kyunki seekhne ki shuruaat tab hoti hai jab hum sweekar karte hain ki humein madad ki zarurat hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab hum apni uljhan ko sweekar karke sahi margdarshan maangte hain, tabhi sachcha gyaan milta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि प्रपश्यामि ममापनुद्याद्
यच्छोकमुच्छोषणमिन्द्रियाणाम् ।
अवाप्य भूमावसपत्नमृद्धं
राज्यं सुराणामपि चाधिपत्यम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na hi prapashyami mamapanudyad
Yac chokam ucchoshanam indriyanam,
Avapya bhumav asapatnam riddham
Rajyam suranam api chadhipatyam.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne kaha:

'Mujhe koi aisa upay nazar nahi aata jo mere is gehre dukh ko door kar sake. Chahe mujhe poori prithvi ka rajya mil jaaye ya devtaon ka bhi adhikaar mil jaaye, phir bhi mera yeh shok khatam nahi hoga.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun samajh gaya hai ki uski samasya dhan, rajya ya shakti ki nahi hai.

Uska dukh itna gehra hai ki duniya ki sabse badi safalta bhi use khushi nahi de sakti.

Yeh batata hai ki kuch samasyaayein bahari cheezon se nahi, balki andar ki uljhan aur dukh se judi hoti hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Paisa aur safalta har dukh ka ilaaj nahi hote. Mann ki shanti sabse bada dhan hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशं गुडाकेशः परन्तप ।
न योत्स्य इति गोविन्दमुक्त्वा तूष्णीं बभूव ह ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sanjaya Uvacha:
Evam uktva Hrishikesham Gudakeshah Parantapah,
Na yotsya iti Govindam uktva tushnim babhuva ha.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Sanjaya ne kaha:

'Itna kehne ke baad Arjun ne Krishna se kaha, "Main yuddh nahi karunga," aur phir chup ho gaya.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Apni saari baat kehne ke baad bhi Arjun kisi faisle par nahi pahunch paaya.

Uska mann dukh aur uljhan se bhar gaya tha. Isliye usne yuddh karne se mana kar diya aur chupchaap baith gaya.

Ab Arjun ke paas apni taraf se kehne ko kuch nahi bacha tha. Isi samay Krishna use sachcha gyaan dene wale hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Kabhi-kabhi jab hum poori tarah ulajh jaate hain, tab bolne se zyada zaroori sunna hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत ।
सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tam uvacha Hrishikeshah prahasann iva Bharata,
Senayor ubhayor madhye vishidantam idam vachah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Sanjaya ne kaha:

'Hey Dhritarashtra! Dono senaon ke beech shok mein doobe hue Arjun se Bhagwan Krishna ne halka sa muskurate hue baat karni shuru ki.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun poori tarah se nirash aur uljhan mein doob chuka tha. Usne yuddh karne se mana kar diya tha aur apne hathiyaar neeche rakh diye the.

Bhagwan Krishna dekh rahe the ki Arjun ka dukh uski soch par haavi ho gaya hai. Isliye Krishna ne muskurate hue usse samjhana shuru kiya.

Isi kshan se Bhagavad Gita ka mahaan updesh shuru hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab hum uljhan aur nirasha mein hote hain, tab ek sahi margdarshak humein nayi drishti aur sahi raasta dikha sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
अशोच्यानन्वशोचस्त्वं प्रज्ञावादांश्च भाषसे ।
गतासूनगतासूंश्च नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Ashochyan anvashochas tvam prajnavadams cha bhasase,
Gatasun agatasums cha nanushochanti panditah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Bhagwan Krishna ne kaha:

'Tum un logon ke liye shok kar rahe ho jin ke liye shok karna uchit nahi hai. Saath hi tum gyaan ki baatein bhi kar rahe ho. Sachche gyani na jeevit logon ke liye shok karte hain aur na hi mrit logon ke liye.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna Arjun ko samjha rahe hain ki uska dukh sharir ko dekhkar ho raha hai, atma ko samajhkar nahi.

Gyani vyakti jaanta hai ki atma amar hai aur sharir ke badalne se uska astitva samaapt nahi hota.

Isliye Krishna Arjun ko jeevan aur mrityu ke gehre satya ki taraf le jaana shuru karte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Adhoori jaankari aksar dukh ka kaaran banti hai. Sachcha gyaan drishti ko badal deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
न त्वेवाहं जातु नासं न त्वं नेमे जनाधिपाः ।
न चैव न भविष्यामः सर्वे वयमतः परम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na tvevaham jatu nasam na tvam neme janadhipah,
Na chaiva na bhavishyamah sarve vayam atah param.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Bhagwan Krishna ne kaha:

'Aisa kabhi nahi tha ki main nahi tha, tum nahi the ya ye raja log nahi the. Aur aisa bhi kabhi nahi hoga ki hum aage chal kar rahenge hi nahi.'
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna yahan atma ki nityata samjha rahe hain.

Sharir janm leta hai aur ek din samaapt ho jaata hai, lekin atma kabhi na janm leti hai aur na hi marti hai.

Hum sab pehle bhi the, ab bhi hain aur aage bhi kisi na kisi roop mein rahenge. Isi sach ko samajhne se mrityu ka dar kam ho jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Hum sirf sharir nahi hain. Jab hum apni asli pehchaan ko samajhte hain, tab dar aur shok kam hone lagte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
देहिनोऽस्मिन्यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा ।
तथा देहान्तरप्राप्तिर्धीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Dehino'smin Yatha Dehe Kaumaram Yauvanam Jara,
Tatha Dehantar-Praptir Dhiras Tatra Na Muhyati.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise ek vyakti bachpan se jawani aur phir budhape tak pahunchta hai, waise hi mrityu ke baad atma ek shareer chhodkar doosra shareer prapt karti hai. Gyani vyakti is baat se ghabrata nahi hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna Arjun ko samjha rahe hain ki shareer badalta rehta hai, lekin atma kabhi nahi badalti.

Bachpan, jawani aur budhapa shareer ke badlav hain. Isi tarah mrityu bhi sirf ek badlav hai, ant nahi.

Jo vyakti is sach ko samajh leta hai, vah mrityu ya badlav se dukhi nahi hota.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan mein badlav swabhavik hain. Unhe samajhkar aur sweekar karke hum adhik shaant reh sakte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः ।
आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत ॥
verses.transliteration:
Matra-Sparshas Tu Kaunteya Shitoshna-Sukha-Duhkha-Dah,
Agamapayino'nityas Tams Titikshasva Bharata.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Thand-garmi, sukh-dukh aur anya anubhav indriyon ke vishayon se milne par utpann hote hain. Yeh aate aur jaate rehte hain, isliye inhe dhairya se sahan karo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jeevan mein kabhi sukh milta hai aur kabhi dukh. Kabhi paristhitiyan achchi hoti hain aur kabhi kathin.

Shri Krishna kehte hain ki yeh sab sthayi nahi hote. Jaise mausam badalta rehta hai, waise hi sukh aur dukh bhi badalte rehte hain.

Isliye humein har paristhiti mein dhairya aur santulan banaye rakhna chahiye.
verses.lifeLesson: Har mushkil aur har khushi ek din beet jaati hai. Dhairya rakhna jeevan ki badi shakti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ ।
समदुःखसुखं धीरं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yam Hi Na Vyathayantyete Purusham Purusharshabha,
Sama-Duhkha-Sukham Dhiram So'mritatvaya Kalpate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Jo vyakti sukh aur dukh dono mein samaan rehta hai aur paristhitiyon se vichlit nahi hota, vah moksha ka adhikari banta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna batate hain ki sachcha gyani wahi hai jo safalta mein adhik utsahit aur asafalta mein adhik nirash nahi hota.

Vah har paristhiti mein apna santulan banaye rakhta hai.

Aisa vyakti andar se majboot hota hai aur adhyatmik unnati ki aur badhta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sukh aur dukh dono ko samaan drishti se dekhna man ko majboot aur shaant banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः ।
उभयोरपि दृष्टोऽन्तस्त्वनयोस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Nasato Vidyate Bhavo Nabhavo Vidyate Satah,
Ubhayorapi Drshto'ntas Tvanayos Tattvadarshibhih.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo asatya aur asthayi hai uska koi sthayi astitva nahi hota, aur jo satya hai uska kabhi naash nahi hota. Gyani log is sach ko samajhte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan satya aur asatya ka antar samjha rahe hain.

Shareer aur duniya ki vastuayein badalti rehti hain, isliye ve asthayi hain. Lekin atma sadaiv rehti hai, isliye vah satya hai.

Gyani vyakti isi sach ko pehchan leta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan mein hamesha satya aur sthayi mulyon ko mahatva dena chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
अविनाशि तु तद्विद्धि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
विनाशमव्ययस्यास्य न कश्चित्कर्तुमर्हति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Avinashi Tu Tad Viddhi Yena Sarvam Idam Tatam,
Vinasham Avyayasyasya Na Kashcit Kartum Arhati.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo poore jagat mein vyapt hai, use avinashi jaano. Uska naash koi nahi kar sakta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna batate hain ki atma har jeev ke andar maujood hai.

Atma kabhi khatam nahi hoti aur na hi ise koi nuksan pahuncha sakta hai.

Yeh hamesha rehti hai aur sabhi jeevon mein samaan roop se vidyamaan hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Hamari asli pehchaan shareer nahi, balki avinashi atma hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तवन्त इमे देहा नित्यस्योक्ताः शरीरिणः ।
अनाशिनोऽप्रमेयस्य तस्माद्युध्यस्व भारत ॥
verses.transliteration:
Antavanta Ime Deha Nityasyoktah Sharirinah,
Anashino'prameyasya Tasmad Yudhyasva Bharata.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Atma sadaiv rehti hai, lekin shareer ek din samapt ho jata hai. Isliye hey Arjun, apna kartavya nibhao.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna Arjun ko yaad dilate hain ki shareer nashvar hai aur ek din khatam ho jayega.

Lekin atma amar hai aur kabhi nahi marti.

Isliye sirf shareer ke naash ka sochkar apne kartavya se peeche nahi hatna chahiye.
verses.lifeLesson: Darr aur moh ko chhodkar apne kartavya par dhyan dena chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम् ।
उभौ तौ न विजानीतो नायं हन्ति न हन्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ya Enam Vetti Hantaram Yas Chainam Manyate Hatam,
Ubhau Tau Na Vijanito Nayam Hanti Na Hanyate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo atma ko maarne wala ya mara hua samajhta hai, dono hi sach ko nahi jaante. Atma na kisi ko maarti hai aur na hi maari ja sakti hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna batate hain ki atma ka na janm hota hai aur na hi mrityu.

Isliye kisi vyakti ke shareer ke naash ko atma ka naash samajhna galat hai.

Atma hamesha bani rehti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab hum atma ki sachchai ko samajhte hain, tab mrityu ka bhay kam ho jata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्
नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः ।
अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो
न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Jayate Mriyate Va Kadachin,
Nayam Bhutva Bhavita Va Na Bhuyah.
Ajo Nityah Shashvato'yam Purano,
Na Hanyate Hanyamane Sharire.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Atma ka kabhi janm nahi hota aur na hi uski mrityu hoti hai. Shareer ke naash hone par bhi atma ka kuch nahi bigadta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna atma ke amar swaroop ko aur spasht karte hain.

Atma na kabhi paida hoti hai aur na kabhi khatam hoti hai.

Shareer badalte rehte hain, lekin atma hamesha waise hi bani rehti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni pehchaan atma se jodne par bhay aur chinta kam ho jaate hain.

verses.sanskrit:
वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यं य एनमजमव्ययम् ।
कथं स पुरुषः पार्थ कं घातयति हन्ति कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Vedavinashinam Nityam Ya Enam Ajam Avyayam,
Katham Sa Purushah Partha Kam Ghatayati Hanti Kam.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Jo vyakti atma ko avinashi, amar aur nitya jaanta hai, vah kaise kisi ko maarne ya marwane wala samajh sakta hai?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jo vyakti atma ke sachche swaroop ko samajh leta hai, vah jaanta hai ki atma ka kabhi naash nahi hota.

Isliye vah shareer ke star par hone wali ghatnaon ko antim satya nahi maanta.

Uski drishti adhik gahri aur gyanpoorn ho jaati hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachcha gyaan hamari soch ko badal deta hai aur humein jeevan ko sahi drishti se dekhna sikhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय
नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि ।
तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णा-
न्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही ॥
verses.transliteration:
Vasamsi Jirnani Yatha Vihaya,
Navani Grhnati Naro'parani.
Tatha Sharirani Vihaya Jirnani,
Anyani Samyati Navani Dehi.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise koi vyakti purane kapde chhodkar naye kapde pehen leta hai, waise hi atma purana shareer chhodkar naya shareer grahan karti hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna atma aur shareer ka antar ek bahut saral udaharan se samjhate hain.

Jaise kapde purane ho jaane par badal diye jaate hain, waise hi shareer bhi ek samay ke baad badal jata hai.

Lekin kapde badalne se vyakti nahi badalta, usi tarah shareer badalne se atma nahi badalti.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo cheez badalti hai usse adhik moh nahi karna chahiye. Hamari asli pehchaan atma hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः ।
न चैनं क्लेदयन्त्यापो न शोषयति मारुतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Nainam Chindanti Shastrani Nainam Dahati Pavakah,
Na Chainam Kledayantyapo Na Shoshayati Marutah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Atma ko na koi hathiyar kaat sakta hai, na agni jala sakti hai, na paani bhigo sakta hai aur na hi hawa sukha sakti hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna batate hain ki atma kisi bhi bhautik vastu se prabhavit nahi hoti.

Jin cheezon se shareer ko nuksan pahunch sakta hai, unka atma par koi asar nahi hota.

Atma har paristhiti se pare aur surakshit rehti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Atma ki shakti ko samajhne se bhay aur asuraksha ki bhavna kam ho jaati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अच्छेद्योऽयमदाह्योऽयमक्लेद्योऽशोष्य एव च ।
नित्यः सर्वगतः स्थाणुरचलोऽयं सनातनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Acchedyo'yam Adahyo'yam Akledyo'shoshya Eva Cha,
Nityah Sarvagatah Sthanur Achalo'yam Sanatanah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Atma ko na kaata ja sakta hai, na jalaya ja sakta hai, na bhigoya ja sakta hai aur na hi sukhaya ja sakta hai. Vah nitya aur sadaiv rehne wali hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna atma ki visheshtaon ko aur spasht karte hain.

Atma kabhi badalti nahi, kabhi khatam nahi hoti aur hamesha ek samaan rehti hai.

Yeh har jeev mein vidyamaan hai aur samay ke saath bhi iska swaroop nahi badalta.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo cheez sach mein amar hai usi ko apni pehchaan banana chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्तोऽयमचिन्त्योऽयमविकार्योऽयमुच्यते ।
तस्मादेवं विदित्वैनं नानुशोचितुमर्हसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Avyakto'yam Achintyo'yam Avikaryo'yam Ucyate,
Tasmad Evam Viditvainam Nanushochitum Arhasi.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Atma ko dekha nahi ja sakta, poori tarah samjha nahi ja sakta aur usme koi badlav nahi hota. Isliye iske liye shok karna uchit nahi hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Atma hamari aankhon se dikhai nahi deti, lekin iska astitva hota hai.

Yeh shareer ki tarah badalti ya khatam nahi hoti.

Is sach ko jaanne ke baad vyakti anavashyak shok se bahar aa sakta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har cheez jo dikhai nahi deti, zaruri nahi ki vah maujood na ho.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम् ।
तथापि त्वं महाबाहो नैवं शोचितुमर्हसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Atha Chainam Nityajatam Nityam Va Manyase Mritam,
Tathapi Tvam Mahabaho Naivam Shochitum Arhasi.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Agar tum yeh bhi maano ki atma baar-baar janm leti aur marti hai, tab bhi tumhe shok nahi karna chahiye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna tark ke roop mein baat samjha rahe hain.

Vah kehte hain ki agar tum atma ko amar na bhi maano, tab bhi janm aur mrityu jeevan ka niyam hain.

Isliye kisi anivarya baat par atyadhik shok karna uchit nahi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo cheez hamare niyantran mein nahi hai, uske liye adhik chinta nahi karni chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च ।
तस्मादपरिहार्येऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Jatasya Hi Dhruvo Mrityur Dhruvam Janma Mritasya Cha,
Tasmad Apariharye'rthe Na Tvam Shochitum Arhasi.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo janm leta hai uski mrityu nishchit hai, aur jo mar jata hai uska punah janm bhi nishchit hai. Isliye is baat par shok nahi karna chahiye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Janm aur mrityu prakriti ka niyam hain.

Har jeev ko ek din shareer chhodna padta hai.

Is sach ko sweekar karne se hum jeevan ko adhik samajhdari se jee paate hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan ki sachchai ko sweekar karne se man shaant rehta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्तादीनि भूतानि व्यक्तमध्यानि भारत ।
अव्यक्तनिधनान्येव तत्र का परिदेवना ॥
verses.transliteration:
Avyaktadini Bhutani Vyaktamadhyani Bharata,
Avyakta Nidhanany Eva Tatra Ka Paridevana.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sabhi jeev janm se pehle avyakta hote hain, jeevan ke dauran dikhai dete hain aur mrityu ke baad phir avyakta ho jaate hain. Phir shok kis baat ka?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna samjha rahe hain ki jeev ka prakat hona aur phir adrishya ho jana prakriti ka hissa hai.

Hum sirf jeevan ke beech ka hissa dekh paate hain.

Isliye mrityu ko antim satya samajhkar dukhi nahi hona chahiye.
verses.lifeLesson: Har cheez ka ek prakritik chakra hota hai, use samajhna zaruri hai.

verses.sanskrit:
आश्चर्यवत्पश्यति कश्चिदेन-
माश्चर्यवद्वदति तथैव चान्यः ।
आश्चर्यवच्चैनमन्यः शृणोति
श्रुत्वाप्येनं वेद न चैव कश्चित् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ashcharyavat Pashyati Kashchid Enam,
Ashcharyavad Vadati Tathaiva Chanyah.
Ashcharyavac Chainam Anyah Shrinoti,
Shrutvapy Enam Veda Na Chaiva Kashchit.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kuch log atma ko ek adbhut cheez ke roop mein dekhte hain, kuch uske baare mein sunte ya batate hain, lekin bahut kam log use sach mein samajh paate hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Atma ka gyaan bahut gehra aur adbhut hai.

Log iske baare mein sunte hain, padhte hain aur charcha karte hain.

Lekin iska sachcha anubhav aur samajh bahut kam logon ko hoti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Keval sunna ya padhna hi kaafi nahi, sachcha gyaan anubhav aur samajh se aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
देही नित्यमवध्योऽयं देहे सर्वस्य भारत ।
तस्मात्सर्वाणि भूतानि न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Dehi Nityam Avadhyo'yam Dehe Sarvasya Bharata,
Tasmat Sarvani Bhutani Na Tvam Shochitum Arhasi.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Sabhi jeevon ke shareer mein rehne wali atma avinashi hai. Isliye kisi ke liye atyadhik shok nahi karna chahiye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna phir se yaad dilate hain ki atma kabhi nahi marti.

Mrityu sirf shareer ka ant hai, atma ka nahi.

Isliye gyaan ke saath jeevan ko dekhna chahiye, sirf bhavnaon ke saath nahi.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab hum atma ko samajhte hain, tab jeevan aur mrityu dono ko alag drishti se dekhte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि ।
धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाच्छ्रेयोऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Svadharmam Api Chavekshya Na Vikampitum Arhasi,
Dharmyad Dhi Yuddhach Chreyo'nyat Kshatriyasya Na Vidyate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Apne kartavya ko dekhkar tumhe vichlit nahi hona chahiye. Ek kshatriya ke liye dharm ki raksha karna sabse bada kartavya hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Ab Shri Krishna atma ke gyaan se kartavya ki baat par aate hain.

Arjun ek yoddha hai aur uska kartavya dharm ki raksha karna hai.

Kathin paristhitiyon mein bhi vyakti ko apne kartavya se peeche nahi hatna chahiye.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi kaam mushkil ho sakta hai, lekin kartavya se bhaagna samadhan nahi hota.

verses.sanskrit:
यदृच्छया चोपपन्नं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम् ।
सुखिनः क्षत्रियाः पार्थ लभन्ते युद्धमीदृशम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yadricchaya Chopapannam Svargadvaram Apavritam,
Sukhinaḥ Kshatriyah Partha Labhante Yuddham Idrisham.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Aisa dharm yuddh jo swayam prapt ho aur dharm ki raksha ke liye ho, bahut hi bhagyashali yoddhaon ko milta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna Arjun ko bata rahe hain ki yeh yuddh sirf rajya ke liye nahi, balki dharm ki raksha ke liye hai.

Har vyakti ko jeevan mein aise avsar nahi milte jahan vah sachchai aur nyay ke liye khada ho sake.

Isliye Arjun ko is kartavya se peeche nahi hatna chahiye.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab sachchai aur nyay ke liye khade hone ka avsar mile, to usse ghabrana nahi chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ चेत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि ।
ततः स्वधर्मं कीर्तिं च हित्वा पापमवाप्स्यसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Atha Chet Tvam Imam Dharmyam Sangramam Na Karishyasi,
Tatah Svadharmam Kirtim Cha Hitva Papam Avapsyasi.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Agar tum is dharm yuddh ko nahi karoge, to apne kartavya aur samman ko kho kar paap ke bhaagi banoge.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna kehte hain ki kartavya se bhaagna bhi galat ho sakta hai.

Arjun ka dharm anyay ke khilaf ladna hai.

Agar vah darr ya moh ke karan apna kartavya chhod deta hai, to vah galat ka saath dene jaisa hoga.
verses.lifeLesson: Kartavya se bhaagna aksar samasya ko aur bada bana deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अकीर्तिं चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति तेऽव्ययाम् ।
सम्भावितस्य चाकीर्तिर्मरणादतिरिच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Akirtim Chapi Bhutani Kathayishyanti Te'vyayam,
Sambhavitasya Chakirtir Maranad Atirichyate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Log tumhari badnaami ko lambe samay tak yaad rakhenge, aur ek sammanit vyakti ke liye badnaami mrityu se bhi adhik dukhdayi hoti hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ek mahan yoddha ke roop mein jaana jaata tha.

Agar vah yuddh se peeche hat jaata, to log use kayar samajhte.

Shri Krishna samjha rahe hain ki samman aur charitra ko bachaye rakhna bahut mahatvapurn hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Achha charitra aur imaandari jeevan ki sabse badi sampatti hain.

verses.sanskrit:
भयाद्रणादुपरतं मंस्यन्ते त्वां महारथाः ।
येषां च त्वं बहुमतो भूत्वा यास्यसि लाघवम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Bhayad Ranad Uparatam Mamsyante Tvam Maharathah,
Yesham Cha Tvam Bahumato Bhutva Yasyasi Laghavam.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo mahan yoddha tumhara samman karte hain, ve sochenge ki tum darr kar yuddh se bhaag gaye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna Arjun ko batate hain ki log uske faisle ko samajh nahi payenge.

Ve sochenge ki Arjun ne darr ke karan yuddh chhod diya.

Isse uska samman aur vishwas dono kam ho sakte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Dar ke karan liye gaye faisle aksar humein pachtava dete hain.

verses.sanskrit:
अवाच्यवादांश्च बहून्वदिष्यन्ति तवाहिताः ।
निन्दन्तस्तव सामर्थ्यं ततो दुःखतरं नु किम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Avachyavadansh Cha Bahun Vadishyanti Tavahitah,
Nindantas Tava Samarthyam Tato Duhkhatram Nu Kim.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Tumhare shatru tumhari ninda karenge aur tumhari yogyata ka mazaak udaayenge. Isse bada dukh aur kya ho sakta hai?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Agar Arjun yuddh se peeche hat jaata, to uske virodhi uska mazaak banaate.

Ve uski shakti aur sahas par sawaal uthate.

Shri Krishna use yaad dilate hain ki kabhi-kabhi kathin kaam karna hi sahi raasta hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Dusron ke dar se nahi, apne kartavya aur sachchai ke aadhar par faisla lena chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम् ।
तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ कौन्तेय युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Hato Va Prapsyasi Svargam Jitva Va Bhokshyase Mahim,
Tasmad Uttishtha Kaunteya Yuddhaya Krita Nishchayah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yadi tum yuddh mein veergati paate ho to swarg prapt karoge, aur yadi jeetoge to rajya ka sukh bhogoge. Isliye dridh nishchay ke saath khade ho jao.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna Arjun ko batate hain ki dono paristhitiyon mein uska hi kalyan hai.

Jeetne par dharm ki sthapana hogi aur haarne par veergati milegi.

Isliye use darr ya uljhan mein nahi rehna chahiye.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab uddeshya sahi ho, to parinaam ki chinta chhodkar poori mehnat karni chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ ।
ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sukha-Duhkhe Same Kritva Labhalabhau Jayajayau,
Tato Yuddhaya Yujyasva Naivam Papam Avapsyasi.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sukh-dukh, laabh-haani aur jeet-haar ko samaan samajhkar apna kartavya karo. Aisa karne se tum paap ke bhaagi nahi banoge.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Bhagavad Gita ke sabse mahatvapurn sandeshon mein se ek hai.

Shri Krishna kehte hain ki parinaam ki chinta kiye bina kartavya par dhyan do.

Jab man santulit rehta hai, tab hum sahi nirnay le paate hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Safalta aur asafalta dono mein santulan banaye rakhna hi asli yog hai.

verses.sanskrit:
एषा तेऽभिहिता साङ्ख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां शृणु ।
बुद्ध्या युक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Esha Te'bhihita Sankhye Buddhir Yoge Tvimam Shrunu,
Buddhya Yukto Yaya Partha Karmabandham Prahasyasi.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Ab tak maine tumhe gyaan ka marg samjhaya. Ab karma yog ko suno, jiske dwara tum karmon ke bandhan se mukt ho sakte ho.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Ab Shri Krishna atma ke gyaan se karma yog ki aur badh rahe hain.

Vah batate hain ki sahi soch ke saath kiya gaya karm vyakti ko bandhan mein nahi baandhta.

Yahi karma yog ka aarambh hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi soch aur nishkaam bhav ke saath kiya gaya karm man ko mukti deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नेहाभिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते ।
स्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Nehabhikramanasho'sti Pratyavayo Na Vidyate,
Svalpam Apyasya Dharmasya Trayate Mahato Bhayat.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Is marg par ki gayi thodi si bhi pragati vyarth nahi jaati. Iska thoda sa abhyas bhi bade bhay se bachata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna batate hain ki adhyatmik marg par kiya gaya har prayas mahatvapurn hota hai.

Yahan mehnat kabhi bekaar nahi jaati.

Chhota sa sahi kadam bhi vyakti ke jeevan mein bada badlav la sakta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Achhe kaam ki shuruaat chhoti ho sakti hai, lekin uska prabhav bahut bada ho sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह कुरुनन्दन ।
बहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Vyavasayatmika Buddhir Ekeha Kurunandana,
Bahushakha Hyanantashcha Buddhayo'vyavasayinam.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Jiska lakshya spasht hota hai uski buddhi ekagr rehti hai, lekin jo log asmanjas mein rehte hain unki soch kai dishaon mein bikhri rehti hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna batate hain ki safalta aur adhyatmik unnati ke liye man ka ekagr hona zaruri hai.

Jab hamara lakshya spasht hota hai, tab hum sahi faisle le paate hain.

Lekin jo vyakti har samay uljhan mein rehta hai, uski urja kai dishaon mein bikhhar jaati hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan mein ek spasht lakshya aur dridh nishchay bahut mahatvapurn hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
यामिमां पुष्पितां वाचं प्रवदन्त्यविपश्चितः ।
वेदवादरताः पार्थ नान्यदस्तीति वादिनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yam Imam Pushpitam Vacham Pravadanty Avipashchitah,
Vedavadaratah Partha Nanyad Astiti Vadinaḥ.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kuch log sirf sundar baaton aur bahari dharmik kriyaon mein uljhe rehte hain aur unhe hi sab kuch samajhte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna batate hain ki kuch log dharm ke asli uddeshya ko samjhe bina sirf bahari kriyaon par dhyan dete hain.

Ve shabdon aur dikhave mein uljhe rehte hain.

Lekin sachcha gyaan andar ki shuddhi aur samajh se aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sirf dikhawa nahi, balki sachchi samajh aur niyat mahatvapurn hoti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
कामात्मानः स्वर्गपरा जन्मकर्मफलप्रदाम् ।
क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Kamatmanah Svargapara Janma Karma Phalapradam,
Kriyavishesha Bahulam Bhogaisvarya Gatim Prati.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo log ichchhaon aur bhog-vilas mein lage rehte hain, ve aise karmon mein uljhe rehte hain jo sirf sukh aur dhan dene ka vaada karte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Kuch logon ka dhyan keval sukh, dhan aur swarg paane par hota hai.

Isliye ve har kaam kisi na kisi laabh ke liye karte hain.

Shri Krishna batate hain ki aisi soch vyakti ko asli shanti se door le jaati hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Keval laabh aur sukh ke peeche bhaagne se man kabhi santusht nahi hota.

verses.sanskrit:
भोगैश्वर्यप्रसक्तानां तयापहृतचेतसाम् ।
व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिः समाधौ न विधीयते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Bhogaisvarya Prasaktanam Tayapahrita Chetasam,
Vyavasayatmika Buddhih Samadhau Na Vidhiyate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo log bhog aur aishwarya mein adhik aasakt hote hain, unka man sthir nahi ho pata.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jab man hamesha paisa, sukh aur suvidhaon ke peeche bhaagta rehta hai, tab usse shanti nahi milti.

Aisa vyakti apne lakshya par dhyan nahi laga pata.

Isliye adhyatmik pragati ke liye man ka santulit rehna zaruri hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ati aasakti man ki shanti aur ekagrata ko kam kar deti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रैगुण्यविषया वेदा निस्त्रैगुण्यो भवार्जुन ।
निर्द्वन्द्वो नित्यसत्त्वस्थो निर्योगक्षेम आत्मवान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Traigunya Vishaya Veda Nistraigunyo Bhavarjuna,
Nirdvandvo Nityasattvastho Niryogakshema Atmavan.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Sukh-dukh aur anya dvandvon se upar uthkar, shuddh aur sthir man wale bano.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna Arjun ko kehte hain ki jeevan ke utar-chadhav se bahut adhik prabhavit nahi hona chahiye.

Man ko shaant aur santulit rakhna hi sachchi pragati ka marg hai.

Jo vyakti apne upar niyantran rakhta hai, wahi andar se majboot banta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har paristhiti mein santulan banaye rakhna jeevan ki badi kala hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यावानर्थ उदपाने सर्वतः सम्प्लुतोदके ।
तावान्सर्वेषु वेदेषु ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yavan Artha Udapane Sarvatah Samplutodake,
Tavan Sarveshu Vedeshu Brahmanasya Vijanatah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jis vyakti ko sachcha gyaan mil jaata hai, uske liye bahut si baatein swayam hi spasht ho jaati hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jaise ek bade jalashaya ke saamne chhote kuen ka mahatva kam ho jaata hai,

waise hi sachcha gyaan prapt karne ke baad vyakti ko jeevan ki gehri samajh mil jaati hai.

Tab vah sirf jaankari nahi, balki gyaan ko jeene lagta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachcha gyaan sirf padhne se nahi, samajhne aur jeene se milta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन ।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Karmanye Vadhikaraste Ma Phaleshu Kadachana,
Ma Karma Phala Hetur Bhur Ma Te Sango'stvakarmani.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Tumhara adhikar sirf karm karne par hai, uske phal par nahi. Isliye phal ki chinta kiye bina apna kartavya karo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Bhagavad Gita ka sabse prasiddh shlok hai.

Shri Krishna kehte hain ki humein apni poori mehnat aur imaandari se kaam karna chahiye.

Lekin parinaam ki chinta mein apni shanti nahi khona chahiye.
verses.lifeLesson: Mehnat par dhyan do, parinaam apne aap aayega.

verses.sanskrit:
योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय ।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yogasthah Kuru Karmani Sangam Tyaktva Dhananjaya,
Siddhyasiddhyoh Samo Bhutva Samatvam Yoga Uchyate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Safalta aur asafalta mein samaan rehkar apna kartavya karo. Isi ko yog kehte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna batate hain ki yog ka matlab sirf dhyan lagana nahi hai.

Asli yog hai har paristhiti mein santulit rehna.

Jab vyakti jeet aur haar dono ko shaanti se sweekar karta hai, tab vah yogi kehlata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeet aur haar dono mein santulan banaye rakhna hi asli safalta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
दूरेण ह्यवरं कर्म बुद्धियोगाद्धनञ्जय ।
बुद्धौ शरणमन्विच्छ कृपणाः फलहेतवः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Durena Hyavaram Karma Buddhiyogad Dhananjaya,
Buddhau Sharanam Anviccha Kripanah Phala Hetavah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Sirf phal ki ichchha se kiya gaya karm, samajhdari aur yog ke saath kiye gaye karm se neecha hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jo log har kaam sirf laabh ke liye karte hain, ve aksar chinta aur nirasha mein fase rehte hain.

Shri Krishna kehte hain ki buddhi aur vivek ke saath karm karna adhik uttam hai.

Aisa karm man ko shaanti aur santosh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sirf fayde ke liye nahi, sahi uddeshya ke liye bhi kaam karna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते ।
तस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Buddhiyukto Jahatiha Ubhe Sukrita-Dushkrite,
Tasmad Yogaya Yujyasva Yogah Karmasu Kaushalam.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo vyakti samatva aur vivek ke saath karm karta hai, vah paap aur punya ke bandhan se upar uth jaata hai. Isliye yog mein sthit hokar karm karo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna batate hain ki yog ka matlab sirf dhyan lagana nahi hai.

Asli yog hai har kaam ko samajhdari, imaandari aur santulan ke saath karna.

Jab hum bina swarth aur bina adhik chinta ke karm karte hain, tab man shaant rehta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har kaam ko poori lagan aur samajhdari se karna hi jeevan ki asli kala hai.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः ।
जन्मबन्धविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Karmajam Buddhiyukta Hi Phalam Tyaktva Manishinah,
Janma-Bandha-Vinirmuktah Padam Gacchanty Anamayam.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Gyani log karm ke phal ki aasakti chhod dete hain aur jeevan ke bandhanon se mukt hokar shanti ko prapt karte hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jo vyakti sirf phal ke liye kaam nahi karta, uska man halka aur shaant rehta hai.

Vah safalta aur asafalta dono mein santulit rehta hai.

Aisi soch vyakti ko andar se azaadi aur sukoon deti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Phal ki chinta kam karne se jeevan mein adhik shanti milti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा ते मोहकलिलं बुद्धिर्व्यतितरिष्यति ।
तदा गन्तासि निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yada Te Mohakalilam Buddhir Vyatitarishyati,
Tada Gantasi Nirvedam Shrotavyasya Shrutasya Cha.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jab tumhari buddhi moh aur bhram se bahar aa jaayegi, tab tum sach ko spasht roop se dekh paoge.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Moh aur bhram hamari soch ko dhundhla bana dete hain.

Jab gyaan ke dwara yeh bhram door ho jaata hai, tab vyakti sahi aur galat ko achhi tarah samajhne lagta hai.

Uska man bahari baaton se kam prabhavit hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Spasht soch ke liye moh aur bhram ko kam karna zaruri hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुतिविप्रतिपन्ना ते यदा स्थास्यति निश्चला ।
समाधावचला बुद्धिस्तदा योगमवाप्स्यसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shruti-Vipratipanna Te Yada Sthasyati Nishchala,
Samadhav Achala Buddhis Tada Yogam Avapsyasi.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jab tumhari buddhi sthir aur shaant ho jaayegi, tab tum sachche yog ko prapt kar loge.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jeevan mein humein kai tarah ki baatein aur vichar sunne ko milte hain.

Lekin jab man sthir ho jaata hai aur sach par tik jaata hai, tab uljhan khatam ho jaati hai.

Yahi yog ki avastha hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sthir aur shaant man sahi nirnay lene mein madad karta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
स्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा समाधिस्थस्य केशव ।
स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किमासीत व्रजेत किम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Sthitaprajnasya Ka Bhasha Samadhisthasya Keshava,
Sthitadhih Kim Prabhasheta Kimasita Vrajeta Kim.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne poocha: Hey Krishna! Jiski buddhi sthir ho gayi hai, us vyakti ki pehchaan kya hai? Vah kaise bolta, rehta aur vyavahar karta hai?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ab jaanana chahte hain ki ek gyani aur sthir buddhi wala vyakti kaisa hota hai.

Vah uske vyavahar aur jeevan jeene ke tareeke ke baare mein prashn poochte hain.

Yeh prashn hum sabke liye bhi mahatvapurn hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sirf gyaan paana hi nahi, us gyaan ko jeevan mein utaarna bhi zaruri hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
प्रजहाति यदा कामान्सर्वान्पार्थ मनोगतान् ।
आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Prajahati Yada Kaman Sarvan Partha Manogatan,
Atmany Evatmana Tushtah Sthitaprajnas Tadochyate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shri Krishna ne kaha: Jab vyakti man ki sabhi ichchhaon ko chhodkar apne andar hi santusht rehta hai, tab use sthitaprajna kaha jaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Sthitaprajna vyakti apni khushi ke liye bahari cheezon par nirbhar nahi rehta.

Uski santushti uske andar se aati hai.

Vah paristhitiyon ke badalne par bhi shaant rehta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Asli khushi bahar nahi, apne andar milti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः ।
वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Duhkheshv Anudvigna-Manah Sukheshu Vigata-Sprihah,
Vita-Raga-Bhaya-Krodhah Sthitadhir Munir Uchyate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo vyakti dukh mein pareshan nahi hota, sukh mein adhik aasakt nahi hota aur jiske andar se bhay, krodh aur moh kam ho gaye hain, vah sthir buddhi wala hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jeevan mein har kisi ko sukh aur dukh milte hain.

Lekin gyani vyakti in dono mein santulan banaye rakhta hai.

Vah apni bhavnaon ka gulaam nahi banta.
verses.lifeLesson: Bhavnaon par niyantran jeevan ko adhik shaant aur safal banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहस्तत्तत्प्राप्य शुभाशुभम् ।
नाभिनन्दति न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yah Sarvatranabhisnehas Tat Tat Prapya Shubhashubham,
Nabhinandati Na Dveshti Tasya Prajna Pratishthita.
