verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo vyakti achchi ya buri paristhiti mein na adhik khush hota hai aur na hi dvesh karta hai, uski buddhi sthir hoti hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Sthir buddhi wala vyakti har paristhiti ko santulan ke saath dekhta hai.

Vah safalta mein ahankari nahi banta aur asafalta mein toot nahi jaata.

Uska man sthir aur shaant rehta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har paristhiti mein santulan banaye rakhna ek badi jeevan kala hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः ।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yada Samharate Chayam Kurmo'ṅganiva Sarvashah,
Indriyani Indriyarthebhyas Tasya Prajna Pratishthita.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise kachhua apne angon ko andar samet leta hai, waise hi jo vyakti apni indriyon ko niyantrit kar leta hai, uski buddhi sthir ho jaati hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna kachhue ka udaharan dete hain.

Jab zarurat ho to kachhua apne angon ko surakshit kar leta hai.

Waise hi gyani vyakti apni indriyon aur ichchhaon par niyantran rakhta hai, jisse uska man sthir rehta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Atma-niyantran aur sanyam vyakti ko majboot aur safal banate hain.

verses.sanskrit:
विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः ।
रसवर्जं रसोऽप्यस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्तते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Vishaya Vinivartante Niraharasya Dehinah,
Rasavarjam Raso'pyasya Param Drishtva Nivartate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vyakti kuch samay ke liye vishayon se door reh sakta hai, lekin unki ichchha man mein bani reh sakti hai. Jab use kuch aur uchch aur behtar milta hai, tab vah ichchha bhi chali jaati hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Sirf kisi cheez ko chhod dena kaafi nahi hota.

Jab tak man uski taraf akarshit hai, tab tak aasakti bani rehti hai.

Lekin jab vyakti ko atma ka gyaan aur andar ki khushi milti hai, tab bahari cheezon ki ichchha apne aap kam ho jaati hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Buri aadaton ko sirf rokna nahi, unki jagah kuch behtar apnana zaruri hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यततो ह्यपि कौन्तेय पुरुषस्य विपश्चितः ।
इन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि हरन्ति प्रसभं मनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yatato Hyapi Kaunteya Purushasya Vipashchitah,
Indriyani Pramathini Haranti Prasabham Manah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Buddhiman vyakti ka man bhi kabhi-kabhi indriyan zor se apni taraf kheench leti hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna batate hain ki indriyon ko niyantrit karna aasan nahi hai.

Kabhi-kabhi gyani aur samajhdar vyakti bhi unke prabhav mein aa sakta hai.

Isliye hamesha satark aur jagruk rehna zaruri hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Atma-niyantran ek lagatar abhyas hai, ek baar ka kaam nahi.

verses.sanskrit:
तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः ।
वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tani Sarvani Samyamya Yukta Asita Matparah,
Vashe Hi Yasyendriyani Tasya Prajna Pratishthita.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo vyakti apni indriyon ko niyantrit karke Ishwar mein man lagata hai, uski buddhi sthir ho jaati hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Man aur indriyon ko niyantrit karna zaruri hai.

Jab vyakti apna dhyan uchch lakshya aur sahi marg par lagata hai, tab uska man bhatakta nahi.

Aisa vyakti sthir buddhi wala ban jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jis vyakti ka apne man par niyantran hota hai, vah jeevan mein adhik safal hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते ।
सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Dhyayato Vishayan Pumsah Sangas Teshupajayate,
Sangat Sanjayate Kamah Kamat Krodho'bhijayate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jab vyakti baar-baar kisi vishay ke baare mein sochta hai, to usmein aasakti ho jaati hai. Aasakti se ichchha aur ichchha poori na hone par krodh paida hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna man ke patan ki shuruaat samjhate hain.

Har cheez soch se shuru hoti hai. Baar-baar sochne se lagav badhta hai, lagav se ichchha aur ichchha poori na hone par gussa aata hai.

Isliye apne vicharon par dhyan dena bahut zaruri hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Galat soch ko shuruaat mein hi rok lena bahut si samasyaon se bacha sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
क्रोधाद्भवति सम्मोहः सम्मोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः ।
स्मृतिभ्रंशाद् बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Krodhad Bhavati Sammohah Sammohat Smriti Vibhramah,
Smriti Bhramshad Buddhi Nasho Buddhi Nashat Pranashyati.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Krodh se bhram paida hota hai, bhram se sochne-samajhne ki shakti kam ho jaati hai, aur ant mein vyakti galat raaste par chala jaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna batate hain ki krodh kitna nuksan pahunchata hai.

Gusse mein vyakti sahi aur galat ka antar bhool jaata hai.

Isse uski soch kamzor ho jaati hai aur vah galat nirnay lene lagta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ek pal ka gussa kabhi-kabhi bahut bada nuksan kar sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
रागद्वेषविमुक्तैस्तु विषयानिन्द्रियैश्चरन् ।
आत्मवश्यैर्विधेयात्मा प्रसादमधिगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ragadvesha Vimuktais Tu Vishayan Indriyais Charan,
Atmavashyair Vidheyatma Prasadam Adhigacchati.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo vyakti raag aur dvesh se mukt hokar apni indriyon ko niyantrit rakhta hai, vah man ki shanti prapt karta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Jeevan mein cheezon ka upyog karna galat nahi hai.

Galat tab hota hai jab hum unse atyadhik lagav ya nafrat rakhne lagte hain.

Santulit vyakti har paristhiti mein shaant rehta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Na adhik moh aur na adhik dvesh, dono se door rehna hi santulan hai.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रसादे सर्वदुःखानां हानिरस्योपजायते ।
प्रसन्नचेतसो ह्याशु बुद्धिः पर्यवतिष्ठते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Prasade Sarva Duhkhanam Hanir Asyopajayate,
Prasanna Chetaso Hyashu Buddhih Paryavatishthate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jab man shaant aur prasann rehta hai, tab dukh kam ho jaate hain aur buddhi sthir ho jaati hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shaant man se hum har paristhiti ko behtar tareeke se sambhal paate hain.

Pareshaniyan tab bhi hoti hain, lekin unka prabhav kam ho jaata hai.

Prasann man sahi nirnay lene mein madad karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ki shanti bahari safalta se bhi zyada mahatvapurn hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना ।
न चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Nasti Buddhir Ayuktasya Na Chayuktasya Bhavana,
Na Chabhavayatah Shantir Ashantasya Kutah Sukham.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jiska man niyantrit nahi hai, uski buddhi sthir nahi ho sakti. Aur bina shanti ke sachcha sukh nahi mil sakta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna batate hain ki sukh ka mool man ki shanti hai.

Agar man hamesha bhatakta rahe, to na dhyan lagega aur na hi santosh milega.

Isliye pehle man ko shaant banana zaruri hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shaant man hi sachche sukh ka aadhaar hai.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियाणां हि चरतां यन्मनोऽनुविधीयते ।
तदस्य हरति प्रज्ञां वायुर्नावमिवाम्भसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Indriyanam Hi Charatam Yan Mano'nuvidhiyate,
Tadasya Harati Prajnam Vayur Navam Ivambhasi.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jis vyakti ka man indriyon ke peeche chalta hai, uski buddhi usi tarah bhatak jaati hai jaise hawa paani mein naav ko baha le jaati hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Agar man har ichchha aur akarshan ke peeche bhaagne lage, to vyakti apna lakshya bhool sakta hai.

Shri Krishna naav ka udaharan dekar samjhate hain ki bina niyantran ke man aasani se bhatak sakta hai.

Isliye indriyon aur man par niyantran bahut zaruri hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo apne man ko sambhal leta hai, vah apne jeevan ko bhi sahi disha de sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्माद्यस्य महाबाहो निगृहीतानि सर्वशः ।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tasmad Yasya Mahabaho Nigrihitani Sarvashah,
Indriyani Indriyarthebhyas Tasya Prajna Pratishthita.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Jo vyakti apni indriyon ko vishayon ke prabhav se niyantrit rakhta hai, uski buddhi sthir ho jaati hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna phir se indriya niyantran ka mahatva batate hain.

Jab vyakti har ichchha aur akarshan ke peeche nahi bhaagta, tab uska man shaant rehta hai.

Aisa vyakti sahi nirnay lene mein saksham hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jis vyakti ka apne man aur indriyon par niyantran hota hai, vah jeevan mein adhik safal aur shaant rehta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी ।
यस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ya Nisha Sarvabhutanam Tasyam Jagarti Samyami,
Yasyam Jagrati Bhutani Sa Nisha Pashyato Muneh.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo baatein aam logon ko mahatvapurn lagti hain, ve gyani ke liye mahatvapurn nahi hoti. Aur jo sach gyani dekh pata hai, use aam log aksar nahi samajh paate.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna yahan gyani aur aam vyakti ki soch ka antar batate hain.

Aam log adhiktar bahari sukh aur vasuon mein lage rehte hain.

Lekin gyani vyakti atma, sachchai aur jeevan ke gehre arth par dhyan deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har vyakti wahi dekhta hai jahan uska dhyan hota hai. Isliye apna dhyan sahi cheezon par lagao.

verses.sanskrit:
आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं
समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत् ।
तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे
स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी ॥
verses.transliteration:
Apuryamanam Achala Pratishtham Samudram Apah Pravishanti Yadvat,
Tadvat Kama Yam Pravishanti Sarve Sa Shantim Apnoti Na Kamakami.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise anek nadiyan samudra mein milti hain lekin samudra shaant rehta hai, waise hi jo vyakti ichchhaon ke beech bhi shaant rehta hai, wahi sachchi shanti paata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna samudra ka sundar udaharan dete hain.

Samudra mein lagataar paani aata rehta hai, lekin vah apna santulan nahi khota.

Waise hi gyani vyakti ichchhaon aur paristhitiyon ke aane par bhi andar se shaant rehta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shanti tab milti hai jab hum ichchhaon ke gulaam nahi bante.

verses.sanskrit:
विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान्पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः ।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः स शान्तिमधिगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Vihaya Kaman Yah Sarvan Pumansh Charati Nihsprihah,
Nirmamo Nirahankarah Sa Shantim Adhigacchati.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo vyakti ichchhaon, mamta aur ahankar ko chhodkar jeevan jeeta hai, vah sachchi shanti prapt karta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna batate hain ki ashanti ka ek bada karan ahankar aur adhik aasakti hai.

Jab vyakti 'sirf mera' aur 'main hi sab kuch hoon' wali soch se bahar aata hai, tab uska man halka ho jaata hai.

Aisi soch use andar ki shanti deti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Ahankar kam aur vinamrata adhik hone se jeevan adhik sukhmay banta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति ।
स्थित्वास्यामन्तकालेऽपि ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Esha Brahmi Sthitih Partha Nainam Prapya Vimuhyati,
Sthitvasyam Antakale'pi Brahmanirvanam Richchhati.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Yeh sthir buddhi aur gyaan ki avastha hai. Ise prapt karne wala vyakti kabhi bhramit nahi hota aur ant mein param shanti ko prapt karta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Yeh Adhyay 2 ka samapan shlok hai.

Shri Krishna batate hain ki jo vyakti gyaan, santulan aur atma ki samajh mein sthir ho jaata hai, uska jeevan badal jaata hai.

Vah moh aur bhram se mukt hokar sachchi shanti aur mukti ko prapt karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Gyaan, santulan aur atma ki samajh jeevan ko sachchi shanti ki aur le jaati hai.

summary: The third chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Karma Yoga or the Path of Selfless Service. Here Lord Krishna emphasizes the importance of karma in life. He reveals that it is important for every human being to engage in some sort of activity in this material world. Further, he describes the kinds of actions that lead to bondage and the kinds that lead to liberation. Those persons who continue to perform their respective duties externally for the pleasure of the Supreme, without attachment to its rewards get liberation at the end.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
ज्यायसी चेत्कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिर्जनार्दन ।
तत्किं कर्मणि घोरे मां नियोजयसि केशव ॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Jyayasi Chet Karmanas Te Mata Buddhir Janardana,
Tat Kim Karmani Ghore Mam Niyojayasi Keshava.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kaha: Hey Krishna! Agar gyaan karm se shreshth hai, to phir aap mujhe is kathin yuddh mein kyon laga rahe hain?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Adhyay 2 mein Krishna ne gyaan aur sthir buddhi ki baat ki thi.

Isliye Arjun uljhan mein pad gaya aur poochhne laga ki agar gyaan hi sabse mahatvapurn hai, to use yuddh karne ke liye kyon kaha ja raha hai.

Yeh Adhyay 3 ki shuruaat hai jahan Krishna karm yog ko samjhayenge.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab man mein uljhan ho, to prashn poochhna aur sach ko samajhne ki koshish karni chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे ।
तदेकं वद निश्चित्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Vyamishreneva Vakyena Buddhim Mohayasiva Me,
Tad Ekam Vada Nishchitya Yena Shreyo'ham Apnuyam.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kaha: Aapki baaton se meri buddhi uljhan mein pad gayi hai. Kripaya mujhe ek spasht marg bataiye jisse mera kalyan ho.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun Krishna se kehta hai ki use samajh nahi aa raha ki gyaan ka marg chune ya karm ka.

Vah ek spasht uttar chahta hai jisse vah sahi faisla le sake.

Yeh uski sachchi jigyasa ko dikhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan mein spashtata paane ke liye sahi margdarshan zaruri hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
लोकेऽस्मिन् द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ ।
ज्ञानयोगेन साङ्ख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Loke'smin Dvividha Nishtha Pura Prokta Mayanagha,
Jnanayogena Sankhyanam Karmayogena Yoginam.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shri Krishna ne kaha: Hey Arjun! Is sansar mein do marg bataye gaye hain - gyaan yog aur karm yog.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna samjhate hain ki alag-alag prakriti ke logon ke liye alag marg hote hain.

Kuch log gyaan ke marg se aage badhte hain aur kuch karm yog ke marg se.

Dono ka uddeshya ant mein adhyatmik unnati hi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har vyakti ka safar alag ho sakta hai, lekin lakshya ek hi ho sakta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
न कर्मणामनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते ।
न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Karmanam Anarambhan Naishkarmyam Purusho'shnute,
Na Cha Sannyasanad Eva Siddhim Samadhigacchati.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sirf karm chhod dene se koi mukti nahi paata aur na hi keval sanyas lene se safalta milti hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna batate hain ki karm se bhaagna samadhan nahi hai.

Jeevan mein pragati ke liye sahi bhav se karm karna zaruri hai.

Keval bahari roop se karm chhod dene se gyaan ya mukti nahi milti.
verses.lifeLesson: Samasyaon se bhaagne ke bajaay unka sahi tareeke se saamna karna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि कश्चित्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत् ।
कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Hi Kashcit Kshanam Api Jatu Tishthaty Akarmakrit,
Karyate Hyavashah Karma Sarvah Prakritijair Gunaih.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Koi bhi vyakti ek pal ke liye bhi bina karm kiye nahi reh sakta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna batate hain ki karm karna hamari prakriti ka hissa hai.

Hum sochkar, bolkar ya sharir se hamesha kuch na kuch karte hi rehte hain.

Isliye karm se bachna sambhav nahi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Karm jeevan ka hissa hai, isliye use sahi disha deni chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन् ।
इन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Karmendriyani Samyamya Ya Aste Manasa Smaran,
Indriyarthan Vimudhatma Mithyacharah Sa Uchyate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo vyakti bahar se indriyon ko rokta hai lekin man mein bhogon ke baare mein sochta rehta hai, vah dikhawa karta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna kehte hain ki keval bahari niyantran kaafi nahi hai.

Agar man mein wahi ichchha aur aasakti bani rahe, to vyakti sach mein sanyami nahi hai.

Aisa vyakti khud ko aur dusron ko dhokha deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Asli badlav andar se aata hai, sirf bahari dikhawa kaafi nahi.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन ।
कर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yas Tv Indriyani Manasa Niyamy Arabhate'rjuna,
Karmendriyaih Karmayogam Asaktah Sa Vishishyate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Jo vyakti man se indriyon ko niyantrit karke bina aasakti ke karm karta hai, vah shreshth hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna batate hain ki sahi marg karm yog hai.

Vyakti ko apne kartavya karte rehna chahiye, lekin phal ki aasakti nahi rakhni chahiye.

Aisa karm vyakti ko andar se majboot banata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Kartavya karo, lekin uske phal ke prati adhik chinta mat karo.

verses.sanskrit:
नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः ।
शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Niyatam Kuru Karma Tvam Karma Jyayo Hyakarmanah,
Sharirayatra'pi Cha Te Na Prasiddhyed Akarmanah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Apne kartavya karm karo, kyunki karm na karne se karm karna behtar hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Krishna kehte hain ki jeevan chalane ke liye bhi karm zaruri hai.

Agar vyakti kuch bhi na kare, to vah apni zimmedariyan bhi nahi nibha sakta.

Isliye kartavya se door nahi bhaagna chahiye.
verses.lifeLesson: Nishkriyata se behtar hai ki hum kuch achha aur upyogi kaam karein.

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः ।
तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसङ्गः समाचर ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yajnarthat Karmano Anyatra Loko Ayam Karma Bandhanah,
Tadartham Karma Kaunteya Mukta Sangah Samachara.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jo karm sirf apne fayde ke liye kiye jaate hain, ve insaan ko bandhan mein daal dete hain.

Isliye hey Arjun, apna har kaam kartavya aur seva ke bhaav se karo — kisi lagav ke bina.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna samjha rahe hain ki karm ka asli maqsad sirf apna fayda nahi hona chahiye.

Jab hum doosron ki bhalaai aur ek bade uddeshya ke liye kaam karte hain, tab woh kaam bandhan nahi, mukti deta hai.

Yeh shlok yeh sikhata hai ki kaam ka bhaav hi use sahi ya galat banata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sirf apne liye nahi, balki doosron ki bhalaai ke liye kiye gaye kaam hi sachche aur tikau hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः ।
अनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sahayajnah Prajah Srishtva Purovaca Prajapatih,
Anena Prasavisyadhvam Esha Vo Astvishtakamadhuk.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Shuruaat mein Prajapati ne manushyon ko seva aur yajna ke bhaav ke saath banaya aur kaha ki isi bhaav se aage badho aur ek doosre ka hit karo.

Yeh soch hi tumhare jeevan ko poora karegi.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna bata rahe hain ki jeevan ka sahi tarika sirf lena nahi, dena bhi hai.

Yajna ka matlab hai — apna waqt, mehnat aur koshish doosron ki bhalaai ke liye lagaana.

Jab hum isi bhaav se jeete hain, tab hum bhi badhte hain aur samaj bhi.
verses.lifeLesson: Sirf apne liye jeene se zindagi chhoti ho jaati hai — doosron ke kaam aana hi asli taraqqui hai.

verses.sanskrit:
देवान्भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः ।
परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ ॥
verses.transliteration:
Devan Bhavayatanena Te Deva Bhavayantu Vah,
Parasparam Bhavayantah Shreyah Paramavapsyatha.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Apne kartavya aur yajna se ek doosre ka hit karo.

Jab sab milkar ek doosre ko sehara dete hain, tab hi sachchi unnati hoti hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna samjha rahe hain ki jeevan mein santulan tab aata hai jab sab ek doosre ka sahara bante hain.

Jab hum apna kartavya poori tarah nibhaate hain, tab na sirf hum, balki poora mahaul behtar hota hai.

Sahyog aur seva se hi sachchi taraqqui milti hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab hum doosron ko aage badhne mein madad karte hain, tab hum khud bhi aage badhte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
इष्टान्भोगान्हि वो देवा दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः ।
तैर्दत्तानप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ishtan Bhogan Hi Vo Deva Dasyante Yajnabhavitah,
Tairdattanapradayaibhyo Yo Bhunte Stena Eva Sah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jab tum seva aur yajna ke bhaav se jeete ho, tab jeevan ki zaruri cheezein khud-ba-khud milti hain.

Lekin jo bina kuch diye sirf bhog karta hai, woh ek tarah ki chhota soch mein jeeta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna bata rahe hain ki jo kuch bhi humein milta hai — rishte, sukh, ya suvidhaayen — usme doosron ka bhi yogdan hota hai.

Isliye sirf lena sahi nahi, wapas dena bhi zaroori hai.

Jab hum apni praptiyon ko baantte hain, tab jeevan sach mein shuddh aur sukoon bhara hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo mila hai usme se kuch wapas dena — yahi sachche insaan ki pehchaan hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ।
भुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yajnashishtashinah Santo Muchyante Sarvakilbishaih,
Bhunjate Te Tvagham Papa Ye Pacantyatmakaranat.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jo log seva aur yajna ke baad jo bacha hai use santosh se grahan karte hain, ve shuddh hote hain.

Lekin jo sirf apne liye sab kuch karte hain, ve andar se hi ulajh jaate hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ka sandesh saaf hai — pehle seva, pehle doosre, aur jo bache use santosh se lo.

Sirf apne liye sab kuch rakhna ek aisi soch hai jo insaan ko andar se khokha kar deti hai.

Dena aur baantna hi jeevan ko saf aur halka banata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Santosh aur seva mein jeene se jeevan ki gandagi khud saaf ho jaati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः ।
यज्ञाद्भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Annad Bhavanti Bhutani Parjanyad Annasambhavah,
Yajnad Bhavati Parjanyo Yajnah Karma Samudbhavah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jeev anaj se zinda rehte hain, anaj baarish se milta hai, baarish sahi karm aur yajna se aati hai — sab ek doosre se jude hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna jeevan ke ek bade chakra ko samjhaa rahe hain — prakriti, karm aur jeevan sab ek doosre se bane hain.

Jab hum apna kaam sahi niyat aur mehnat se karte hain, tab prakriti bhi saath deti hai.

Koi bhi cheez alag aur akeli nahi hai — sab ek doosre se judi hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan ka har hissa ek doosre se juda hai — sahi kaam karo, to poora chakra theek chalta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम् ।
तस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Karma Brahmodbhavam Viddhi Brahmakshara Samudbhavam,
Tasmat Sarvagatam Brahma Nityam Yajne Pratishthitam.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Karm ka asal mool ek gehra aur sachcha niyam hai, aur woh niyam sada sahi karm aur seva se hi juda rehta hai.

Isliye sachcha karm hi sachche gyan ki neev hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna bata rahe hain ki karm ka gyaan bhi ek badi aur gehri sachcaai se aata hai.

Jeevan ka sahi tarika yahi hai — seva, santulan aur sahi niyam ko samajhkar kaam karo.

Yahi niyam poori srishti ko chalaata hai aur insaan ko sahi raah dikhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeevan ke niyam ko samajhkar kiya gaya karm hi hamesha safal hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः ।
अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Evam Pravartitam Chakram Nanuvartayatiha Yah,
Aghayurindriyaramo Mogham Partha Sa Jivati.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo vyakti is jeevan ke chakra ko nahi samajhta aur sirf apni khwaishon mein duba rehta hai, uska jeevan bekaar chala jaata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna kehte hain ki jeevan sirf apni khwaishein poori karne ka naam nahi hai.

Jo insaan kartavya, seva aur sahyog se munh fera leta hai, woh jeevan ka asli maqsad kho deta hai.

Aisa jeevan bahar se bhara dikhta hai par andar se bilkul khali hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sirf apni khwaishon ke peeche bhaagna jeevan ko andar se khali kar deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यादात्मतृप्तश्च मानवः ।
आत्मन्येव च सन्तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yastu Atmaratireva Syad Atmatriptashcha Manavah,
Atmanyeva Cha Santushtastasya Karyam Na Vidyate.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jo insaan apne andar ki shanti aur santosh mein jeeta hai, uske liye bahar ki duniya ki koi badi chinta nahi rehti.

Woh khud mein hi poora hota hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna bata rahe hain ki sachcha sukoon bahari cheezon mein nahi, andar se aata hai.

Jis insaan ko apne bheetar hi sukoon milta hai, woh na zyada bhaagta hai aur na bekar ulajhta hai.

Woh sach mein sthir aur shaant rehta hai — aur yahi sabse bada dhan hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab santosh andar ho, tab bahar ki koi bhi cheez tujhe bechain nahi kar sakti.

verses.sanskrit:
नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन ।
न चास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्चिदर्थव्यपाश्रयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Naiva Tasya Kritenartho Nakriteneha Kashchana,
Na Chasya Sarvabhuteshu Kashchidarthavyapashrayah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Aisi gyani vyakti ko na kiye hue kaam se koi fayda hota hai aur na na-kiye hue kaam se koi nuksan.

Voh kisi bhi cheez ya praaṇi par aasrit nahi rehta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna samjha rahe hain ki jo vyakti andar se poora ho jaata hai, use na safalta ka ghamand hota hai aur na nasfali ka dukh.

Voh na kisi cheez ka sahara dhundhta hai aur na kisi se kuch maangta hai.

Yeh shlok dikhata hai ki sachchi aazaadi bahar se nahi, andar se aati hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab insaan andar se poora ho jaata hai, tab use bahar ki kissi bhi cheez ki zaroorat nahi padti.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर ।
असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tasmadasaktah Satatam Karyam Karma Samachara,
Asakto Hyacharan Karma Paramapnoti Purushah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Isliye bina kisi lagav ke hamesha apna kartavya nibhaao.

Jo vyakti bina aasakti ke karm karta hai, wahi sacche param tatva ko paata hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna keh rahe hain ki kaam karna zaroori hai, lekin uske natije se chipakna nahi hai.

Kam poori lagan aur imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mann mein mat rakho.

Jab hum natije ki chinta chhodte hain, tab kaam aur bhi shuddh aur achha ho jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kaam poori imaandari se karo, lekin natija kya aayega — yeh sochna chhhod do.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिमास्थिता जनकादयः ।
लोकसंग्रहमेवापि सम्पश्यन्कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Karmanaiva Hi Samsiddhimasthita Janakadayah,
Lokasangrahamevapi Sampashyan Kartumarhasi.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Raja Janak jaise bade gyani log bhi sirf karm ke zariye hi unch mukaam tak pahunche.

Isliye tum bhi duniya ki bhalaai ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue karm karo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek badi misaal dete hain ki Raja Janak — jo ek poorn gyani the — unhone bhi karm nahi chhhoda.

Sirf gyan ya sochne se kuch nahi banta, kaam karna padta hai.

Yeh shlok yeh sikhata hai ki duniya ka bhala sochkar kiya gaya karm hi sabse bada karm hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sirf sochne se kuch nahi badalega — uthho aur woh karo jo doosron ke kaam aaye.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः ।
स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yadyadacharati Shreshthastattadevetaro Janah,
Sa Yatpramanam Kurute Lokastadanuvartate.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Jo bade aur achhe log karte hain, aam log wohi dekhkar wahi karte hain.

Voh jo bhi misaal pesh karte hain, duniya usi ke peeche chalti hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna samjha rahe hain ki bade logon ka asar bahut gehara hota hai.

Unka har kaam, har baat — log dhyaan se dekhte hain aur usi ko apni zindagi mein utaarne ki koshish karte hain.

Isliye jo bhi aage ho, uski zimmedari hoti hai ki woh sahi raah dikhaye.
verses.lifeLesson: Tumhara apna aacharan hi sabse badi seekh hai jo tum doosron ko de sakte ho.

verses.sanskrit:
न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किञ्चन ।
नानवाप्तमवाप्तव्यं वर्त एव च कर्मणि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Me Parthasti Kartavyam Trishu Lokeshu Kinchana,
Nanavaptamavaptavyam Varta Eva Cha Karmani.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Mujhe teeno lokon mein na kuch paana baaki hai aur na kuch karne ki zaroorat hai, phir bhi main karm karta rehta hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna khud apni misaal dete hain ki unhein kuch bhi nahi chahiye — phir bhi woh karm karte hain.

Kyunki agar woh kaam band kar den, toh duniya ka santulan bigad jaaye.

Yeh shlok sikhata hai ki nishkaam karm — bina swarth ke kaam — sabse ooncha karm hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab koi bina kisi swarth ke kaam karta hai, tab woh kaam sabse zyada prabhavshali hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः ।
मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Yadi Hyaham Na Varteyam Jatu Karmanyatandritah,
Mama Vartmanuvartante Manushyah Partha Sarvashah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Agar main bhi apne kaam mein dheela pad jaata, toh log mere hi raaste par chalte aur wahi seekhte jo main karta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna bata rahe hain ki unka khud ka vyavhar poori duniya ke liye ek namoona hai.

Agar woh sust ya laparwah ho jaayein, toh log usi ko sahi maankar usi raaste par chal padenge.

Yeh shlok yeh batata hai ki jo log aage hote hain, unki har harkhat ka asar bahut door tak jaata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo log aage hote hain, unhe hamesha hoshiyaar rehna chahiye — kyunki duniya unko dekhkar seekhti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेदहम् ।
सङ्करस्य च कर्ता स्यामुपहन्यामिमाः प्रजाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Utsideyurime Loka Na Kuryam Karma Cedaham,
Sankarasya Cha Karta Syamupahanyamimah Prajah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Agar main karm na karun, toh yeh sab lok bigad jaayenge aur main iss abhed ki wajah se praja ka naash karne waala ban jaaunga.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna samjha rahe hain ki ek sahi vyakti ka kaam band karna sirf usi ko nahi, poori duniya ko prabhavit karta hai.

Jab achhe log kaam karna chhhod dete hain, toh burai ka raasta khul jaata hai.

Isliye achhe log chahe thak jaayein, par apna dharm nahi chhhod sakte.
verses.lifeLesson: Tumhara ek sahi kaam kitne logon ki zindagi ko sambhal sakta hai — yeh mat bhuloo.

verses.sanskrit:
सक्ताः कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत ।
कुर्याद्विद्वांस्तथासक्तश्चिकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Saktah Karmanyavidvamso Yatha Kurvanti Bharata,
Kuryad Vidvamstatha Asaktashchikirshurlokasangraham.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise anjaane log lagav ke saath kaam karte hain, waise hi gyani vyakti ko bhi bina lagav ke duniya ki bhalaai ke liye kaam karna chahiye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek sundar taulna karte hain — jo log nahi jaante woh bhi mehnat se kaam karte hain, toh jo jaante hain unhe toh aur bhi karna chahiye.

Farak bas itna hai — gyani ka kaam swarth ke liye nahi, seva ke liye hota hai.

Aisa kaam doosron ke liye bhi raah dikhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Gyaani wahi hai jo jaan-bujhkar, bina kisi swarth ke, doosron ke kaam aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम् ।
जोषयेत्सर्वकर्माणि विद्वान्युक्तः समाचरन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Na Buddhibhedam Janayedajnanam Karmasanginam,
Joshayetsarvakarmani Vidvanyuktah Samacharan.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Gyani vyakti ko unhe bhatkaana nahi chahiye jo abhi kaam mein lage hue hain aur poora sach nahi jaante.

Balki khud sahi tarike se kaam karte hue unhe bhi achhi raah dikhani chahiye.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna keh rahe hain ki gyan ka upyog logon ko uljhane mein nahi, unhe sambhaalne mein hona chahiye.

Jo gyani hai, woh khud sahi kaam kare aur apne aacharan se doosron ko bhi seekhne ka mauka de.

Baaton se zyada, apna kaam hi sabse bada sandesh hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sachcha gyaani woh hai jo doosron ko uljhaata nahi — balki apne kaam se unhe sahi raah dikhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृतेः क्रियमाणानि गुणैः कर्माणि सर्वशः ।
अहङ्कारविमूढात्मा कर्ताहमिति मन्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Prakriteḥ Kriyamanani Gunaih Karmani Sarvashah,
Ahankara Vimudhatma Kartahamiti Manyate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Saare kaam prakriti ke teeno gunon dwara hote hain, par ahankar mein duba vyakti yeh sochta hai ki yeh sab main kar raha hoon.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna bata rahe hain ki jo kuch bhi is duniya mein hota hai, woh prakriti ke niyamon ke anusar hota hai.

Lekin jab insaan ke andar ahankar aa jaata hai, toh woh khud ko hi sab kuch karne waala samajhne lagta hai.

Yeh soch ek bada bhram hai — aur isi bhram se dukh paida hota hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo khud ko hi sab kuch samajhne lagta hai, woh sabse badi galti mein phansa hota hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्त्ववित्तु महाबाहो गुणकर्मविभागयोः ।
गुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न सज्जते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tattvavittu Mahabaho Gunakarmavibhagayoh,
Guna Guneshu Vartanta Iti Matva Na Sajjate.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Par jo sachcha gyaani hai, woh yeh jaanta hai ki prakriti ke gun hi apas mein kaam kar rahe hain — isliye woh kaam mein phasta nahi.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna samjha rahe hain ki jo insaan sachche gyan ko paata hai, woh jaanta hai ki sab kuch prakriti ka khel hai.

Woh kaam karta hai, par use apna nahi maanta — isliye na ghamand aata hai aur na dukh.

Yeh gyaan hi ek insaan ko andar se azaad karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo samajh leta hai ki sab prakriti ki den hai, woh na ahankar mein bhatkata hai aur na dukh mein doobta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृतेर्गुणसम्मूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु ।
तानकृत्स्नविदो मन्दान्कृत्स्नविन्न विचालयेत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Prakriterguna Sammudhaḥ Sajjante Gunakarmasu,
Tan Akritsnavido Mandan Kritsnavinna Vicalayet.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Prakriti ke gunon ke prabhav mein aaye hue log kaam aur uske natije mein hi phanse rehte hain.

Jo poora sach jaanta hai, woh aisi samajh na rakhne wale logon ko aur zyada uljhan mein nahi daale.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna samjha rahe hain ki kuch log abhi tak prakriti ke prabhav mein hain — woh abhi poora sach nahi dekh paate.

Aise logon ko ekdum se gehra sach samjhana unhe aur bhatak sakta hai.

Isliye gyani vyakti unhe dheere-dheere, pyaar aur sabr ke saath sahi raah dikhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har kisi ki samajh alag hoti hai — kisi ko sach samjhana ho toh sabr aur naram andaz se samjhao, jolte hue nahi.

verses.sanskrit:
मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा ।
निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Mayi Sarvani Karmani Sannyasyadhyatma Chetasa,
Nirashir Nirmamo Bhutva Yudhyasva Vigata Jvarah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Apne saare kaam mujhe arpan karke, bina kisi umeed aur mamta ke, aur man ki chinta hatakar apna kartavya nibhao.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna keh rahe hain ki kaam karo, lekin uska bojh apne oopar mat lo.

Jab hum kisi nateeje ki umeed ya apnapan chhodte hain, tab kaam karna bahut aasaan aur halka ho jaata hai.

Yeh shlok yeh sikhata hai ki kaam ka bojh nahi, kaam ka bhaav hi insaan ko thakhaata ya sukoon deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Kaam poori mehnat se karo, lekin uska natija apne haath mein nahi — yeh maan lene se man hamesha shaant rehta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः ।
श्रद्धावन्तोऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि कर्मभिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ye Me Matam Idam Nityam Anutishthanti Manavah,
Shraddhavanto Anasuyanto Muchyante Te Api Karmabhih.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo log shraddha ke saath aur kisi shikayat ke bhaav ke bina mere is updesh ko apni zindagi mein utaarte hain, ve karm ke bandhan se azaad ho jaate hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna bata rahe hain ki sirf sunna ya jaanna kaafi nahi hota — jeevan mein utaarna padta hai.

Jo insaan sachche mann se seekh ko apnaata hai aur bina kisi giley-shikve ke chalte rehta hai, woh dheere-dheere sab bandhanon se mukt ho jaata hai.

Shraddha aur sahi aacharan milkar insaan ki zindagi badal dete hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo jaana hai use jeena bhi padega — sirf padhe-likhe rehne se zindagi nahi badalti, amal se badalti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ये त्वेतदभ्यसूयन्तो नानुतिष्ठन्ति मे मतम् ।
सर्वज्ञानविमूढांस्तान्विद्धि नष्टानचेतसः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Ye Tvetad Abhyasuyanto Nanutishthanti Me Matam,
Sarvajnana Vimudham Staan Viddhi Nashtaan Acetasah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo log is sachche updesh mein bhi galtiyan dhundhhte hain aur ise nahi maante, samajh lo ki woh khud ko hi andhere mein rakh rahe hain aur apna hi nuksan kar rahe hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna spasht keh rahe hain ki sach ko jaankar bhi inkaar karna sabse badi bewaqoofi hai.

Aisa insaan na badhta hai, na seekhta hai — woh sirf apni hi soch ke pinjare mein band rehta hai.

Sach ko swikaarna hi sudhaar ki pehli aur sabse zaroori seedhi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jo sach dikhne ke baad bhi aankhein band kar le, woh apna hi raasta rok leta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवानपि ।
प्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sadrisham Ceshtate Svasyah Prakriter Jnanavaan Api,
Prakritim Yanti Bhutani Nigrahah Kim Karishyati.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Bada se bada gyaani bhi apne swabhaav ke anusar hi kaam karta hai. Har jeev apni fitrat ke hisaab se chalta hai — toh sirf zabardasti se koi nahi badal sakta.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek gehri baat keh rahe hain ki har insaan ki apni ek fitrat hoti hai — ek alag andaaz, alag soch.

Yeh fitrat andar se hoti hai, bahar se thopi nahi ja sakti.

Isliye asli badlaav tab aata hai jab insaan andar se samjhe aur khud badalna chahe — bahari dabaav se nahi.
verses.lifeLesson: Kisi ko zabardasti badalne ki koshish mat karo — asli badlaav hamesha andar se aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियस्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ ।
तयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
Indriyasye Ndriyasyarthe Raga Dveshau Vyavasthitau,
Tayor Na Vasham Agacchet Tau Hyasya Paripanthinau.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Har cheez ke prati mann mein raag aur dvesh — yaani pasand aur nafrat — hote hain. Lekin in dono ke kaaboo mein nahi aana chahiye, kyunki yahi dono insaan ke sabse bade dushman hain.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna bata rahe hain ki kisi cheez se bahut zyaada lagav ya bahut zyaada nafrat — dono hi mann ka santulan bigaad dete hain.

Jab hum kisi cheez ke deewaane hote hain, toh darr hota hai use khoone ka. Aur jab nafrat hoti hai, toh chain nahi milta.

Dono hi haalaton mein insaan khud hi pareshaan rehta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Na kisi cheez ka itna deewana bano ki khoone ka darr ho, aur na itni nafrat ki chain hi chali jaaye — santulan hi sachchi azaadi hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् ।
स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shreyan Svadharmo Vigunah Paradharmaat Svanushtitat,
Svadharme Nidhanam Shreyah Paradharmo Bhayavahah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Apna kartavya thoda kamzor ho tab bhi behtar hai doosre ka raasta achhe se apnaane se.

Apni bhoomika mein jaan de dena bhi izzat ki baat hai, lekin doosre ka raasta apnaana khud ke liye khatra hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek bahut gehri baat keh rahe hain — doosron ki zindagi dekh kar apni zindagi mat jeeo.

Har insaan ki apni ek alag jagah, alag zimmedari aur alag raasta hota hai.

Jo apni asli zimmedari ko sachche mann se nibhaata hai — chahe woh chhhoti hi kyun na ho — woh insaan hamesha chain aur izzat ke saath jeeta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Doosron ki chamak dekh kar apna raasta mat chhhodo — jo tumhara apna hai, usi mein tumhari asli taaqat chhuppi hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः ।
अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Arjuna Uvacha:
Atha Kena Prayukto Ayam Papam Carati Purushah,
Anicchan Api Varshneya Balad Iva Niyojitah.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Arjun ne poocha:

Hey Krishna! Akhir woh kya cheez hai jo insaan ko galat kaam karne par majboor kar deti hai, jabki woh khud nahi chahta — jaise koi jabarzan karaata ho?
verses.simpleExplanation:
Arjun ek bahut zaroori sawaal poochhte hain jo har insaan ke mann mein kabhi na kabhi zaroor aata hai.

Hum jaante hain ki kuch kaam galat hain — phir bhi ho jaate hain. Kyon?

Yeh sawaal hi is poori baat ki neev hai. Aur ab Krishna iska jawab denge jo insaan ko hamesha ke liye sochne par majboor kar deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Galti ko pehchaanna hi usse sudharne ki shuruwaat hai — sawaal poochhne ki himmat rakhna bhi ek taaqat hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
काम एष क्रोध एष रजोगुणसमुद्भवः ।
महाशनो महापाप्मा विद्ध्येनमिह वैरिणम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Shri Bhagavan Uvacha:
Kaama Esha Krodha Esha Rajogunasamudbhavah,
Mahasano Mahapapma Viddhyenam Iha Vairinaam.
verses.hinglishMeaning:
Shri Krishna ne kaha:

Yeh kaama — yaani laalaach aur tarishna — aur yeh krodh, yahi hain woh bade dushman jo insaan ko galat raaste par le jaate hain. Inhe hi apna sabse bada shatru samjho.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna Arjun ke sawaal ka seedha aur saaf jawab dete hain — insaan ka sabse bada dushman bahar nahi, andar hai.

Kaama yaani kisi cheez ki itni zyaada chahat ki mann us par hi atak jaaye. Aur jab yeh chahat poori na ho, toh krodh paida hota hai.

Yeh dono milkar insaan ki soch, uski samajh aur uska sukoon — sab kuch chheen lete hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Bahar ka koi dushman utna nuksaan nahi pahunchata jitna andar ki laalaach aur gussa pahunchata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथादर्शो मलेन च ।
यथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Dhumena Avriyate Vahni Ryatha Adarso Malena Ca,
Yatholbena Avrito Garbhas Tatha Tene Dam Avritam.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise dhuaan aag ko dhak leta hai, jaise dhool sheeshe ko dhundla kar deti hai, aur jaise jhilli garbh ko chhupa leti hai — usi tarah kaama insaan ke gyaan ko dhak leta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ek bahut sundar misaal dete hain — kaama yaani andhee chahat ek pardey ki tarah kaam karti hai.

Jis tarah dhuaan hote hue bhi aag toh hoti hai par dikhti nahi, usi tarah gyaan hote hue bhi kaama ki wajah se insaan sahi faisla nahi kar paata.

Kaama gyaan ko khatam nahi karta — bas dhak deta hai. Aur jab yeh parda hata, tab insaan phir se saf soch sakta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Andhee chahat teri aankhon pe parda daal deti hai — jo sach dikhna chahiye woh nahi dikhta, aur galat sahi laghne lagta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा ।
कामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च ॥
verses.transliteration:
Avritam Jnanam Etena Jnanino Nitya Vairinam,
Kaamarupena Kaunteya Dushpurena Analena Ca.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun! Yeh kaama — jo kabhi bhi poora nahi hota, jaise aag jisme jitna daalo utna aur maangti hai — yahi gyaan ke insaan ka bhi hamesha ka dushman hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna kaama ki ek aur gehri haqeeqat bata rahe hain — yeh kabhi poora nahi hota.

Ek cheez milti hai toh doosri ki chahat hoti hai, woh milti hai toh teesri ki — yeh silsila kabhi khatam nahi hota.

Aur jab tak yeh laalaach hai, tab tak sachcha sukoon aur sachchi samajh dono door rehte hain.
verses.lifeLesson: Chahat ka koi ant nahi hota — ek poori hogi toh doosri uthegi. Asli sukoon chahat kam karne mein hai, aur zyaada paane mein nahi.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिरस्याधिष्ठानमुच्यते ।
एतैर्विमोहयत्येष ज्ञानमावृत्य देहिनम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Indriyani Mano Buddhir Asyaadhi Shthanam Ucyate,
Etair Vimohayaty Esha Jnanam Avritya Dehinam.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Indriyaan, mann aur buddhi — yeh teen jagah hain jahan kaama apna ghar banaa leta hai. Aur inhi ke zariye woh insaan ke gyaan ko dhak kar use bhatka deta hai.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna bata rahe hain ki kaama sirf ek jagah nahi rehta — woh teen jagah baith jaata hai.

Pehle indriyaan — aankhein, kaan, naak jo baahar ki cheezon ki taraf khinchti hain. Phir mann — jo unke baare mein sochta rehta hai. Aur phir buddhi — jo sahi-galat ka faisla karti hai, woh bhi kaama se prabhavit ho jaati hai.

Jab teeno hi kaaboo mein aa jaayein, tab insaan ke paas sahi sochne ki shakti hi nahi bachti.
verses.lifeLesson: Jab andar ka shor bahut zyaada ho jaata hai, tab sachchi awaz sunna mushkil ho jaata hai — man ko shaant rakhna hi sabse badi taaqat hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्त्वमिन्द्रियाण्यादौ नियम्य भरतर्षभ ।
पाप्मानं प्रजहि ह्येनं ज्ञानविज्ञाननाशनम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tasmat Tvam Indriyany Adau Niyamya Bharatarshabha,
Papmanam Prajahi Hyenam Jnana Vijnana Nashanam.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isliye hey Arjun! Pehle apni indriyaan kaaboo karo, aur phir is kaama ko — jo gyaan aur vivek dono ko khatam kar deta hai — apne andar se door karo.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna ab seedha raasta dikh rahe hain — pehle indriyaan sambhaalo, phir baaki sab theek hoga.

Jab aankhein, kaan aur mann baahar ki cheezon mein bahut zyaada kho jaate hain, tab andar ki sach sunne ki taaqat khatam ho jaati hai.

Isliye pehla qadam yeh hai ki apni indriyaan kaaboo karo — phir kaama apne aap kamzor padne lagta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Jeet ki shuruwaat andar se hoti hai — pehle apni khwaishon ko kaaboo karo, phir duniya apne aap sambhal jaayegi.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः ।
मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
Indriyani Paranyahur Indriyebhyah Param Manah,
Manasas Tu Para Buddhir Yo Buddheh Paratas Tu Sah.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shareera se oopar indriyaan hain, indriyaan se oopar mann hai, mann se oopar buddhi hai, aur buddhi se bhi oopar jo hai — woh hai aatma.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna insaan ke andar ki ek seedhi bana rahe hain — neeche se oopar ki taraf.

Sabse baahri hain indriyaan jo duniya ko mehsoos karti hain. Unse oopar mann hai jo sochta rehta hai. Mann se oopar buddhi hai jo sahi-galat sochti hai. Aur buddhi se bhi oopar aatma hai — jo shuddh, shaant aur hamesha se hai.

Jab insaan aatma ko jaanta hai, tab woh indriyaan ya mann ka gulaam nahi rehta.
verses.lifeLesson: Tu sirf apna sharir ya apna mann nahi hai — tu isse bhi kaafi zyaada hai. Jis din yeh samajh aaya, usi din sachchi azaadi mili.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना ।
जहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
Evam Buddheh Param Buddhva Samstabhyat Maanam Atmana,
Jahi Shatrum Mahabaho Kamarupam Durasadam.
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isi tarah buddhi se bhi oopar ki sach ko jaankar, apni aatma ki shakti se apne mann ko thaame raho, aur is kathin shatru — kaama — ko apne andar se harao.
verses.simpleExplanation:
Shri Krishna is poore adhyaay ka saar ek baar mein dete hain.

Jab insaan apni asli pehchaan — aatma — ko samajh leta hai, tab woh mann aur indriyaan se oopar uth jaata hai.

Aur jab woh oopar uth jaata hai, tab kaama — chahat, laalaach, gussa — sab apne aap kamzor pad jaate hain.

Yeh ladaai bahar ki nahi, bilkul andar ki hai — aur isi mein asli jeet chhuppi hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Zindagi ki sabse badi jang bahar nahi, andar hoti hai — apni chahat aur gusse ko jeeto, aur phir koi bhi taaqat tujhe nahi hila sakti.

summary: The fourth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Jnana Karma Sanyasa Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna glorifies the Karma Yoga and imparts the Transcendental Knowledge (the knowledge of the soul and the Ultimate Truth) to Arjuna. He reveals the reason behind his appearance in this material world. He reveals that even though he is eternal, he reincarnates time after time to re-establish dharma and peace on this Earth. His births and activities are eternal and are never contaminated by material flaws. Those persons who know and understand this Truth engage in his devotion with full faith and eventually attain Him. They do not have to take birth in this world again.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम् ।
विवस्वान्मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
imaṃ vivasvate yogaṃ proktavānahamavyayam.
vivasvānmanave prāha manurikṣvākave.abravīt
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa --- mainne isa avinaashee yoga ko vivasvaan (soorya devataa) se kahaa (sikhaayaa); vivasvaan ne manu se kahaa; manu ne ikshvaaku se kahaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa --- mainne isa avinaashee yoga ko vivasvaan (soorya devataa) se kahaa (sikhaayaa); vivasvaan ne manu se kahaa; manu ne ikshvaaku se kahaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः ।
स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप ॥
verses.transliteration:
evaṃ paramparāprāptamimaṃ rājarṣayo viduḥ.
sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣṭaḥ parantapa
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isa prakaara paramparaa se praapta huye isa yoga ko raajarshiyon ne jaanaa, (parantu) hey parantapa ! vaha yoga bahuta kaala (ke antaraala) se yahaan (isa loka men) nashtapraaya ho gayaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Isa prakaara paramparaa se praapta huye isa yoga ko raajarshiyon ne jaanaa, (parantu) hey parantapa ! vaha yoga bahuta kaala (ke antaraala) se yahaan (isa loka men) nashtapraaya ho gayaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः ।
भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa evāyaṃ mayā te.adya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ.
bhakto.asi me sakhā ceti rahasyaṃ hyetaduttamam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vaha hee yaha puraatana yoga aaja mainne tumhen kahaa (sikhaayaa) kyonki tuma mere bhakta aura mitra ho. yaha uttama rahasya hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Vaha hee yaha puraatana yoga aaja mainne tumhen kahaa (sikhaayaa) kyonki tuma mere bhakta aura mitra ho. yaha uttama rahasya hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः ।
कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति ॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca.
aparaṃ bhavato janma paraṃ janma vivasvataḥ.
kathametadvijānīyāṃ tvamādau proktavāniti
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kahaa -- aapakaa janma apara arthaat pashchaata kaa hai aura vivasvaan kaa janma (aapake) poorva kaa hai, isaliye yaha main kaise jaanoon ki (srishti ke) aadi men aapane (isa yoga ko) kahaa thaa?
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Arjun ne kahaa -- aapakaa janma apara arthaat pashchaata kaa hai aura vivasvaan kaa janma (aapake) poorva kaa hai, isaliye yaha main kaise jaanoon ki (srishti ke) aadi men aapane (isa yoga ko) kahaa thaa?. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन ।
तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava cārjuna.
tānyahaṃ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṃ vettha parantapa
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- hey Arjun ! mere aura tumhaare bahuta se janma ho chuke hain, (parantu) hey parantapa ! una sabako main jaanataa hoon aura tuma naheen jaanate
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- hey Arjun ! mere aura tumhaare bahuta se janma ho chuke hain, (parantu) hey parantapa ! una sabako main jaanataa hoon aura tuma naheen jaanate. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन् ।
प्रकृतिं स्वामधिष्ठाय सम्भवाम्यात्ममायया ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajo.api sannavyayātmā bhūtānāmīśvaro.api san.
prakṛtiṃ svāmadhiṣṭhāya sambhavāmyātmamāyayā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yadyapi main ajanmaa aura avinaashee svaroopa hoon aura bhootamaatra kaa eeshvara hoon (tathaapi) apanee prakriti ko apane adheena rakhakara (adhishthaaya) main apanee maayaa se janma letaa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Yadyapi main ajanmaa aura avinaashee svaroopa hoon aura bhootamaatra kaa eeshvara hoon (tathaapi) apanee prakriti ko apane adheena rakhakara (adhishthaaya) main apanee maayaa se janma letaa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत ।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata.
abhyutthānamadharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmyaham
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bhaarata ! jaba-jaba dharma kee haani aura adharma kee vriddhi hotee hai, taba-taba main svayan ko prakata karataa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey bhaarata ! jaba-jaba dharma kee haani aura adharma kee vriddhi hotee hai, taba-taba main svayan ko prakata karataa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम् ।
धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे ॥
verses.transliteration:
paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṃ vināśāya ca duṣkṛtām.
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge
verses.hinglishMeaning: Saadhu purushon ke rakshana, dushkritya karane vaalon ke naasha, tathaa dharma sansthaapanaa ke liye, main pratyeka yuga men pragata hotaa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Saadhu purushon ke rakshana, dushkritya karane vaalon ke naasha, tathaa dharma sansthaapanaa ke liye, main pratyeka yuga men pragata hotaa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Dharma ka sahara lekar kathin faisle bhi shuddh bhav se liye ja sakte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ।
त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन ॥
verses.transliteration:
janma karma ca me divyamevaṃ yo vetti tattvataḥ.
tyaktvā dehaṃ punarjanma naiti māmeti so.arjuna
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun ! meraa janma aura karma divya hai, isa prakaara jo purusha tattvata: jaanataa hai, vaha shareera ko tyaagakara phira janma ko naheen praapta hotaa; vaha mujhey hee praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey Arjun ! meraa janma aura karma divya hai, isa prakaara jo purusha tattvata: jaanataa hai, vaha shareera ko tyaagakara phira janma ko naheen praapta hotaa; vaha mujhey hee praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः ।
बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
vītarāgabhayakrodhā manmayā māmupāśritāḥ.
bahavo jñānatapasā pūtā madbhāvamāgatāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Raaga bhaya aura krodha se rahita manamaya mere sharana hue bahuta se purusha jnyaana rupa tapa se pavitra‌ hue mere svarupa ko praapta hue hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Raaga bhaya aura krodha se rahita manamaya mere sharana hue bahuta se purusha jnyaana rupa tapa se pavitra‌ hue mere svarupa ko praapta hue hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम् ।
मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham.
mama vartmānuvartante manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo mujhey jaise bhajate hain, main una para vaise hee anugraha karataa hoon; hey paartha sabhee manushya saba prakaara se, mere hee maarga kaa anuvartana karate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo mujhey jaise bhajate hain, main una para vaise hee anugraha karataa hoon; hey paartha sabhee manushya saba prakaara se, mere hee maarga kaa anuvartana karate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः ।
क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा ॥
verses.transliteration:
kāṅkṣantaḥ karmaṇāṃ siddhiṃ yajanta iha devatāḥ.
kṣipraṃ hi mānuṣe loke siddhirbhavati karmajā
verses.hinglishMeaning: (saamaanya manushya) yahaan (isa loka men) karmon ke phala ko chaahate huye devataaon ko poojate hain; kyonki manushya loka men karmon ke phala sheeghra hee praapta hote hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: (saamaanya manushya) yahaan (isa loka men) karmon ke phala ko chaahate huye devataaon ko poojate hain; kyonki manushya loka men karmon ke phala sheeghra hee praapta hote hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः ।
तस्य कर्तारमपि मां विद्ध्यकर्तारमव्ययम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
cāturvarṇyaṃ mayā sṛṣṭaṃ guṇakarmavibhāgaśaḥ.
tasya kartāramapi māṃ viddhyakartāramavyayam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Guna aura karmon ke vibhaaga se chaaturvanya mere dvaaraa rachaa gayaa hai. yadyapi main usakaa kartaa hoon, tathaapi tuma mujhey akartaa aura avinaashee jaano
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Guna aura karmon ke vibhaaga se chaaturvanya mere dvaaraa rachaa gayaa hai. yadyapi main usakaa kartaa hoon, tathaapi tuma mujhey akartaa aura avinaashee jaano. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा ।
इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
na māṃ karmāṇi limpanti na me karmaphale spṛhā.
iti māṃ yo.abhijānāti karmabhirna sa badhyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Karma mujhey lipta naheen karate; na mujhey karmaphala men sprihaa hai. isa prakaara mujhey jo jaanataa hai, vaha bhee karmon se naheen bandhataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Karma mujhey lipta naheen karate; na mujhey karmaphala men sprihaa hai. isa prakaara mujhey jo jaanataa hai, vaha bhee karmon se naheen bandhataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः ।
कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
evaṃ jñātvā kṛtaṃ karma pūrvairapi mumukṣubhiḥ.
kuru karmaiva tasmāttvaṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṃ kṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Poorva ke mumuksha purushon dvaaraa bhee isa prakaara jaanakara hee karma kiyaa gayaa hai; isaliye tuma bhee poorvajon dvaaraa sadaa se kiye hue karmon ko hee karo
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Poorva ke mumuksha purushon dvaaraa bhee isa prakaara jaanakara hee karma kiyaa gayaa hai; isaliye tuma bhee poorvajon dvaaraa sadaa se kiye hue karmon ko hee karo. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
किं कर्म किमकर्मेति कवयोऽप्यत्र मोहिताः ।
तत्ते कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kiṃ karma kimakarmeti kavayo.apyatra mohitāḥ.
tatte karma pravakṣyāmi yajjñātvā mokṣyase.aśubhāt
verses.hinglishMeaning: Karma kyaa hai aura akarma kyaa hai? isa vishaya men buddhimaana purusha bhee bhramita ho jaate hain. isaliye main tumhen karma kahoongaa, (arthaat karma aura akarma kaa svaroopa samajhaaoongaa) jisako jaanakara tuma ashubha (sansaara bandhana) se mukta ho jaaoge
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Karma kyaa hai aura akarma kyaa hai? isa vishaya men buddhimaana purusha bhee bhramita ho jaate hain. isaliye main tumhen karma kahoongaa, (arthaat karma aura akarma kaa svaroopa samajhaaoongaa) jisako jaanakara tuma ashubha (sansaara bandhana) se mukta ho jaaoge. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः ।
अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṃ boddhavyaṃ ca vikarmaṇaḥ.
akarmaṇaśca boddhavyaṃ gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Karma kaa (svaroopa) jaananaa chaahiye aura vikarma kaa (svaroopa) bhee jaananaa chaahiye ; (boddhavyam) tathaa akarma kaa bhee (svaroopa) jaananaa chaahiye (kyonki) karma kee gati gahana hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Karma kaa (svaroopa) jaananaa chaahiye aura vikarma kaa (svaroopa) bhee jaananaa chaahiye ; (boddhavyam) tathaa akarma kaa bhee (svaroopa) jaananaa chaahiye (kyonki) karma kee gati gahana hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः ।
स बुद्धिमान्मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśyedakarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ.
sa buddhimānmanuṣyeṣu sa yuktaḥ kṛtsnakarmakṛt
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha karma men akarma aura akarma men karma dekhataa hai, vaha manushyon men buddhimaana hai, vaha yogee sampoorna karmon ko karane vaalaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha karma men akarma aura akarma men karma dekhataa hai, vaha manushyon men buddhimaana hai, vaha yogee sampoorna karmon ko karane vaalaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसङ्कल्पवर्जिताः ।
ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasya sarve samārambhāḥ kāmasaṅkalpavarjitāḥ.
jñānāgnidagdhakarmāṇaṃ tamāhuḥ paṇḍitaṃ budhāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jisake samasta kaarya kaamanaa aura sankalpa se rahita hain, aise usa jnyaanaroopa agni ke dvaaraa bhasma huye karmon vaale purusha ko jnyaaneejana pandita kahate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jisake samasta kaarya kaamanaa aura sankalpa se rahita hain, aise usa jnyaanaroopa agni ke dvaaraa bhasma huye karmon vaale purusha ko jnyaaneejana pandita kahate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः ।
कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तोऽपि नैव किञ्चित्करोति सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tyaktvā karmaphalāsaṅgaṃ nityatṛpto nirāśrayaḥ.
karmaṇyabhipravṛtto.api naiva kiñcitkaroti saḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha, karmaphalaasakti ko tyaagakara, nityatripta aura saba aashrayon se rahita hai vaha karma men pravritta hote hue bhee (vaastava men) kuchha bhee naheen karataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha, karmaphalaasakti ko tyaagakara, nityatripta aura saba aashrayon se rahita hai vaha karma men pravritta hote hue bhee (vaastava men) kuchha bhee naheen karataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः ।
शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
nirāśīryatacittātmā tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ.
śārīraṃ kevalaṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo aashaa rahita hai tathaa jisane chitta aura atma (shareera) ko sanyamita kiyaa hai, jisane saba parigrahon kaa tyaaga kiyaa hai, aisaa purusha shaareerika karma karate hue bhee paapa ko naheen praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo aashaa rahita hai tathaa jisane chitta aura atma (shareera) ko sanyamita kiyaa hai, jisane saba parigrahon kaa tyaaga kiyaa hai, aisaa purusha shaareerika karma karate hue bhee paapa ko naheen praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः ।
समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadṛcchālābhasantuṣṭo dvandvātīto vimatsaraḥ.
samaḥ siddhāvasiddhau ca kṛtvāpi na nibadhyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yadrichchhayaa (apane aapa) jo kuchha praapta ho usamen hee santushta rahane vaalaa, dvandvon se ateeta tathaa matsara se rahita, siddhi va asiddhi men samabhaava vaalaa purusha karma karake bhee naheen bandhataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Yadrichchhayaa (apane aapa) jo kuchha praapta ho usamen hee santushta rahane vaalaa, dvandvon se ateeta tathaa matsara se rahita, siddhi va asiddhi men samabhaava vaalaa purusha karma karake bhee naheen bandhataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः ।
यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं प्रविलीयते ॥
verses.transliteration:
gatasaṅgasya muktasya jñānāvasthitacetasaḥ.
yajñāyācarataḥ karma samagraṃ pravilīyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo aasaktirahita aura mukta hai, jisakaa chitta jnyaana men sthita hai, yajnya ke liye aacharana karane vaale aise purusha ke samasta karma leena ho jaate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo aasaktirahita aura mukta hai, jisakaa chitta jnyaana men sthita hai, yajnya ke liye aacharana karane vaale aise purusha ke samasta karma leena ho jaate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 4 ke mool vishay se juda hai: divya gyaan, karm ki shuddhi aur guru-parampara ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्म हविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम् ।
ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmārpaṇaṃ brahma havirbrahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam.
brahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ brahmakarmasamādhinā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arpana (arthaat arpana karane kaa saadhana shruvaa) brahma hai aura havi (shaakalya athavaa havana karane yogya dravya) bhee brahma hai; brahmaroopa agni men brahmaroopa kartaa ke dvaaraa jo havana kiyaa gayaa hai, vaha bhee brahma hee hai. isa prakaara brahmaroopa karma men samaadhistha purusha kaa gantavya bhee brahma hee hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Arpana (arthaat arpana karane kaa saadhana shruvaa) brahma hai aura havi (shaakalya athavaa havana karane yogya dravya) bhee brahma hai; brahmaroopa agni men brahmaroopa kartaa ke dvaaraa jo havana kiyaa gayaa hai, vaha bhee brahma hee hai. isa prakaara brahmaroopa karma men samaadhistha purusha kaa gantavya bhee brahma hee hai. verses.transliteration:

summary: The fifth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Karma Sanyasa Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna compares the paths of renunciation in actions (Karma Sanyas) and actions with detachment (Karma Yoga) and explains that both are means to reach the same goal and we can choose either. A wise person should perform his/her worldly duties without attachment to the fruits of his/her actions and dedicate them to God. This way they remain unaffected by sin and eventually attain liberation.

verses.sanskrit:

verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca.
saṃnyāsaṃ karmaṇāṃ kṛṣṇa punaryogaṃ ca śaṃsasi.
yacchreya etayorekaṃ tanme brūhi suniścitam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kahaa hey -- Krishna ! aapa karmon ke sannyaasa kee aura phira yoga (karma ke aacharana) kee prashansaa karate hain. ina donon men eka jo nishchaya poorvaka shreyaskara hai, usako mere lie kahiye

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
संन्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकरावुभौ ।
तयोस्तु कर्मसंन्यासात्कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
saṃnyāsaḥ karmayogaśca niḥśreyasakarāvubhau.
tayostu karmasaṃnyāsātkarmayogo viśiṣyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- karmasannyaasa aura karmayoga ye donon hee parama kalyaanakaaraka hain; parantu una donon men karmasannyaasa se karmayoga shreshtha hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- karmasannyaasa aura karmayoga ye donon hee parama kalyaanakaaraka hain; parantu una donon men karmasannyaasa se karmayoga shreshtha hai. verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति ।
निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
jñeyaḥ sa nityasaṃnyāsī yo na dveṣṭi na kāṅkṣati.
nirdvandvo hi mahābāho sukhaṃ bandhātpramucyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha na kisee se dvesha karataa hai aura na kisee kee aakaankshaa, vaha sadaa sannyaasee hee samajhane yogya hai; kyonki, hey mahaabaaho ! dvandvon se rahita purusha sahaja hee bandhana mukta ho jaataa hai

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
साङ्ख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः ।
एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sāṅkhyayogau pṛthagbālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ.
ekamapyāsthitaḥ samyagubhayorvindate phalam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Baalaka arthaat baalabuddhi ke loga saankhya (sannyaasa) aura yoga ko paraspara bhinna samajhate hain; kisee eka men bhee samyak prakaara se sthita huaa purusha donon ke phala ko praapta kara letaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Baalaka arthaat baalabuddhi ke loga saankhya (sannyaasa) aura yoga ko paraspara bhinna samajhate hain; kisee eka men bhee samyak prakaara se sthita huaa purusha donon ke phala ko praapta kara letaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्साङ्ख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैरपि गम्यते ।
एकं साङ्ख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatsāṅkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṃ tadyogairapi gamyate.
ekaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo sthaana jnyaaniyon dvaaraa praapta kiyaa jaataa hai, usee sthaana para karmayogee bhee pahunchate hain. isalie jo purusha saankhya aura yoga ko (phalaroopa se) eka hee dekhataa hai, vahee (vaastava men) dekhataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo sthaana jnyaaniyon dvaaraa praapta kiyaa jaataa hai, usee sthaana para karmayogee bhee pahunchate hain. isalie jo purusha saankhya aura yoga ko (phalaroopa se) eka hee dekhataa hai, vahee (vaastava men) dekhataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
