verses.sanskrit:
संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः ।
योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃnyāsastu mahābāho duḥkhamāptumayogataḥ.
yogayukto munirbrahma nacireṇādhigacchati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parantu, hey mahaabaaho ! yoga ke binaa sannyaasa praapta honaa kathina hai; yogayukta mananasheela purusha paramatma ko sheeghra hee praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Parantu, hey mahaabaaho ! yoga ke binaa sannyaasa praapta honaa kathina hai; yogayukta mananasheela purusha paramatma ko sheeghra hee praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः ।
सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yogayukto viśuddhātmā vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ.
sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmā kurvannapi na lipyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha yogayukta, vishuddha antakarana vaalaa, shareera ko vasha men kiye hue, jitendriya tathaa bhootamaatra men sthita atma ke saatha ekatva anubhava kiye hue hai vaha karma karate hue bhee unase lipta naheen hotaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha yogayukta, vishuddha antakarana vaalaa, shareera ko vasha men kiye hue, jitendriya tathaa bhootamaatra men sthita atma ke saatha ekatva anubhava kiye hue hai vaha karma karate hue bhee unase lipta naheen hotaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
नैव किञ्चित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित् ।
पश्यञ्शृण्वन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपञ्श्वसन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
naiva kiñcitkaromīti yukto manyeta tattvavit.
paśyañśruṇvanspṛśañjighrannaśnangacchansvapañśvasan
verses.hinglishMeaning: Tattvavit yukta purusha yaha sochegaa (arthaat jaanataa hai) ki "main kinchit maatra karma naheen karataa hoon" dekhataa huaa, sunataa huaa, sparsha karataa huaa, soonghataa huaa, khaataa huaa, chalataa huaa, sotaa huaa, shvaasa letaa huaa,
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Tattvavit yukta purusha yaha sochegaa (arthaat jaanataa hai) ki "main kinchit maatra karma naheen karataa hoon" dekhataa huaa, sunataa huaa, sparsha karataa huaa, soonghataa huaa, khaataa huaa, chalataa huaa, sotaa huaa, shvaasa letaa huaa,. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि ।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pralapanvisṛjangṛhṇannunmiṣannimiṣannapi.
indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan
verses.hinglishMeaning: Bolataa huaa, tyaagataa huaa, grahana karataa huaa tathaa aankhon ko kholataa aura banda karataa huaa (vaha) nishchayaatmaka roopa se jaanataa hai ki saba indriyaan apane-apane vishayon men vicharana kara rahee hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Bolataa huaa, tyaagataa huaa, grahana karataa huaa tathaa aankhon ko kholataa aura banda karataa huaa (vaha) nishchayaatmaka roopa se jaanataa hai ki saba indriyaan apane-apane vishayon men vicharana kara rahee hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः ।
लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ.
lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāmbhasā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha saba karma brahma men arpana karake aura aasakti ko tyaagakara karataa hai, vaha purusha kamala ke patte ke sadrisha paapa se lipta naheen hotaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha saba karma brahma men arpana karake aura aasakti ko tyaagakara karataa hai, vaha purusha kamala ke patte ke sadrisha paapa se lipta naheen hotaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि ।
योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये ॥
verses.transliteration:
kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalairindriyairapi.
yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṃ tyaktvātmaśuddhaye
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yogeejana, shareera, mana, buddhi aura indriyon dvaaraa aasakti ko tyaaga kara aatmashuddhi (chittashuddhi) ke lie karma karate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Yogeejana, shareera, mana, buddhi aura indriyon dvaaraa aasakti ko tyaaga kara aatmashuddhi (chittashuddhi) ke lie karma karate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम् ।
अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yuktaḥ karmaphalaṃ tyaktvā śāntimāpnoti naiṣṭhikīm.
ayuktaḥ kāmakāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yukta purusha karmaphala kaa tyaaga karake parama shaanti ko praapta hotaa hai; aura ayukta purusha phala men aasakta huaa kaamanaa ke dvaaraa bandhataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Yukta purusha karmaphala kaa tyaaga karake parama shaanti ko praapta hotaa hai; aura ayukta purusha phala men aasakta huaa kaamanaa ke dvaaraa bandhataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी ।
नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvakarmāṇi manasā saṃnyasyāste sukhaṃ vaśī.
navadvāre pure dehī naiva kurvanna kārayan
verses.hinglishMeaning: Saba karmon kaa mana se sannyaasa karake sanyamee purusha navadvaara vaalee shareera roopa nagaree men sukha se rahataa huaa na karma karataa hai aura na karavaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Saba karmon kaa mana se sannyaasa karake sanyamee purusha navadvaara vaalee shareera roopa nagaree men sukha se rahataa huaa na karma karataa hai aura na karavaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः ।
न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते ॥
verses.transliteration:
na kartṛtvaṃ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛjati prabhuḥ.
na karmaphalasaṃyogaṃ svabhāvastu pravartate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Lokamaatra ke lie prabhu (eeshvara) na kartritva, na karma aura na karmaphala ke sanyoga ko rachataa hai. parantu prakriti (saba kuchha) karatee hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Lokamaatra ke lie prabhu (eeshvara) na kartritva, na karma aura na karmaphala ke sanyoga ko rachataa hai. parantu prakriti (saba kuchha) karatee hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः ।
अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः ॥
verses.transliteration:
nādatte kasyacitpāpaṃ na caiva sukṛtaṃ vibhuḥ.
ajñānenāvṛtaṃ jñānaṃ tena muhyanti jantavaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vibhu paramatma na kisee ke paapakarma ko aura na punyakarma ko hee grahana karataa hai; (kintu) ajnyaana se jnyaana dhakaa huaa hai, isase saba jeeva mohita hote hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Vibhu paramatma na kisee ke paapakarma ko aura na punyakarma ko hee grahana karataa hai; (kintu) ajnyaana se jnyaana dhakaa huaa hai, isase saba jeeva mohita hote hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः ।
तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
jñānena tu tadajñānaṃ yeṣāṃ nāśitamātmanaḥ.
teṣāmādityavajjñānaṃ prakāśayati tatparam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parantu jinakaa vaha ajnyaana aatmajnyaana se nashta ho jaataa hai, unake lie vaha jnyaana, soorya ke sadrisha, paramatma ko prakaashita karataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Parantu jinakaa vaha ajnyaana aatmajnyaana se nashta ho jaataa hai, unake lie vaha jnyaana, soorya ke sadrisha, paramatma ko prakaashita karataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः ।
गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tadbuddhayastadātmānastanniṣṭhāstatparāyaṇāḥ.
gacchantyapunarāvṛttiṃ jñānanirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jinakee buddhi usa (paramatma) men sthita hai, jinakaa mana tadroopa huaa hai, usamen hee jinakee nishthaa hai, vaha (brahma) hee jinakaa parama lakshya hai, jnyaana ke dvaaraa paaparahita purusha apunaraavritti ko praapta hote hain, arthaat unakaa punarjanma naheen hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jinakee buddhi usa (paramatma) men sthita hai, jinakaa mana tadroopa huaa hai, usamen hee jinakee nishthaa hai, vaha (brahma) hee jinakaa parama lakshya hai, jnyaana ke dvaaraa paaparahita purusha apunaraavritti ko praapta hote hain, arthaat unakaa punarjanma naheen hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
विद्याविनयसम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि ।
शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
vidyāvinayasampanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini.
śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: (aise ve) jnyaaneejana vidyaa aura vinaya se sampanna braahmana, tathaa gaaya, haathee, shvaana aura chaandaala men bhee sama tattva ko dekhate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: (aise ve) jnyaaneejana vidyaa aura vinaya se sampanna braahmana, tathaa gaaya, haathee, shvaana aura chaandaala men bhee sama tattva ko dekhate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 5 ke mool vishay se juda hai: tyag aur karm ko ek shuddh antarik drishti se jodne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः ।
निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद् ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ihaiva tairjitaḥ sargo yeṣāṃ sāmye sthitaṃ manaḥ.
nirdoṣaṃ hi samaṃ brahma tasmād brahmaṇi te sthitāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jinakaa mana samatvabhaava men sthita hai, unake dvaaraa yaheen para yaha sarga jeeta liyaa jaataa hai; kyonki brahma nirdosha aura sama hai isaliye ve brahma men hee sthita hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jinakaa mana samatvabhaava men sthita hai, unake dvaaraa yaheen para yaha sarga jeeta liyaa jaataa hai; kyonki brahma nirdosha aura sama hai isaliye ve brahma men hee sthita hain. summary: The sixth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Dhyana Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna reveals the Yoga of Meditation and how to practise this Yoga. He discusses the role of action in preparing for Meditation, how performing duties in devotion purifies one's mind and heightens one's spiritual consciousness. He explains in detail the obstacles that one faces when trying to control their mind and the exact methods by which one can conquer their mind. He reveals how one can focus their mind on Paramatma and unite with the God.

sādhuṣvapi ca pāpeṣu samabuddhirviśiṣyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha suhrid, mitra, shatru, udaaseena, madhyastha, dveshee aura baandhavon men tathaa dharmatmaon men aura paapiyon men bhee samaana bhaava vaalaa hai, vaha shreshtha hai

verses.sanskrit:
योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः ।
एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yogī yuñjīta satatamātmānaṃ rahasi sthitaḥ.
ekākī yatacittātmā nirāśīraparigrahaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shareera aura mana ko sanyamita kiyaa huaa yogee ekaanta sthaana para akelaa rahataa huaa aashaa aura parigraha se mukta hokara nirantara mana ko atma men sthira kare
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shareera aura mana ko sanyamita kiyaa huaa yogee ekaanta sthaana para akelaa rahataa huaa aashaa aura parigraha se mukta hokara nirantara mana ko atma men sthira kare. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः ।
नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ.
nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ cailājinakuśottaram
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shuddha (svachchha) bhoomi men kusha, mrigashaalaa aura usa para vastra rakhaa ho aise apane aasana ko na ati oonchaa aura na ati neechaa sthira sthaapita karake....৷৷
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shuddha (svachchha) bhoomi men kusha, mrigashaalaa aura usa para vastra rakhaa ho aise apane aasana ko na ati oonchaa aura na ati neechaa sthira sthaapita karake....৷৷. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः ।
उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये ॥
verses.transliteration:
tatraikāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā yatacittendriyakriyaḥ.
upaviśyāsane yuñjyādyogamātmaviśuddhaye
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vahaan (aasana men baithakara) mana ko ekaagra karake, chitta aura indriyon kee kriyaaon ko vasha men kiye huye aatmashuddhi ke lie yoga kaa abhyaasa kare
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Vahaan (aasana men baithakara) mana ko ekaagra karake, chitta aura indriyon kee kriyaaon ko vasha men kiye huye aatmashuddhi ke lie yoga kaa abhyaasa kare. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः ।
सम्प्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
samaṃ kāyaśirogrīvaṃ dhārayannacalaṃ sthiraḥ.
samprekṣya nāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kaayaa, sira aura greevaa ko samaana aura achala dhaarana kiye hue sthira hokara apanee naasikaa ke agra bhaaga ko dekhakara anya dishaaon ko na dekhataa huaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Kaayaa, sira aura greevaa ko samaana aura achala dhaarana kiye hue sthira hokara apanee naasikaa ke agra bhaaga ko dekhakara anya dishaaon ko na dekhataa huaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः ।
मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः ॥
verses.transliteration:
praśāntātmā vigatabhīrbrahmacārivrate sthitaḥ.
manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: (saadhaka ko) prashaanta anta:karana, nirbhaya aura brahmacharya brata men sthita hokara, mana ko sanyamita karake chitta ko mujhamen lagaakara mujhey hee parama lakshya samajhakara baithanaa chaahie
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: (saadhaka ko) prashaanta anta:karana, nirbhaya aura brahmacharya brata men sthita hokara, mana ko sanyamita karake chitta ko mujhamen lagaakara mujhey hee parama lakshya samajhakara baithanaa chaahie. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी नियतमानसः ।
शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī niyatamānasaḥ.
śāntiṃ nirvāṇaparamāṃ matsaṃsthāmadhigacchati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isa prakaara sadaa mana ko sthira karane kaa prayaasa karataa huaa sanyamita mana kaa yogee mujhamen sthita parama nirvaana (moksha) svaroopa shaanti ko praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Isa prakaara sadaa mana ko sthira karane kaa prayaasa karataa huaa sanyamita mana kaa yogee mujhamen sthita parama nirvaana (moksha) svaroopa shaanti ko praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः ।
न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन ॥
verses.transliteration:
nātyaśnatastu yogo.asti na caikāntamanaśnataḥ.
na cātisvapnaśīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parantu, hey Arjun ! yaha yoga usa purusha ke lie sambhava naheen hotaa, jo adhika khaane vaalaa hai yaa bilkula na khaane vaalaa hai tathaa jo adhika sone vaalaa hai yaa sadaa jaagane vaalaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Parantu, hey Arjun ! yaha yoga usa purusha ke lie sambhava naheen hotaa, jo adhika khaane vaalaa hai yaa bilkula na khaane vaalaa hai tathaa jo adhika sone vaalaa hai yaa sadaa jaagane vaalaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु ।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ॥
verses.transliteration:
yuktāhāravihārasya yuktaceṣṭasya karmasu.
yuktasvapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkhahā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Usa purusha ke lie yoga du:khanaashaka hotaa hai, jo yukta aahaara aura vihaara karane vaalaa hai, yathaayogya cheshtaa karane vaalaa hai aura parimita shayana aura jaagarana karane vaalaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Usa purusha ke lie yoga du:khanaashaka hotaa hai, jo yukta aahaara aura vihaara karane vaalaa hai, yathaayogya cheshtaa karane vaalaa hai aura parimita shayana aura jaagarana karane vaalaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते ।
निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadā viniyataṃ cittamātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate.
niḥspṛhaḥ sarvakāmebhyo yukta ityucyate tadā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vasha men kiyaa huaa chitta jisa kaalamen apane svarupamen hee sthita ho jaataa hai aura svayan sampoorna padaarthon ni: spriha ho jaataa hai, usa kaalamen vaha yogee kahaa jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Vasha men kiyaa huaa chitta jisa kaalamen apane svarupamen hee sthita ho jaataa hai aura svayan sampoorna padaarthon ni: spriha ho jaataa hai, usa kaalamen vaha yogee kahaa jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता ।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā.
yogino yatacittasya yuñjato yogamātmanaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise spandanarahita vaayuke sthaanamen sthita deepakakee lau cheshtaarahita ho jaatee hai, yogakaa abhyaasa karate hue yatachittavaale yogeeke chittakee vaisee hee upamaa kahee gayee hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jaise spandanarahita vaayuke sthaanamen sthita deepakakee lau cheshtaarahita ho jaatee hai, yogakaa abhyaasa karate hue yatachittavaale yogeeke chittakee vaisee hee upamaa kahee gayee hai. verses.sanskrit:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया ।
यत्र चैवात्मनात्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatroparamate cittaṃ niruddhaṃ yogasevayā.
yatra caivātmanātmānaṃ paśyannātmani tuṣyati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yogakaa sevana karanese jisa avasthaamen nirudhda chitta uparaama ho jaataa hai tathaa jisa avasthaamen svayan apane-aapamen apane-aapako dekhataa huaa apane-aapamen santushta ho jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Yogakaa sevana karanese jisa avasthaamen nirudhda chitta uparaama ho jaataa hai tathaa jisa avasthaamen svayan apane-aapamen apane-aapako dekhataa huaa apane-aapamen santushta ho jaataa hai. verses.sanskrit:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद् बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् ।
वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sukhamātyantikaṃ yattad buddhigrāhyamatīndriyam.
vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo sukha aatyantika, ateendriya aura budhdigraahma hai, usa sukhakaa jisa avasthaamen anubhava karataa hai aura jisa sukhamen sthita huaa yaha dhyaanayogee phira kabhee tatvase vichalita naheen hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo sukha aatyantika, ateendriya aura budhdigraahma hai, usa sukhakaa jisa avasthaamen anubhava karataa hai aura jisa sukhamen sthita huaa yaha dhyaanayogee phira kabhee tatvase vichalita naheen hotaa hai. verses.sanskrit:
यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः ।
यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ.
yasminsthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vicālyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jisa laabhakee praapti honepara usase adhika koee doosaraa laabha usake maananemen bhee naheen aataa aura jisamen sthita honepara vaha bade bhaaree du:kha se bhee vichalita naheen hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jisa laabhakee praapti honepara usase adhika koee doosaraa laabha usake maananemen bhee naheen aataa aura jisamen sthita honepara vaha bade bhaaree du:kha se bhee vichalita naheen hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम् ।
स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा ॥
verses.transliteration:
taṃ vidyād duḥkhasaṃyogaviyogaṃ yogasaṃjñitam.
sa niścayena yoktavyo yogo.anirviṇṇacetasā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Du:kha ke sanyoga se viyoga hai, useeko 'yoga' naamase jaananaa chaahiye . (vaha yoga jisa dhyaanayoga lakshya hai,) usa dhyaanayokaa abhyaasa na ukataaye hue chittase nishchayapoorvaka karanaa chaahiye
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Du:kha ke sanyoga se viyoga hai, useeko 'yoga' naamase jaananaa chaahiye . (vaha yoga jisa dhyaanayoga lakshya hai,) usa dhyaanayokaa abhyaasa na ukataaye hue chittase nishchayapoorvaka karanaa chaahiye. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः ।
मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṅkalpaprabhavānkāmāṃstyaktvā sarvānaśeṣataḥ.
manasaivendriyagrāmaṃ viniyamya samantataḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sankalpa se utpanna samasta kaamanaaon ko ni:shesha roopa se parityaaga kara mana ke dvaaraa indriya samudaaya ko saba ora se samyak prakaara vasha men karake
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Sankalpa se utpanna samasta kaamanaaon ko ni:shesha roopa se parityaaga kara mana ke dvaaraa indriya samudaaya ko saba ora se samyak prakaara vasha men karake. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया ।
आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śanaiḥ śanairuparamed buddhyā dhṛtigṛhītayā.
ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayet
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shanai: shanai: dhairyayukta buddhi ke dvaaraa (yogee) uparaamataa (shaanti) ko praapta hove; mana ko atma men sthita karake phira anya kuchha bhee chintana na kare
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shanai: shanai: dhairyayukta buddhi ke dvaaraa (yogee) uparaamataa (shaanti) ko praapta hove; mana ko atma men sthita karake phira anya kuchha bhee chintana na kare. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् ।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram.
tatastato niyamyaitadātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yaha chanchala aura asthira mana jina kaaranon se (vishayon men) vicharana karataa hai, unase sanyamita karake use atma ke hee vasha men laave arthaat atma men sthira kare
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Yaha chanchala aura asthira mana jina kaaranon se (vishayon men) vicharana karataa hai, unase sanyamita karake use atma ke hee vasha men laave arthaat atma men sthira kare. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम् ।
उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
praśāntamanasaṃ hyenaṃ yoginaṃ sukhamuttamam.
upaiti śāntarajasaṃ brahmabhūtamakalmaṣam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jisakaa mana prashaanta hai, jo paaparahita (akalmasham) hai aura jisakaa rajoguna (vikshepa) shaanta huaa hai, aise brahmaroopa hue isa yogee ko uttama sukha praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jisakaa mana prashaanta hai, jo paaparahita (akalmasham) hai aura jisakaa rajoguna (vikshepa) shaanta huaa hai, aise brahmaroopa hue isa yogee ko uttama sukha praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः ।
सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī vigatakalmaṣaḥ.
sukhena brahmasaṃsparśamatyantaṃ sukhamaśnute
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isa prakaara mana ko sadaa atma men sthira karane kaa yoga karane vaalaa paaparahita yogee sukhapoorvaka brahmasansparsha kaa parama sukha praapta karataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Isa prakaara mana ko sadaa atma men sthira karane kaa yoga karane vaalaa paaparahita yogee sukhapoorvaka brahmasansparsha kaa parama sukha praapta karataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि ।
ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani.
īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yogayukta anta:karana vaalaa aura sarvatra samadarshee yogee atma ko saba bhooton men aura bhootamaatra ko atma men dekhataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Yogayukta anta:karana vaalaa aura sarvatra samadarshee yogee atma ko saba bhooton men aura bhootamaatra ko atma men dekhataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति ।
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati.
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha mujhey sarvatra dekhataa hai aura sabako mujhamen dekhataa hai, usake lie main nashta naheen hotaa (arthaat usake lie main doora naheen hotaa) aura vaha mujhase viyukta naheen hotaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha mujhey sarvatra dekhataa hai aura sabako mujhamen dekhataa hai, usake lie main nashta naheen hotaa (arthaat usake lie main doora naheen hotaa) aura vaha mujhase viyukta naheen hotaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvabhūtasthitaṃ yo māṃ bhajatyekatvamāsthitaḥ.
sarvathā vartamāno.api sa yogī mayi vartate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha ekatvabhaava mane sthita huaa sampoorna bhooton men sthita mujhey bhajataa hai, vaha yogee saba prakaara se vartataa huaa (rahataa huaa) mujhamen sthita rahataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha ekatvabhaava mane sthita huaa sampoorna bhooton men sthita mujhey bhajataa hai, vaha yogee saba prakaara se vartataa huaa (rahataa huaa) mujhamen sthita rahataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन ।
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo.arjuna.
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun ! jo purusha apane samaana sarvatra sama dekhataa hai, chaahey vaha sukha ho yaa du:kha, vaha parama yogee maanaa gayaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey Arjun ! jo purusha apane samaana sarvatra sama dekhataa hai, chaahey vaha sukha ho yaa du:kha, vaha parama yogee maanaa gayaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन ।
एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात्स्थितिं स्थिराम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca.
yo.ayaṃ yogastvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana.
etasyāhaṃ na paśyāmi cañcalatvātsthitiṃ sthirām
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kahaa -- hey madhusoodana ! jo yaha saamya yoga aapane kahaa, main mana ke chanchala hone se isakee chirasthaayee sthiti ko naheen dekhataa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Arjun ne kahaa -- hey madhusoodana ! jo yaha saamya yoga aapane kahaa, main mana ke chanchala hone se isakee chirasthaayee sthiti ko naheen dekhataa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद् दृढम् ।
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavad dṛḍham.
tasyāhaṃ nigrahaṃ manye vāyoriva suduṣkaram
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kyonki hey Krishna ! yaha mana chanchala aura pramathana svabhaava kaa tathaa balavaan aura dridha hai; usakaa nigraha karanaa main vaayu ke samaana ati dushkara maanataa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Kyonki hey Krishna ! yaha mana chanchala aura pramathana svabhaava kaa tathaa balavaan aura dridha hai; usakaa nigraha karanaa main vaayu ke samaana ati dushkara maanataa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् ।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
asaṃśayaṃ mahābāho mano durnigrahaṃ calam.
abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shreebhagavaan kahate hain -- hey mahabaaho ! ni:sandeha mana chanchala aura kathinataa se vasha men hone vaalaa hai; parantu, hey kunteeputra ! use abhyaasa aura vairaagya ke dvaaraa vasha men kiyaa jaa sakataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shreebhagavaan kahate hain -- hey mahabaaho ! ni:sandeha mana chanchala aura kathinataa se vasha men hone vaalaa hai; parantu, hey kunteeputra ! use abhyaasa aura vairaagya ke dvaaraa vasha men kiyaa jaa sakataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः ।
वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ.
vaśyātmanā tu yatatā śakyo.avāptumupāyataḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Asanyata mana ke purusha dvaaraa yoga praapta honaa kathina hai, parantu svaadheena mana vaale prayatnasheela purusha dvaaraa upaaya se yoga praapta honaa sanbhava hai, yaha meraa mata hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Asanyata mana ke purusha dvaaraa yoga praapta honaa kathina hai, parantu svaadheena mana vaale prayatnasheela purusha dvaaraa upaaya se yoga praapta honaa sanbhava hai, yaha meraa mata hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः ।
अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca.
ayatiḥ śraddhayopeto yogāccalitamānasaḥ.
aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kahaa -- hey Krishna ! jisakaa mana yoga se chalaayamaana ho gayaa hai, aisaa apoorna prayatna vaalaa (ayati) shraddhaayukta purusha yoga kee siddhi ko na praapta hokara kisa gati ko praapta hotaa hai?
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Arjun ne kahaa -- hey Krishna ! jisakaa mana yoga se chalaayamaana ho gayaa hai, aisaa apoorna prayatna vaalaa (ayati) shraddhaayukta purusha yoga kee siddhi ko na praapta hokara kisa gati ko praapta hotaa hai?. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति ।
अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि ॥
verses.transliteration:
kaccinnobhayavibhraṣṭaśchinnābhramiva naśyati.
apratiṣṭho mahābāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey mahabaaho ! kyaa vaha brahma ke maarga men mohita tathaa aashrayarahita purusha chhinna-bhinna megha ke samaana donon ora se bhrashta huaa nashta to naheen ho jaataa hai?
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey mahabaaho ! kyaa vaha brahma ke maarga men mohita tathaa aashrayarahita purusha chhinna-bhinna megha ke samaana donon ora se bhrashta huaa nashta to naheen ho jaataa hai?. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः ।
त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
etanme saṃśayaṃ kṛṣṇa chettumarhasyaśeṣataḥ.
tvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya chettā na hyupapadyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Krishna ! mere isa sanshaya ko ni:shesha roopa se chhedana (niraakarana) karane ke lie aapa hee yogya hai; kyonki aapake atirikta anya koee isa sanshaya kaa chhedana karana vaalaa (chhettaa) milanaa sanbhava naheen hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey Krishna ! mere isa sanshaya ko ni:shesha roopa se chhedana (niraakarana) karane ke lie aapa hee yogya hai; kyonki aapake atirikta anya koee isa sanshaya kaa chhedana karana vaalaa (chhettaa) milanaa sanbhava naheen hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते ।
न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद् दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśastasya vidyate.
na hi kalyāṇakṛtkaścid durgatiṃ tāta gacchati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- hey paartha ! usa purusha kaa, na to isa loka men aura na hee paraloka men hee naasha hotaa hai; hey taata ! koee bhee shubha karma karane vaalaa durgati ko naheen praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- hey paartha ! usa purusha kaa, na to isa loka men aura na hee paraloka men hee naasha hotaa hai; hey taata ! koee bhee shubha karma karane vaalaa durgati ko naheen praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः ।
शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokānuṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ.
śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo.abhijāyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yogabhrashta purusha punyavaanon ke lokon ko praapta hokara vahaan deerghakaala taka vaasa karake shuddha aacharana vaale shreemanta (dhanavaana) purushon ke ghara men janma letaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Yogabhrashta purusha punyavaanon ke lokon ko praapta hokara vahaan deerghakaala taka vaasa karake shuddha aacharana vaale shreemanta (dhanavaana) purushon ke ghara men janma letaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम् ।
एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
athavā yogināmeva kule bhavati dhīmatām.
etaddhi durlabhataraṃ loke janma yadīdṛśam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Athavaa, (saadhaka) jnyaanavaan yogiyon ke hee kula men janma letaa hai, parantu isa prakaara kaa janma isa loka men ni:sandeha ati durlabha hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Athavaa, (saadhaka) jnyaanavaan yogiyon ke hee kula men janma letaa hai, parantu isa prakaara kaa janma isa loka men ni:sandeha ati durlabha hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम् ।
यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन ॥
verses.transliteration:
tatra taṃ buddhisaṃyogaṃ labhate paurvadehikam.
yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kurunandana ! vaha purusha vahaan poorva deha men praapta kiye gaye jnyaana se sampanna hokara yogasansiddhi ke lie usase bhee adhika prayatna karataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey kurunandana ! vaha purusha vahaan poorva deha men praapta kiye gaye jnyaana se sampanna hokara yogasansiddhi ke lie usase bhee adhika prayatna karataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः ।
जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते ॥
verses.transliteration:
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśo.api saḥ.
jijñāsurapi yogasya śabdabrahmātivartate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Usee poorvaabhyaasa ke kaarana vaha avasha huaa yoga kee ora aakarshita hotaa hai. yoga kaa jo kevala jijnyaasu hai vaha shabdabrahma kaa atikramana karataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Usee poorvaabhyaasa ke kaarana vaha avasha huaa yoga kee ora aakarshita hotaa hai. yoga kaa jo kevala jijnyaasu hai vaha shabdabrahma kaa atikramana karataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः ।
अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prayatnādyatamānastu yogī saṃśuddhakilbiṣaḥ.
anekajanmasaṃsiddhastato yāti parāṃ gatim
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parantu prayatnapoorvaka abhyaasa karane vaalaa yogee sampoorna paapon se shuddha hokara aneka janmon se (shanai: shanai:) siddha hotaa huaa, taba parama gati ko praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Parantu prayatnapoorvaka abhyaasa karane vaalaa yogee sampoorna paapon se shuddha hokara aneka janmon se (shanai: shanai:) siddha hotaa huaa, taba parama gati ko praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः ।
कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन ॥
verses.transliteration:
tapasvibhyo.adhiko yogī jñānibhyo.api mato.adhikaḥ.
karmibhyaścādhiko yogī tasmādyogī bhavārjuna
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kyonki yogee tapasviyon se shreshtha hai aura (kevala shaastra ke) jnyaana vaalon se bhee shreshtha maanaa gayaa hai tathaa karma karane vaalon se bhee yogee shreshtha hai, isalie hey Arjun tuma yogee bano
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Kyonki yogee tapasviyon se shreshtha hai aura (kevala shaastra ke) jnyaana vaalon se bhee shreshtha maanaa gayaa hai tathaa karma karane vaalon se bhee yogee shreshtha hai, isalie hey Arjun tuma yogee bano. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना ।
श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yogināmapi sarveṣāṃ madgatenāntarātmanā.
śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Samasta yogiyon men jo bhee shraddhaavaan yogee mujha men yukta huye antaratma se (arthaat ekatva bhaava se mujhey bhajataa hai, vaha mujhey yuktatama (sarvashreshtha) maanya hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Samasta yogiyon men jo bhee shraddhaavaan yogee mujha men yukta huye antaratma se (arthaat ekatva bhaava se mujhey bhajataa hai, vaha mujhey yuktatama (sarvashreshtha) maanya hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 6 ke mool vishay se juda hai: man ko saadhkar dhyan, santulan aur atma-uddhar ka marg batata hai.

summary: The seventh chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Gyaan Vigyana Yoga . In this chapter, Krishna reveals that he is the Supreme Truth, the principal cause and the sustaining force of everything. He reveals his illusionary energy in this material world called Maya, which is very difficult to overcome but those who surrender their minds unto Him attain Him easily. He also describes the four types of people who surrender to Him in devotion and the four kinds that don't. Krishna confirms that He is the Ultimate Reality and those who realize this Truth reach the pinnacle of spiritual realization and unite with the Lord.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः ।
असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
mayyāsaktamanāḥ pārtha yogaṃ yuñjanmadāśrayaḥ.
asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! mujhamen asakta hue mana vaale tathaa madaashrita hokara yoga kaa abhyaasa karate hue jisa prakaara tuma mujhey samagraroopa se, binaa kisee sanshaya ke, jaanoge vaha suno

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
jñānaṃ te.ahaṃ savijñānamidaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ.
yajjñātvā neha bhūyo.anyajjñātavyamavaśiṣyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main tumhaare lie vijnyaana sahita isa jnyaana ko ashesha roopa se kahoongaa jisako jaanakara yahaan (jagat men) phira aura kuchha jaanane yogya (jnyaatavya) shesha naheen raha jaataa hai

verses.sanskrit:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये ।
यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration:

yatatāmapi siddhānāṃ kaścinmāṃ vetti tattvataḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sahasron manushyon men koee hee manushya poornatva kee siddhi ke lie prayatna karataa hai aura una prayatnasheela saadhakon men bhee koee hee purusha mujhey tattva se jaanataa hai

verses.sanskrit:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च ।
अहंकार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhūmirāpo.analo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca.
ahaṃkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Prithvee, jala, agni, vaayu aura aakaasha tathaa mana, buddhi aura ahankaara - yaha aatha prakaara se vibhakta huee meree prakriti hai

verses.sanskrit:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम् ।
जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
apareyamitastvanyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām.
jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey mahaabaaho ! yaha aparaa prakriti hai. isase bhinna meree jeevaroopee paraaprakriti ko jaano, jisase yaha jagat dhaarana kiyaa jaataa hai

verses.sanskrit:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय ।
अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा ॥
verses.transliteration:
etadyonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya.
ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayastathā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yaha jaano ki samampoorna bhoota ina donon prakritiyon se utpatti vaale hain. (ata:) main sampoorna jagat kaa utpatti tathaa pralaya sthaana hoon

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय ।
मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ॥
verses.transliteration:

mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey dhananjaya ! mujhase shreshtha (pare) anya kichinmaatra vastu naheen hai. yaha sampoorna jagat sootra men maniyon ke sadrisha mujhamen piroyaa huaa hai

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः ।
प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु ॥
verses.transliteration:
raso.ahamapsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śaśisūryayoḥ.
praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kaunteya ! jala men main rasa hoon, chandramaa aura soorya men prakaasha hoon, saba vedon men pranava (n़kaara) hoon tathaa aakaasha men shabda aura purushon men purushatva hoon

verses.sanskrit:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ ।
जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु ॥
verses.transliteration:

jīvanaṃ sarvabhūteṣu tapaścāsmi tapasviṣu
verses.hinglishMeaning: Prithvee men pavitra gandha hoon aura agni men teja hoon; sampoorna bhooton men jeevana hoon aura tapasviyon men main tapa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Prithvee men pavitra gandha hoon aura agni men teja hoon; sampoorna bhooton men jeevana hoon aura tapasviyon men main tapa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम् ।

verses.transliteration:

buddhirbuddhimatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! sampoorna bhooton kaa sanaatana beeja (kaarana) mujhey hee jaano; main buddhimaanon kee buddhi aura tejasviyon kaa teja hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey paartha ! sampoorna bhooton kaa sanaatana beeja (kaarana) mujhey hee jaano; main buddhimaanon kee buddhi aura tejasviyon kaa teja hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम् ।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ ॥
verses.transliteration:

dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo.asmi bharatarṣabha
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bharata shreshtha ! main balavaanon kaa kaamanaa tathaa aasakti se rahita bala hoon aura saba bhooton men dharma ke aviruddha arthaat anukoola kaama hoon

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये ।
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्वहं तेषु ते मयि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye.
matta eveti tānviddhi na tvahaṃ teṣu te mayi
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo bhee saattvika (shuddha), raajasika (kriyaasheela) aura taamasika (jada) bhaava hain, una sabako tuma mere se utpanna hue jaano; tathaapi main unamen naheen hoon, ve mujhamen hain

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत् ।

verses.transliteration:

mohitaṃ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ paramavyayam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Trigunon se utpanna ina bhaavon (vikaaron) se sampoorna jagat (loga) mohita huaa ina (gunon) se pare avyaya svaroopa mujhey naheen jaanataa hai

verses.sanskrit:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया ।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते ॥
verses.transliteration:

māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yaha daivee trigunamayee meree maayaa badee dustara hai. parantu jo meree sharana men aate hain, ve isa maayaa ko paara kara jaate hain

verses.sanskrit:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः ।
माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ.
māyayāpahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Dushkritya karane vaale, moodha, naraadhama purusha mujhey naheen bhajate hain; maayaa ke dvaaraa jinakaa jnyaana hara liyaa gayaa hai, ve aasuree bhaava ko dhaarana kiye rahate hain

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन ।
आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ ॥
verses.transliteration:
caturvidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtino.arjuna.
ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca bharatarṣabha
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bharata shreshtha Arjun ! uttama karma karane vaale (sukritina:) aarta, jijnyaasu, arthaarthee aura jnyaanee aise chaara prakaara ke loga mujhey bhajate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey bharata shreshtha Arjun ! uttama karma karane vaale (sukritina:) aarta, jijnyaasu, arthaarthee aura jnyaanee aise chaara prakaara ke loga mujhey bhajate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते ।
प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः ॥
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhaktirviśiṣyate.
priyo hi jñānino.atyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Unamen bhee mujha se nityayukta, ananya bhakti vaalaa jnyaanee shreshtha hai, kyonki jnyaanee ko main atyanta priya hoon aura vaha mujhey atyanta priya hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Unamen bhee mujha se nityayukta, ananya bhakti vaalaa jnyaanee shreshtha hai, kyonki jnyaanee ko main atyanta priya hoon aura vaha mujhey atyanta priya hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् ।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam.
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim
verses.hinglishMeaning: (yadyapi) ye saba utkrishta hain, parantu jnyaanee to meraa svaroopa hee hai aisaa meraa mata hai, kyonki vaha sthira buddhi jnyaanee ati uttama gatisvaroopa mujhamen achchhee prakaara sthita hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: (yadyapi) ye saba utkrishta hain, parantu jnyaanee to meraa svaroopa hee hai aisaa meraa mata hai, kyonki vaha sthira buddhi jnyaanee ati uttama gatisvaroopa mujhamen achchhee prakaara sthita hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते ।
वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bahūnāṃ janmanāmante jñānavānmāṃ prapadyate.
vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti sa mahātmā sudurlabhaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Bahuta janmon ke anta men (kisee eka janma vishesha men) jnyaana ko praapta hokara ki 'yaha saba vaasudeva hai' jnyaanee bhakta mujhey praapta hotaa hai; aisaa mahatma ati durlabha hai

verses.sanskrit:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः ।
तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया ॥
verses.transliteration:
kāmaistaistairhṛtajñānāḥ prapadyante.anyadevatāḥ.
taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Bhogavishesha kee kaamanaa se jinakaa jnyaana hara liyaa gayaa hai, aise purusha apane svabhaava se prerita hue anya devataaon ko vishishta niyama kaa paalana karate hue bhajate hain

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति ।
तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati.
tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tāmeva vidadhāmyaham
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo-jo (sakaamee) bhakta jisa-jisa (devataa ke) roopa ko shraddhaa se poojanaa chaahataa hai, usa-usa (bhakta) kee main usa hee devataa ke prati shraddhaa ko sthira karataa hoon

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते ।
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate.
labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaivavihitānhi tān
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vaha (bhakta) usa shraddhaa se yukta hokara usa devataa kaa poojana karataa hai aura usase mere dvaaraa vidhaana kiye huye ichchhita bhogon ko ni:sandeha praapta karataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Vaha (bhakta) usa shraddhaa se yukta hokara usa devataa kaa poojana karataa hai aura usase mere dvaaraa vidhaana kiye huye ichchhita bhogon ko ni:sandeha praapta karataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम् ।
देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि ॥
verses.transliteration:
antavattu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tadbhavatyalpamedhasām.
devāndevayajo yānti madbhaktā yānti māmapi
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parantu una alpa buddhi purushon kaa vaha phala naashavaan hotaa hai. devataaon ke poojaka devataaon ko praapta hote hain aura mere bhakta mujhey hee praapta hote hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Parantu una alpa buddhi purushon kaa vaha phala naashavaan hotaa hai. devataaon ke poojaka devataaon ko praapta hote hain aura mere bhakta mujhey hee praapta hote hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः ।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
avyaktaṃ vyaktimāpannaṃ manyante māmabuddhayaḥ.
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mamāvyayamanuttamam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Buddhiheena purusha mere anuttama (sarvottama) avyaya parama bhaava ko na jaanate hue mujha avyakta ko vyakta maanate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Buddhiheena purusha mere anuttama (sarvottama) avyaya parama bhaava ko na jaanate hue mujha avyakta ko vyakta maanate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः ।
मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yogamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ.
mūḍho.ayaṃ nābhijānāti loko māmajamavyayam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Apanee yogamaayaa se aavritta main sabako pratyaksha naheen hotaa hoon. yaha mohita loka (manushya) mujha janmarahita, avinaashee ko naheen jaanataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Apanee yogamaayaa se aavritta main sabako pratyaksha naheen hotaa hoon. yaha mohita loka (manushya) mujha janmarahita, avinaashee ko naheen jaanataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन ।
भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन ॥
verses.transliteration:
vedāhaṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna.
bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun ! poorva men vyateeta hue aura vartamaana men sthita tathaa bhavishya men hone vaale bhootamaatra ko main jaanataa hoon, parantu mujhey koee bhee purusha naheen jaanataa hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey Arjun ! poorva men vyateeta hue aura vartamaana men sthita tathaa bhavishya men hone vaale bhootamaatra ko main jaanataa hoon, parantu mujhey koee bhee purusha naheen jaanataa hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत ।
सर्वभूतानि सम्मोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप ॥
verses.transliteration:
icchādveṣasamutthena dvandvamohena bhārata.
sarvabhūtāni sammohaṃ sarge yānti parantapa
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey parantapa bhaarata ! ichchhaa aura dvesha se utpanna dvandvamoha se bhootamaatra utpatti kaala men hee sanmoha (aviveka) ko praapta hote hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey parantapa bhaarata ! ichchhaa aura dvesha se utpanna dvandvamoha se bhootamaatra utpatti kaala men hee sanmoha (aviveka) ko praapta hote hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् ।
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yeṣāṃ tvantagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām.
te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parantu jina punyakarmee purushon kaa paapa nashta ho gayaa hai, ve dvandvamoha se nirmukta aura dridhavatee purusha mujhey bhajate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Parantu jina punyakarmee purushon kaa paapa nashta ho gayaa hai, ve dvandvamoha se nirmukta aura dridhavatee purusha mujhey bhajate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये ।
ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
jarāmaraṇamokṣāya māmāśritya yatanti ye.
te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo mere sharanaagata hokara jaraa aura marana se mukti paane ke lie yatna karate hain, ve purusha usa brahma ko, sampoorna adhyaatma ko aura sampoorna karma ko jaanate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo mere sharanaagata hokara jaraa aura marana se mukti paane ke lie yatna karate hain, ve purusha usa brahma ko, sampoorna adhyaatma ko aura sampoorna karma ko jaanate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः ।
प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ.
prayāṇakāle.api ca māṃ te viduryuktacetasaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha adhibhoota aura adhidaiva tathaa adhiyajnya ke sahita mujhey jaanate hain, ve yuktachitta vaale purusha antakaala men bhee mujhey jaanate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha adhibhoota aura adhidaiva tathaa adhiyajnya ke sahita mujhey jaanate hain, ve yuktachitta vaale purusha antakaala men bhee mujhey jaanate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 7 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ko prakriti, jeevan aur gyaan ke mool roop mein samjhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

summary: The eighth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Akshara Brahma Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna reveals the importance of the last thought before death. If we can remember Krishna at the time of death, we will certainly attain him. Thus, it is very important to be in constant awareness of the Lord at all times, thinking of Him and chanting His names at all times. By perfectly absorbing their mind in Him through constant devotion, one can go beyond this material existence to Lord's Supreme abode.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
किं तद् ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम ।
अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca.
kiṃ tad brahma kimadhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama.
adhibhūtaṃ ca kiṃ proktamadhidaivaṃ kimucyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kahaa -hey purushottama ! vaha brahma kyaa hai adhyaatma kyaa hai? tathaa karma kyaa hai? aura adhibhoota naama se kyaa kahaa gayaa hai? tathaa adhidaiva naama se kyaa kahaa jaataa hai,

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 8 ke mool vishay se juda hai: antim smaran, akshar brahm aur jeevan ki disha ka mahatva batata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन ।
प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko.atra dehe.asminmadhusūdana.
prayāṇakāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo.asi niyatātmabhiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aura hey madhusoodana ! yahaan adhiyajnya kauna hai? aura vaha isa shareera men kaise hai? aura sanyata chitta vaale purushon dvaaraa anta samaya men aapa kisa prakaara jaane jaate hain,

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 8 ke mool vishay se juda hai: antim smaran, akshar brahm aur jeevan ki disha ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo.adhyātmamucyate.
bhūtabhāvodbhavakaro visargaḥ karmasaṃjñitaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- parama akshara (avinaashee) tattva brahma hai; svabhaava (apanaa svaroopa) adhyaatma kahaa jaataa hai; bhooton ke bhaavon ko utpanna karane vaalaa visarga (yajnya, preraka bala) karma naama se jaanaa jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- parama akshara (avinaashee) tattva brahma hai; svabhaava (apanaa svaroopa) adhyaatma kahaa jaataa hai; bhooton ke bhaavon ko utpanna karane vaalaa visarga (yajnya, preraka bala) karma naama se jaanaa jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 8 ke mool vishay se juda hai: antim smaran, akshar brahm aur jeevan ki disha ka mahatva batata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम् ।
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर ॥
verses.transliteration:
adhibhūtaṃ kṣaro bhāvaḥ puruṣaścādhidaivatam.
adhiyajño.ahamevātra dehe dehabhṛtāṃ vara
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey dehadhaariyon men shreshtha Arjun ! nashvara vastu (panchamahaabhoota) adhibhoota aura purusha adhidaiva hai; isa shareera men main hee adhiyajnya hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey dehadhaariyon men shreshtha Arjun ! nashvara vastu (panchamahaabhoota) adhibhoota aura purusha adhidaiva hai; isa shareera men main hee adhiyajnya hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 8 ke mool vishay se juda hai: antim smaran, akshar brahm aur jeevan ki disha ka mahatva batata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् ।
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
antakāle ca māmeva smaranmuktvā kalevaram.
yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aura jo koee purusha antakaala men mujhey hee smarana karataa huaa shareera ko tyaaga kara jaataa hai, vaha mere svaroopa ko praapta hotaa hai, isamen kuchha bhee sanshaya naheen
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Aura jo koee purusha antakaala men mujhey hee smarana karataa huaa shareera ko tyaaga kara jaataa hai, vaha mere svaroopa ko praapta hotaa hai, isamen kuchha bhee sanshaya naheen. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 8 ke mool vishay se juda hai: antim smaran, akshar brahm aur jeevan ki disha ka mahatva batata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम् ।
तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram.
taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kaunteya ! (yaha jeeva) antakaala men jisa kisee bhee bhaava ko smarana karataa huaa shareera ko tyaagataa hai, vaha sadaiva usa bhaava ke chintana ke phalasvaroopa usee bhaava ko hee praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey kaunteya ! (yaha jeeva) antakaala men jisa kisee bhee bhaava ko smarana karataa huaa shareera ko tyaagataa hai, vaha sadaiva usa bhaava ke chintana ke phalasvaroopa usee bhaava ko hee praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 8 ke mool vishay se juda hai: antim smaran, akshar brahm aur jeevan ki disha ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Asakti kam karne se karm halka, spasht aur shant ho jata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयः (orसंशयम्) ॥
verses.transliteration:
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca.
mayyarpitamanobuddhirmāmevaiṣyasyasaṃśayaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isalie, tuma saba kaala men meraa nirantara smarana karo; aura yuddha karo mujhamen arpana kiye mana, buddhi se yukta hue nihsandeha tuma mujhey hee praapta hooge
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Isalie, tuma saba kaala men meraa nirantara smarana karo; aura yuddha karo mujhamen arpana kiye mana, buddhi se yukta hue nihsandeha tuma mujhey hee praapta hooge. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 8 ke mool vishay se juda hai: antim smaran, akshar brahm aur jeevan ki disha ka mahatva batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना ।
परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:

यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः ।
तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः ॥
verses.transliteration:

tasyāhaṃ sulabhaḥ pārtha nityayuktasya yoginaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! jo ananyachitta vaalaa purusha meraa smarana karataa hai, usa nityayukta yogee ke lie main sulabha hoon arthaat sahaja hee praapta ho jaataa hoon

verses.sanskrit:
मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् ।

verses.transliteration:

verses.hinglishMeaning: Parama siddhi ko praapta huye mahatmajana mujhey praapta kara anitya duhkha ke aalayaroopa (griharoopa) punarjanma ko naheen praapta hote hain

verses.sanskrit:

verses.sanskrit:

verses.transliteration:

summary: The ninth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Raja Vidya Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna explains that He is Supreme and how this material existence is created, maintained and destroyed by His Yogmaya and all beings come and go under his supervision. He reveals the Role and the Importance of Bhakti (transcendental devotional service) towards our Spiritual Awakening. In such devotion, one must live for the God, offer everything that he possesses to Him and do everything for Him only. One who follows such devotion becomes free from the bonds of this material world and unites with the Lord.

prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam

verses.sanskrit:

अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन ॥

verses.sanskrit:

यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते ।
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक-
मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान् ॥

te puṇyamāsādya surendralokaṃ aśnanti divyāndivi devabhogān
verses.hinglishMeaning: Teenon vedon ke jnyaataa (vedokta sakaama karma karane vaale), somapaana karane vaale evan paapon se pavitra hue purusha mujhey yajnyon ke dvaaraa poojakara svarga praapti chaahate hain; ve purusha apane punyon ke phalaroopa indraloka ko praapta kara svarga men divya devataaon ke bhoga bhogate hain

क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति ।
एवं त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना
गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
te taṃ bhuktvā svargalokaṃ viśālaṃ kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti.
evaṃ trayīdharmamanuprapannā gatāgataṃ kāmakāmā labhante
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ve usa vishaala svargaloka ko bhogakara, punyaksheena hone para, mrityuloka ko praapta hote hain. isa prakaara teenon vedon men kahey gaye karma ke sharana hue aura bhogon kee kaamanaa vaale purusha aavaagamana (gataagata) ko praapta hote hain

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते ।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ananyāścintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate.
teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ananya bhaava se meraa chintana karate hue jo bhaktajana meree hee upaasanaa karate hain, una nityayukta purushon kaa yogakshema main vahana karataa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Ananya bhaava se meraa chintana karate hue jo bhaktajana meree hee upaasanaa karate hain, una nityayukta purushon kaa yogakshema main vahana karataa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 9 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sarvottam rahasya yeh hai ki prem-bhakti se Bhagavan sabke nikat hain.

verses.sanskrit:
येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः ।
तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye.apyanyadevatābhaktā yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ.
te.api māmeva kaunteya yajantyavidhipūrvakam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kaunteya ! shraddhaa se yukta jo bhakta anya devataaon ko poojate hain, ve bhee mujhey hee avidhipoorvaka poojate hain

verses.sanskrit:
अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च ।
न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca.
na tu māmabhijānanti tattvenātaścyavanti te
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kyonki saba yajnyon kaa bhoktaa aura svaamee main hee hoon, parantu ve mujhey tattvata: naheen jaanate hain, isalie ve girate hain, arthaat sansaara ko praapta hote hain

verses.sanskrit:

verses.transliteration:

bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino.api mām
verses.hinglishMeaning: Devataaon ke poojaka devataaon ko praapta hote hain, pitarapoojaka pitaron ko jaate hain, bhooton kaa yajana karane vaale bhooton ko praapta hote hain aura mujhey poojane vaale bhakta mujhey hee praapta hote hain

तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo koee bhee bhakta mere lie patra, pushpa, phala, jala aadi bhakti se arpana karataa hai, usa shuddha mana ke bhakta kaa vaha bhaktipoorvaka arpana kiyaa huaa (patra pushpaadi) main bhogataa hoon arthaat sveekaara karataa hoon

यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.transliteration:

verses.transliteration:

verses.sanskrit:
क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति ।
कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kaunteya, vaha sheeghra hee dharmatma bana jaataa hai aura shaashvata shaanti ko praapta hotaa hai. tuma nishchayapoorvaka satya jaano ki meraa bhakta kabhee nashta naheen hotaa

स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste.api yānti parāṃ gatim
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! stree, vaishya aura shoodra ye jo koee paapayoni vaale hon, ve bhee mujha para aashrita (mere sharana) hokara parama gati ko praapta hote hain

अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम् ॥

anityamasukhaṃ lokamimaṃ prāpya bhajasva mām

verses.sanskrit:
