summary: The tenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Vibhooti Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna reveals Himself as the cause of all causes. He describes His various manifestations and opulences in order to increase Arjuna's Bhakti. Arjuna is fully convinced of Lord's paramount position and proclaims him to be the Supreme Personality. He prays to Krishna to describe more of His divine glories which are like nectar to hear.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
भूय एव महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः ।
यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
bhūya eva mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ.
yatte.ahaṃ prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hitakāmyayā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- hey mahaabaaho ! puna: tuma mere parama vachanon kaa shravana karo, jo main tujha atishaya prema rakhane vaale ke liye hita kee ichchhaa se kahoongaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- hey mahaabaaho ! puna: tuma mere parama vachanon kaa shravana karo, jo main tujha atishaya prema rakhane vaale ke liye hita kee ichchhaa se kahoongaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः ।
अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः ॥
verses.transliteration:
na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ.
ahamādirhi devānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Meree utpatti (prabhava) ko na devataagana jaanate hain aura na maharshijana; kyonki main saba prakaara se devataaon aura maharshiyon kaa bhee aadikaarana hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Meree utpatti (prabhava) ko na devataagana jaanate hain aura na maharshijana; kyonki main saba prakaara se devataaon aura maharshiyon kaa bhee aadikaarana hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम् ।
असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo māmajamanādiṃ ca vetti lokamaheśvaram.
asammūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo mujhey ajanmaa, anaadi aura lokon ke mahaan eeshvara ke roopa men jaanataa hai, rmatya manushyon men aisaa sanmoharahita (jnyaanee) purusha saba paapon se mukta ho jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo mujhey ajanmaa, anaadi aura lokon ke mahaan eeshvara ke roopa men jaanataa hai, rmatya manushyon men aisaa sanmoharahita (jnyaanee) purusha saba paapon se mukta ho jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसम्मोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः ।
सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च ॥
verses.transliteration:
buddhirjñānamasammohaḥ kṣamā satyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ.
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavo.abhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayameva ca
verses.hinglishMeaning: Buddhi, jnyaana, moha kaa abhaava, kshamaa, satya, dama (indriya sanyama), shama (mana: sanyama), sukha, du:kha, janma aura mrityu, bhaya aura abhaya
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Buddhi, jnyaana, moha kaa abhaava, kshamaa, satya, dama (indriya sanyama), shama (mana: sanyama), sukha, du:kha, janma aura mrityu, bhaya aura abhaya. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः ।
भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahiṃsā samatā tuṣṭistapo dānaṃ yaśo.ayaśaḥ.
bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ahinsaa, samataa, santosha, tapa, daana. yasha aura apayasha aise ye praaniyon ke naanaavidha bhaava mujha se hee prakata hote hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Ahinsaa, samataa, santosha, tapa, daana. yasha aura apayasha aise ye praaniyon ke naanaavidha bhaava mujha se hee prakata hote hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा ।
मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
maharṣayaḥ sapta pūrve catvāro manavastathā.
madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Saata maharshijana, poorvakaala ke chaara (sanakaadi) tathaa (chaudaha) manu ye mere prabhaava vaale mere sankalpa se utpanna hue hain, jinakee sansaara (loka) men yaha prajaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Saata maharshijana, poorvakaala ke chaara (sanakaadi) tathaa (chaudaha) manu ye mere prabhaava vaale mere sankalpa se utpanna hue hain, jinakee sansaara (loka) men yaha prajaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ।
सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ.
so.avikampena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha isa meree vibhooti aura yoga ko tattva se jaanataa hai, vaha purusha avikampa yoga (arthaat nishchala dhyaana yoga) se yukta ho jaataa hai, isamen kuchha bhee sanshaya naheen hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha isa meree vibhooti aura yoga ko tattva se jaanataa hai, vaha purusha avikampa yoga (arthaat nishchala dhyaana yoga) se yukta ho jaataa hai, isamen kuchha bhee sanshaya naheen hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते ।
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate.
iti matvā bhajante māṃ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main hee sabakaa prabhava sthaana hoon; mujhase hee saba (jagat) vikaasa ko praapta hotaa hai, isa prakaara jaanakara budhajana bhakti bhaava se yukta hokara mujhey hee bhajate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main hee sabakaa prabhava sthaana hoon; mujhase hee saba (jagat) vikaasa ko praapta hotaa hai, isa prakaara jaanakara budhajana bhakti bhaava se yukta hokara mujhey hee bhajate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम् ।
कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ॥
verses.transliteration:
maccittā madgataprāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam.
kathayantaśca māṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca
verses.hinglishMeaning: Mujhamen hee chitta ko sthira karane vaale aura mujhamen hee praanon (indriyon) ko arpita karane vaale bhaktajana, sadaiva paraspara meraa bodha karaate hue, mere hee vishaya men kathana karate hue santushta hote hain aura ramate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Mujhamen hee chitta ko sthira karane vaale aura mujhamen hee praanon (indriyon) ko arpita karane vaale bhaktajana, sadaiva paraspara meraa bodha karaate hue, mere hee vishaya men kathana karate hue santushta hote hain aura ramate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ।
ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṃ satatayuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prītipūrvakam.
dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te
verses.hinglishMeaning: Una (mujha se) nitya yukta hue aura premapoorvaka meraa bhajana karane vaale bhakton ko, main vaha 'buddhiyoga' detaa hoon jisase ve mujhey praapta hote hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Una (mujha se) nitya yukta hue aura premapoorvaka meraa bhajana karane vaale bhakton ko, main vaha 'buddhiyoga' detaa hoon jisase ve mujhey praapta hote hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः ।
नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता ॥
verses.transliteration:
teṣāmevānukampārthamahamajñānajaṃ tamaḥ.
nāśayāmyātmabhāvastho jñānadīpena bhāsvatā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Unake oopara anugraha karane ke lie main unake anta:karana men sthita hokara, ajnyaanajanita andhakaara ko prakaashamaya jnyaana ke deepaka dvaaraa nashta karataa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Unake oopara anugraha karane ke lie main unake anta:karana men sthita hokara, ajnyaanajanita andhakaara ko prakaashamaya jnyaana ke deepaka dvaaraa nashta karataa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान् ।
पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca.
paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān.
puruṣaṃ śāśvataṃ divyamādidevamajaṃ vibhum
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kahaa aapa -parama brahma, parama dhaama aura parama pavitra hanai; sanaatana divya purusha, devon ke bhee aadi deva, janma rahita aura sarvavyaapee hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Arjun ne kahaa aapa -parama brahma, parama dhaama aura parama pavitra hanai; sanaatana divya purusha, devon ke bhee aadi deva, janma rahita aura sarvavyaapee hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा ।
असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
āhustvāmṛṣayaḥ sarve devarṣirnāradastathā.
asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aisaa aapako samasta rishijana kahate hain; vaise hee devarshi naarada, asita, devala rishi tathaa vyaasa aura svayan aapa bhee mere prati kahate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Aisaa aapako samasta rishijana kahate hain; vaise hee devarshi naarada, asita, devala rishi tathaa vyaasa aura svayan aapa bhee mere prati kahate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव ।
न हि ते भगवन्व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvametadṛtaṃ manye yanmāṃ vadasi keśava.
na hi te bhagavanvyaktiṃ vidurdevā na dānavāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey keshava ! jo kuchha bhee aapa mere prati kahate hain, isa sabako main satya maanataa hoon. hey bhagavan, aapake (vaastavika) svaroopa ko na devataa jaanate hain aura na daanava
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey keshava ! jo kuchha bhee aapa mere prati kahate hain, isa sabako main satya maanataa hoon. hey bhagavan, aapake (vaastavika) svaroopa ko na devataa jaanate hain aura na daanava. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वयमेवात्मनात्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम ।
भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते ॥
verses.transliteration:
svayamevātmanātmānaṃ vettha tvaṃ puruṣottama.
bhūtabhāvana bhūteśa devadeva jagatpate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey purushottama ! hey bhootabhaavana ! hey bhootesha ! hey devon ke deva ! hey jagat ke svaamee ! aapa svayan hee apane aapa ko jaanate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey purushottama ! hey bhootabhaavana ! hey bhootesha ! hey devon ke deva ! hey jagat ke svaamee ! aapa svayan hee apane aapa ko jaanate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः ।
याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
vaktumarhasyaśeṣeṇa divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ.
yābhirvibhūtibhirlokānimāṃstvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhasi
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aapa hee una apanee divya vibhootiyon ko asheshata: kahane ke lie yogya hain, jina vibhootiyon ke dvaaraa ina samasta lokon ko aapa vyaapta karake sthita hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Aapa hee una apanee divya vibhootiyon ko asheshata: kahane ke lie yogya hain, jina vibhootiyon ke dvaaraa ina samasta lokon ko aapa vyaapta karake sthita hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन् ।
केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया ॥
verses.transliteration:
kathaṃ vidyāmahaṃ yogiṃstvāṃ sadā paricintayan.
keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo.asi bhagavanmayā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey yogeshvara ! main kisa prakaara nirantara chintana karataa huaa aapako jaanoon, aura hey bhagavan ! aapa kinakina bhaavon men mere dvaaraa chintana karane yogya hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey yogeshvara ! main kisa prakaara nirantara chintana karataa huaa aapako jaanoon, aura hey bhagavan ! aapa kinakina bhaavon men mere dvaaraa chintana karane yogya hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन ।
भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि शृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vistareṇātmano yogaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca janārdana.
bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptirhi śṛṇvato nāsti me.amṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey janaardana ! apanee yoga shakti aura vibhooti ko puna: vistaarapoorvaka kahie, kyonki aapake amritamaya vachanon ko sunate hue mujhey tripti naheen hotee
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey janaardana ! apanee yoga shakti aura vibhooti ko puna: vistaarapoorvaka kahie, kyonki aapake amritamaya vachanon ko sunate hue mujhey tripti naheen hotee. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः ।
प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ.
prādhānyataḥ kuruśreṣṭha nāstyanto vistarasya me
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -hanta aba main tumhen apanee divya vibhootiyon ko pradhaanataa se kahoongaa. hey kurushreshtha mere vistaara kaa anta naheen hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -hanta aba main tumhen apanee divya vibhootiyon ko pradhaanataa se kahoongaa. hey kurushreshtha mere vistaara kaa anta naheen hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः ।
अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahamātmā guḍākeśa sarvabhūtāśayasthitaḥ.
ahamādiśca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey gudaakesha (nidraajit) ! main samasta bhooton ke hridaya men sthita sabakee atma hoon tathaa sampoorna bhooton kaa aadi, madhya aura anta bhee main hee hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey gudaakesha (nidraajit) ! main samasta bhooton ke hridaya men sthita sabakee atma hoon tathaa sampoorna bhooton kaa aadi, madhya aura anta bhee main hee hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान् ।
मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी ॥
verses.transliteration:
ādityānāmahaṃ viṣṇurjyotiṣāṃ raviraṃśumān.
marīcirmarutāmasmi nakṣatrāṇāmahaṃ śaśī

verses.sanskrit:
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः ।
इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना ॥
verses.transliteration:
vedānāṃ sāmavedo.asmi devānāmasmi vāsavaḥ.
indriyāṇāṃ manaścāsmi bhūtānāmasmi cetanā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main vedon men saamaveda hoon, devon men vaasava (indra) hoon; main indriyon men mana aura bhootapraaniyon men chetanaa (jnyaanashakti) hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main vedon men saamaveda hoon, devon men vaasava (indra) hoon; main indriyon men mana aura bhootapraaniyon men chetanaa (jnyaanashakti) hoon. verses.sanskrit:
रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम् ।
वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
rudrāṇāṃ śaṅkaraścāsmi vitteśo yakṣarakṣasām.
vasūnāṃ pāvakaścāsmi meruḥ śikhariṇāmaham
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main (gyaaraha) rudron men shankara hoon aura yaksha tathaa raakshason men dhanapati kubera (vittesha) hoon; (aatha) vasuon men agni hoon tathaa shikhara vaale parvaton men meru hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main (gyaaraha) rudron men shankara hoon aura yaksha tathaa raakshason men dhanapati kubera (vittesha) hoon; (aatha) vasuon men agni hoon tathaa shikhara vaale parvaton men meru hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम् ।
सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः ॥
verses.transliteration:
purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim.
senānīnāmahaṃ skandaḥ sarasāmasmi sāgaraḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! purohiton men mujhey brihaspati jaano; main senaapatiyon men skanda aura jalaashayon men samudra hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey paartha ! purohiton men mujhey brihaspati jaano; main senaapatiyon men skanda aura jalaashayon men samudra hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम् ।
यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛgurahaṃ girāmasmyekamakṣaram.
yajñānāṃ japayajño.asmi sthāvarāṇāṃ himālayaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main maharshiyon men bhrigu aura vaanee (shabdon) men ekaakshara onkaara hoon. main yajnyon men japayajnya aura sthaavaron (achalon) men himaalaya hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main maharshiyon men bhrigu aura vaanee (shabdon) men ekaakshara onkaara hoon. main yajnyon men japayajnya aura sthaavaron (achalon) men himaalaya hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः ।
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ.
gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main samasta vrikshon men ashvattha (peepala) hoon aura devarshiyon men naarada hoon; main gandharvon men chitraratha aura siddha purushon men kapila muni hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main samasta vrikshon men ashvattha (peepala) hoon aura devarshiyon men naarada hoon; main gandharvon men chitraratha aura siddha purushon men kapila muni hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम् ।
ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
uccaiḥśravasamaśvānāṃ viddhi māmamṛtodbhavam.
airāvataṃ gajendrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca narādhipam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ashvon men amrita se utpanna hue uchchaishravaa naamaka ashva, haathiyon men airaavata aura manushyon men raajaa mujhey hee jaano
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Ashvon men amrita se utpanna hue uchchaishravaa naamaka ashva, haathiyon men airaavata aura manushyon men raajaa mujhey hee jaano. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक् ।
प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
āyudhānāmahaṃ vajraṃ dhenūnāmasmi kāmadhuk.
prajanaścāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇāmasmi vāsukiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main shastron men vajra aura dhenuon (gaayon) men kaamadhenu hoon, prajaa utpatti kaa hetu kandarpa (kaamadeva) main hoon aura sarpon men vaasuki hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main shastron men vajra aura dhenuon (gaayon) men kaamadhenu hoon, prajaa utpatti kaa hetu kandarpa (kaamadeva) main hoon aura sarpon men vaasuki hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम् ।
पितॄणामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
anantaścāsmi nāgānāṃ varuṇo yādasāmaham.
pitṝṇāmaryamā cāsmi yamaḥ saṃyamatāmaham
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main naagon men ananta (sheshanaaga) hoon aura jala devataaon men varuna hoon; main pitaron men aryamaa han aura niyamana karane vaalon men yama hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main naagon men ananta (sheshanaaga) hoon aura jala devataaon men varuna hoon; main pitaron men aryamaa han aura niyamana karane vaalon men yama hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम् ।
मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prahlādaścāsmi daityānāṃ kālaḥ kalayatāmaham.
mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendro.ahaṃ vainateyaśca pakṣiṇām
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main daityon men prahlaada aura gananaa karane vaalon men kaala hoon, main 'pashuon' men sinha (mrigendra) aura pakshiyon men garuda hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main daityon men prahlaada aura gananaa karane vaalon men kaala hoon, main 'pashuon' men sinha (mrigendra) aura pakshiyon men garuda hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम् ।
झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी ॥
verses.transliteration:
pavanaḥ pavatāmasmi rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmaham.
jhaṣāṇāṃ makaraścāsmi srotasāmasmi jāhnavī
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main pavitra karane vaalon men vaayu hoon aura shastradhaariyon men raama hoon; tathaa matsyon (jalacharon) men main magaramachchha aura nadiyon men main gangaa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main pavitra karane vaalon men vaayu hoon aura shastradhaariyon men raama hoon; tathaa matsyon (jalacharon) men main magaramachchha aura nadiyon men main gangaa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन ।
अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sargāṇāmādirantaśca madhyaṃ caivāhamarjuna.
adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ vādaḥ pravadatāmaham
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun ! srishtiyon kaa aadi, anta aura madhya bhee main hee hoon, main vidyaaon men adhyaatmavidyaa aura vivaada karane vaalon men (arthaat vivaada ke prakaaron men) main vaada hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey Arjun ! srishtiyon kaa aadi, anta aura madhya bhee main hee hoon, main vidyaaon men adhyaatmavidyaa aura vivaada karane vaalon men (arthaat vivaada ke prakaaron men) main vaada hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च ।
अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुखः ॥
verses.transliteration:
akṣarāṇāmakāro.asmi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca.
ahamevākṣayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṃ viśvatomukhaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main aksharon (varnamaalaa) men akaara aura samaason men dvandva (naamaka samaasa) hoon; main akshaya kaala aura vishvatomukha (viraat svaroopa) dhaataa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main aksharon (varnamaalaa) men akaara aura samaason men dvandva (naamaka samaasa) hoon; main akshaya kaala aura vishvatomukha (viraat svaroopa) dhaataa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् ।
कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा ॥
verses.transliteration:
mṛtyuḥ sarvaharaścāhamudbhavaśca bhaviṣyatām.
kīrtiḥ śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main sarvabhakshaka mrityu aura bhavishya men hone vaalon kee utpatti kaa kaarana hoon; striyon men keerti, shree, vaaka (vaanee), smriti, medhaa, dhriti aura kshamaa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main sarvabhakshaka mrityu aura bhavishya men hone vaalon kee utpatti kaa kaarana hoon; striyon men keerti, shree, vaaka (vaanee), smriti, medhaa, dhriti aura kshamaa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम् ।
मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bṛhatsāma tathā sāmnāṃ gāyatrī chandasāmaham.
māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo.ahamṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Saamon (geya mantron) men main brihatsaama aura chhandon men gaayatree chhanda hoon; main maason men maargasheersha (disambarajanavaree ke bhaaga) aura rituon men vasanta hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Saamon (geya mantron) men main brihatsaama aura chhandon men gaayatree chhanda hoon; main maason men maargasheersha (disambarajanavaree ke bhaaga) aura rituon men vasanta hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ।
जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dyūtaṃ chalayatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham.
jayo.asmi vyavasāyo.asmi sattvaṃ sattvavatāmaham
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main chhala karane vaalon men dyoota hoon aura tejasviyon men teja hoon, main vijaya hoon; main vyavasaaya (udyamasheelataa) hoon aura saatvika purushon kaa saatvika bhaava hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main chhala karane vaalon men dyoota hoon aura tejasviyon men teja hoon, main vijaya hoon; main vyavasaaya (udyamasheelataa) hoon aura saatvika purushon kaa saatvika bhaava hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनञ्जयः ।
मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः ॥
verses.transliteration:
vṛṣṇīnāṃ vāsudevo.asmi pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanañjayaḥ.
munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāsaḥ kavīnāmuśanā kaviḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main vrishniyon men vaasudeva hoon aura paandavon men dhananjaya, main muniyon men vyaasa aura kaviyon men ushanaa kavi hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main vrishniyon men vaasudeva hoon aura paandavon men dhananjaya, main muniyon men vyaasa aura kaviyon men ushanaa kavi hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम् ।
मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
daṇḍo damayatāmasmi nītirasmi jigīṣatām.
maunaṃ caivāsmi guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatāmaham
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main damana karane vaalon kaa danda hoon aura vijayechchhuon kee neeti hoon; main guhyon men mauna hoon aura jnyaanavaanon kaa jnyaana hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main damana karane vaalon kaa danda hoon aura vijayechchhuon kee neeti hoon; main guhyon men mauna hoon aura jnyaanavaanon kaa jnyaana hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन ।
न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaccāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ bījaṃ tadahamarjuna.
na tadasti vinā yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun ! jo samasta bhooton kee utpatti kaa beeja (kaarana) hai, vaha bhee men hee hoon, kyonki aisaa koee chara aura achara bhoota naheen hai, jo mujhase rahita hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey Arjun ! jo samasta bhooton kee utpatti kaa beeja (kaarana) hai, vaha bhee men hee hoon, kyonki aisaa koee chara aura achara bhoota naheen hai, jo mujhase rahita hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परन्तप ।
एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया ॥
verses.transliteration:
nānto.asti mama divyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ parantapa.
eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūtervistaro mayā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey parantapa ! meree divya vibhootiyon kaa anta naheen hai; apanee vibhootiyon kaa yaha vistaara mainne eka desha se arthaat sankshepa men kahaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey parantapa ! meree divya vibhootiyon kaa anta naheen hai; apanee vibhootiyon kaa yaha vistaara mainne eka desha se arthaat sankshepa men kahaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 10 ke mool vishay se juda hai: Bhagavan ki vibhutiyon ko pehchankar bhakti aur adbhut-bhav badhata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा ।
तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā.
tattadevāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejoṃśasambhavam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo koee bhee vibhootiyukta, kaantiyukta athavaa shaktiyukta vastu (yaa praanee) hai, usako tuma mere teja ke ansha se hee utpanna huee jaano
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo koee bhee vibhootiyukta, kaantiyukta athavaa shaktiyukta vastu (yaa praanee) hai, usako tuma mere teja ke ansha se hee utpanna huee jaano. verses.sanskrit:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन ।
विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
athavā bahunaitena kiṃ jñātena tavārjuna.
viṣṭabhyāhamidaṃ kṛtsnamekāṃśena sthito jagat
verses.hinglishMeaning: Athavaa hey Arjun ! bahuta jaanane se tumhaaraa kyaa prayojana hai? main isa sampoorna jagat ko apane eka ansha maatra se dhaarana karake sthita hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Athavaa hey Arjun ! bahuta jaanane se tumhaaraa kyaa prayojana hai? main isa sampoorna jagat ko apane eka ansha maatra se dhaarana karake sthita hoon. summary: The eleventh chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga. In this chapter, Arjuna requests Krishna to reveal His Universal Cosmic Form that encompasses all the universes, the entire existence. Arjuna is granted divine vision to be able to see the entirety of creation in the body of the Supreme Lord Krishna.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् ।
यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम ॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca.
madanugrahāya paramaṃ guhyamadhyātmasaṃjñitam.
yattvayoktaṃ vacastena moho.ayaṃ vigato mama
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kahaa -- mujha para anugraha karane ke lie jo parama gopaneeya, adhyaatmavishayaka vachana (upadesha) aapake dvaaraa kahaa gayaa, usase meraa moha doora ho gayaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Arjun ne kahaa -- mujha para anugraha karane ke lie jo parama gopaneeya, adhyaatmavishayaka vachana (upadesha) aapake dvaaraa kahaa gayaa, usase meraa moha doora ho gayaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया ।
त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṃ śrutau vistaraśo mayā.
tvattaḥ kamalapatrākṣa māhātmyamapi cāvyayam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kamalanayana ! mainne bhooton kee utpatti aura pralaya aapase vistaarapoorvaka sune hain tathaa aapakaa avyaya maahaatmya (prabhaava) bhee sunaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey kamalanayana ! mainne bhooton kee utpatti aura pralaya aapase vistaarapoorvaka sune hain tathaa aapakaa avyaya maahaatmya (prabhaava) bhee sunaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर ।
द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम ॥
verses.transliteration:
evametadyathāttha tvamātmānaṃ parameśvara.
draṣṭumicchāmi te rūpamaiśvaraṃ puruṣottama
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey parameshvara ! aapa apane ko jaisaa kahate ho, yaha theeka aisaa hee hai. (parantu) hey purushottama ! main aapake eeshvareeya roopa ko pratyaksha dekhanaa chaahataa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey parameshvara ! aapa apane ko jaisaa kahate ho, yaha theeka aisaa hee hai. (parantu) hey purushottama ! main aapake eeshvareeya roopa ko pratyaksha dekhanaa chaahataa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो ।
योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयात्मानमव्ययम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
manyase yadi tacchakyaṃ mayā draṣṭumiti prabho.
yogeśvara tato me tvaṃ darśayātmānamavyayam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey prabho ! yadi aapa maanate hain ki mere dvaaraa vaha aapakaa roopa dekhaa jaanaa sanbhava hai, to hey yogeshvara ! aapa apane avyaya roopa kaa darshana karaaiye
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey prabho ! yadi aapa maanate hain ki mere dvaaraa vaha aapakaa roopa dekhaa jaanaa sanbhava hai, to hey yogeshvara ! aapa apane avyaya roopa kaa darshana karaaiye. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ।
नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo.atha sahasraśaḥ.
nānāvidhāni divyāni nānāvarṇākṛtīni ca
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- hey paartha ! mere saikadon tathaa sahasron naanaa prakaara ke aura naanaa varna tathaa aakriti vaale divya roopon ko dekho
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- hey paartha ! mere saikadon tathaa sahasron naanaa prakaara ke aura naanaa varna tathaa aakriti vaale divya roopon ko dekho. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा ।
बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याश्चर्याणि भारत ॥
verses.transliteration:
paśyādityānvasūnrudrānaśvinau marutastathā.
bahūnyadṛṣṭapūrvāṇi paśyāścaryāṇi bhārata
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bhaarata ! (mujhamen) aadityon, vasuon, rudron tathaa ashvineekumaaron aura marudganon ko dekho, tathaa aura bhee aneka isake poorva kabhee na dekhey hue aashcharyon ko dekho
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey bhaarata ! (mujhamen) aadityon, vasuon, rudron tathaa ashvineekumaaron aura marudganon ko dekho, tathaa aura bhee aneka isake poorva kabhee na dekhey hue aashcharyon ko dekho. verses.sanskrit:
इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम् ।
मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद् द्रष्टुमिच्छसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ihaikasthaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ paśyādya sacarācaram.
mama dehe guḍākeśa yaccānyad draṣṭumicchasi
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey gudaakesha ! aaja (aba) isa mere shareera men eka sthaana para sthita hue charaachara sahita sampoorna jagat ko dekho tathaa aura bhee jo kuchha tuma dekhanaa chaahate ho, use bhee dekho
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey gudaakesha ! aaja (aba) isa mere shareera men eka sthaana para sthita hue charaachara sahita sampoorna jagat ko dekho tathaa aura bhee jo kuchha tuma dekhanaa chaahate ho, use bhee dekho. verses.sanskrit:
न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा ।
दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
na tu māṃ śakyase draṣṭumanenaiva svacakṣuṣā.
divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me yogamaiśvaram
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parantu tuma apane inheen (praakrita) netron ke dvaaraa mujhey dekhane men samartha naheen ho; (isalie) main tumhen divyachakshu detaa hoon, jisase tuma mere eeshvareeya 'yoga' ko dekho

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः ।
दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca.
evamuktvā tato rājanmahāyogeśvaro hariḥ.
darśayāmāsa pārthāya paramaṃ rūpamaiśvaram
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sanjaya ne kahaa -- hey raajan ! mahaayogeshvara hari ne isa prakaara kahakara phira Arjun ke lie parama aishvaryayukta roopa ko darshaayaa

verses.sanskrit:
अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम् ।
अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
anekavaktranayanamanekādbhutadarśanam.
anekadivyābharaṇaṃ divyānekodyatāyudham
verses.hinglishMeaning: Usa aneka mukha aura netron se yukta tathaa aneka adbhuta darshanon vaale evan bahuta se divya bhooshanon se yukta aura bahuta se divya shastron ko haathon men uthaaye huye

verses.sanskrit:
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् ।
सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ divyagandhānulepanam.
sarvāścaryamayaṃ devamanantaṃ viśvatomukham
verses.hinglishMeaning: Divya maalaa aura vastron ko dhaarana kiye huye aura divya gandha kaa lepana kiye huye evan samasta prakaara ke aashcharyon se yukta ananta, vishvatomukha (viraat svaroopa) parama deva (ko Arjun ne dekhaa)

verses.sanskrit:
दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता ।
यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
divi sūryasahasrasya bhavedyugapadutthitā.
yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syādbhāsastasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aakaasha men sahasra sooryon ke eka saatha udaya hone se utpanna jo prakaasha hogaa, vaha usa (vishvaroopa) paramatma ke prakaasha ke sadrisha hogaa

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा ।
अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा ॥
verses.transliteration:
tatraikasthaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ pravibhaktamanekadhā.
apaśyaddevadevasya śarīre pāṇḍavastadā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Paanduputra Arjun ne usa samaya aneka prakaara se vibhakta hue sampoorna jagat ko devon ke deva shreeKrishna ke shareera men eka sthaana para sthita dekhaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Paanduputra Arjun ne usa samaya aneka prakaara se vibhakta hue sampoorna jagat ko devon ke deva shreeKrishna ke shareera men eka sthaana para sthita dekhaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनञ्जयः ।
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत ॥
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo hṛṣṭaromā dhanañjayaḥ.
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata
verses.hinglishMeaning: Usake uparaanta vaha aashcharyachakita huaa harshita romon vaalaa (jise romaancha kaa anubhava ho rahaa ho) dhananjaya Arjun vishvaroopa deva ko (shraddhaa bhakti sahita) shira se pranaama karake haatha jodakara bolaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Usake uparaanta vaha aashcharyachakita huaa harshita romon vaalaa (jise romaancha kaa anubhava ho rahaa ho) dhananjaya Arjun vishvaroopa deva ko (shraddhaa bhakti sahita) shira se pranaama karake haatha jodakara bolaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे
सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान् ।
ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थ-
मृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca.
paśyāmi devāṃstava deva dehe sarvāṃstathā bhūtaviśeṣasaṅghān.
brahmāṇamīśaṃ kamalāsanasthaṃ ṛṣīṃśca sarvānuragāṃśca divyān
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kahaa -- hey deva! main aapake shareera men samasta devon ko tathaa aneka bhootavisheshon ke samudaayon ko aura kamalaasana para sthita srishti ke svaamee brahmaajee ko, rishiyon ko aura divya sarpon ko dekha rahaa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Arjun ne kahaa -- hey deva! main aapake shareera men samasta devon ko tathaa aneka bhootavisheshon ke samudaayon ko aura kamalaasana para sthita srishti ke svaamee brahmaajee ko, rishiyon ko aura divya sarpon ko dekha rahaa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं
पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम् ।
नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं
पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप ॥
verses.transliteration:
anekabāhūdaravaktranetraṃ paśyāmi tvāṃ sarvato.anantarūpam.
nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ na punastavādiṃ paśyāmi viśveśvara viśvarūpa
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey vishveshvara! main aapakee aneka baahu, udara, mukha aura netron se yukta tathaa saba ora se ananta roopon vaalaa dekhataa hoon. hey vishvaroopa! main aapake na anta ko dekhataa hoon aura na madhya ko aura na aadi ko
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey vishveshvara! main aapakee aneka baahu, udara, mukha aura netron se yukta tathaa saba ora se ananta roopon vaalaa dekhataa hoon. hey vishvaroopa! main aapake na anta ko dekhataa hoon aura na madhya ko aura na aadi ko. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च
तेजोराशिं सर्वतो दीप्तिमन्तम् ।
पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ताद्
दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakriṇaṃ ca tejorāśiṃ sarvato dīptimantam.
paśyāmi tvāṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ samantād dīptānalārkadyutimaprameyam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main aapakaa mukutayukta, gadaayukta aura chakradhaarana kiye huye tathaa saba ora se prakaashamaan teja kaa punja, deepta agni aura soorya ke samaana jyotirmaya, dekhane men ati kathina aura aprameyasvaroopa saba ora se dekhataa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main aapakaa mukutayukta, gadaayukta aura chakradhaarana kiye huye tathaa saba ora se prakaashamaan teja kaa punja, deepta agni aura soorya ke samaana jyotirmaya, dekhane men ati kathina aura aprameyasvaroopa saba ora se dekhataa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं
त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् ।
त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता
सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ tvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam.
tvamavyayaḥ śāśvatadharmagoptā sanātanastvaṃ puruṣo mato me
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aapa hee jaanane yogya (veditavyam) parama akshara hain; aapa hee isa vishva ke parama aashraya (nidhaana) hain ! aapa hee shaashvata dharma ke rakshaka hain aura aapa hee sanaatana purusha hain,aisaa meraa mata hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Aapa hee jaanane yogya (veditavyam) parama akshara hain; aapa hee isa vishva ke parama aashraya (nidhaana) hain ! aapa hee shaashvata dharma ke rakshaka hain aura aapa hee sanaatana purusha hain,aisaa meraa mata hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य-
मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम् ।
पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रं
स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
anādimadhyāntamanantavīryam anantabāhuṃ śaśisūryanetram.
paśyāmi tvāṃ dīptahutāśavaktraṃ svatejasā viśvamidaṃ tapantam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main aapako aadi, anta aura madhya se rahita tathaa ananta saarmathya se yukta aura ananta baahuon vaalaa tathaa chandrasooryaroopee netron vaalaa aura deepta agniroopee mukha vaalaa tathaa apane teja se isa vishva ko tapaate hue dekhataa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Main aapako aadi, anta aura madhya se rahita tathaa ananta saarmathya se yukta aura ananta baahuon vaalaa tathaa chandrasooryaroopee netron vaalaa aura deepta agniroopee mukha vaalaa tathaa apane teja se isa vishva ko tapaate hue dekhataa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि
व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः ।
दृष्ट्वाद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं
लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dyāvāpṛthivyoridamantaraṃ hi vyāptaṃ tvayaikena diśaśca sarvāḥ.
dṛṣṭvādbhutaṃ rūpamugraṃ tavedaṃ lokatrayaṃ pravyathitaṃ mahātman
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey mahaatman ! svarga aura prithvee ke madhya kaa yaha aakaasha tathaa samasta dishaaen akele aapa se hee vyaapta hain; aapake isa adbhuta aura ugra roopa ko dekhakara teenon loka ativyathaa (bhaya) ko praapta ho rahey hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey mahaatman ! svarga aura prithvee ke madhya kaa yaha aakaasha tathaa samasta dishaaen akele aapa se hee vyaapta hain; aapake isa adbhuta aura ugra roopa ko dekhakara teenon loka ativyathaa (bhaya) ko praapta ho rahey hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घा विशन्ति
केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति ।
स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाः
स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
amī hi tvāṃ surasaṅghā viśanti kecidbhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛṇanti.
svastītyuktvā maharṣisiddhasaṅghāḥ stuvanti tvāṃ stutibhiḥ puṣkalābhiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ye samasta devataaon ke samooha aapa men hee pravesha kara rahey hain aura kaee eka bhayabheeta hokara haatha jode hue aapa kee stuti karate hain; maharshi aura siddhon ke samudaaya 'kalyaana hove' (svastivaachana karate hue) aisaa kahakara, uttama (yaa sampoorna) sroton dvaaraa aapakee stuti karate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Ye samasta devataaon ke samooha aapa men hee pravesha kara rahey hain aura kaee eka bhayabheeta hokara haatha jode hue aapa kee stuti karate hain; maharshi aura siddhon ke samudaaya 'kalyaana hove' (svastivaachana karate hue) aisaa kahakara, uttama (yaa sampoorna) sroton dvaaraa aapakee stuti karate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या
विश्वेऽश्विनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च ।
गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घा
वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
rudrādityā vasavo ye ca sādhyā viśve.aśvinau marutaścoṣmapāśca.
gandharvayakṣāsurasiddhasaṅghā vīkṣante tvāṃ vismitāścaiva sarve
verses.hinglishMeaning: Rudragana, aaditya, vasu aura saadhyagana, vishvedeva tathaa do ashvineekumaara, marudgana aura ushmapaa, gandharva, yaksha, asura aura siddhaganon ke samudaaya- ye saba hee vismita hote hue aapako dekhate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Rudragana, aaditya, vasu aura saadhyagana, vishvedeva tathaa do ashvineekumaara, marudgana aura ushmapaa, gandharva, yaksha, asura aura siddhaganon ke samudaaya- ye saba hee vismita hote hue aapako dekhate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं
महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम् ।
बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं
दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
rūpaṃ mahatte bahuvaktranetraṃ mahābāho bahubāhūrupādam.
bahūdaraṃ bahudaṃṣṭrākarālaṃ dṛṣṭvā lokāḥ pravyathitāstathāham
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey mahaabaaho! aapake bahuta mukha tathaa netra vaale, bahuta baahu, uru (janghaa) tathaa pairon vaale, bahuta-nnsee udaron vaale tathaa bahutasee vikaraala daadhon vaale mahaan roopa ko dekhakara saba loga vyathita ho rahey hain aura usee prakaara main bhee (vyaakula ho rahaa hoon)
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey mahaabaaho! aapake bahuta mukha tathaa netra vaale, bahuta baahu, uru (janghaa) tathaa pairon vaale, bahuta-nnsee udaron vaale tathaa bahutasee vikaraala daadhon vaale mahaan roopa ko dekhakara saba loga vyathita ho rahey hain aura usee prakaara main bhee (vyaakula ho rahaa hoon). Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णं
व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम् ।
दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा
धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो ॥
verses.transliteration:
nabhaḥspṛśaṃ dīptamanekavarṇaṃ vyāttānanaṃ dīptaviśālanetram.
dṛṣṭvā hi tvāṃ pravyathitāntarātmā dhṛtiṃ na vindāmi śamaṃ ca viṣṇo
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey vishno! aakaasha ke saatha sparsha kiye hue dedeepyamaana aneka roopon se yukta tathaa vistarita mukha aura prakaashamaana vishaala netron se yukta aapako dekhakara bhayabheeta huaa main dhairya aura shaanti ko naheen praapta ho rahaa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey vishno! aakaasha ke saatha sparsha kiye hue dedeepyamaana aneka roopon se yukta tathaa vistarita mukha aura prakaashamaana vishaala netron se yukta aapako dekhakara bhayabheeta huaa main dhairya aura shaanti ko naheen praapta ho rahaa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि
दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि ।
दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ॥
verses.transliteration:
daṃṣṭrākarālāni ca te mukhāni dṛṣṭvaiva kālānalasannibhāni.
diśo na jāne na labhe ca śarma prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aapake vikaraala daadhon vaale aura pralayaagni ke samaana prajvalita mukhon ko dekhakara, main na dishaaon ko jaana paa rahaa hoon aura na shaanti ko praapta ho rahaa hoon; isalie hey devesha! hey jagannivaasa! aapa prasanna ho jaaie
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Aapake vikaraala daadhon vaale aura pralayaagni ke samaana prajvalita mukhon ko dekhakara, main na dishaaon ko jaana paa rahaa hoon aura na shaanti ko praapta ho rahaa hoon; isalie hey devesha! hey jagannivaasa! aapa prasanna ho jaaie. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः
सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः ।
भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथासौ
सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः ॥
verses.transliteration:
amī ca tvāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ sarve sahaivāvanipālasaṅghaiḥ.
bhīṣmo droṇaḥ sūtaputrastathāsau sahāsmadīyairapi yodhamukhyaiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aura ye samasta dhritaraashtra ke putra raajaaon ke samudaaya sahita aapa men pravesha karate hain. bheeshma, drona tathaa karna aura hamaare paksha ke bhee pradhaana yoddhaaon ke sahita
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Aura ye samasta dhritaraashtra ke putra raajaaon ke samudaaya sahita aapa men pravesha karate hain. bheeshma, drona tathaa karna aura hamaare paksha ke bhee pradhaana yoddhaaon ke sahita. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति
दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि ।
केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु
सन्दृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः ॥
verses.transliteration:
vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśanti daṃṣṭrākarālāni bhayānakāni.
kecidvilagnā daśanāntareṣu sandṛśyante cūrṇitairuttamāṅgaiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Teevra vega se aapake vikaraala daadhon vaale bhayaanaka mukhon men pravesha karate hain aura kaee eka choornita shiron sahita aapake daanton ke beecha men phanse hue dikha rahey hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Teevra vega se aapake vikaraala daadhon vaale bhayaanaka mukhon men pravesha karate hain aura kaee eka choornita shiron sahita aapake daanton ke beecha men phanse hue dikha rahey hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः
समुद्रमेवाभिमुखा द्रवन्ति ।
तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा
विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā nadīnāṃ bahavo.ambuvegāḥ samudramevābhimukhā dravanti.
tathā tavāmī naralokavīrā viśanti vaktrāṇyabhivijvalanti
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise nadiyon ke bahuta se jalapravaaha samudra kee ora vega se bahate hain, vaise hee manushyaloka ke ye veera yoddhaagana aapake prajvalita mukhon men pravesha karate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jaise nadiyon ke bahuta se jalapravaaha samudra kee ora vega se bahate hain, vaise hee manushyaloka ke ye veera yoddhaagana aapake prajvalita mukhon men pravesha karate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा
विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः ।
तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोकास्-
तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā pradīptaṃ jvalanaṃ pataṅgā viśanti nāśāya samṛddhavegāḥ.
tathaiva nāśāya viśanti lokāsa- tavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛddhavegāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaise patange apane naasha ke lie prajvalita agni men ativega se pravesha karate hain, vaise hee ye loga bhee apane naasha ke lie aapake mukhon men ativega se pravesha karate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jaise patange apane naasha ke lie prajvalita agni men ativega se pravesha karate hain, vaise hee ye loga bhee apane naasha ke lie aapake mukhon men ativega se pravesha karate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ताल्-
लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः ।
तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं
भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो ॥
verses.transliteration:
lelihyase grasamānaḥ samantāl- lokānsamagrānvadanairjvaladbhiḥ.
tejobhirāpūrya jagatsamagraṃ bhāsastavogrāḥ pratapanti viṣṇo
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey vishno! aapa prajvalita mukhon ke dvaaraa ina samasta lokon kaa grasana karate hue aasvaada le rahey hain, aapakaa ugra prakaasha sampoorna jagat ko teja ke dvaaraa paripoorna karake tapaa rahaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey vishno! aapa prajvalita mukhon ke dvaaraa ina samasta lokon kaa grasana karate hue aasvaada le rahey hain, aapakaa ugra prakaasha sampoorna jagat ko teja ke dvaaraa paripoorna karake tapaa rahaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो
नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद ।
विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं
न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ākhyāhi me ko bhavānugrarūpo namo.astu te devavara prasīda.
vijñātumicchāmi bhavantamādyaṃ na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛttim
verses.hinglishMeaning: (kripayaa) mere prati kahiye, ki ugraroopa vaale aapa kauna hain? hey devon men shreshtha! aapako namaskaara hai, aapa prasanna hoiye. aadi svaroopa aapako main (tattva se) jaananaa chaahataa hoon, kyonki aapakee pravritti (arthaat prayojana ko) ko main naheen samajha paa rahaa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: (kripayaa) mere prati kahiye, ki ugraroopa vaale aapa kauna hain? hey devon men shreshtha! aapako namaskaara hai, aapa prasanna hoiye. aadi svaroopa aapako main (tattva se) jaananaa chaahataa hoon, kyonki aapakee pravritti (arthaat prayojana ko) ko main naheen samajha paa rahaa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो
लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः ।
ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे
येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
kālo.asmi lokakṣayakṛtpravṛddho lokānsamāhartumiha pravṛttaḥ.
ṛte.api tvāṃ na bhaviṣyanti sarve ye.avasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣu yodhāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- main lokon kaa naasha karane vaalaa pravriddha kaala hoon. isa samaya, main ina lokon kaa sanhaara karane men pravritta hoon. jo pratipakshiyon kee senaa men sthita yoddhaa hain, ve saba tumhaare binaa bhee naheen rahenge

जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम् ।
मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव
निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन् ॥
verses.transliteration:

युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान् ॥

कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी ।
नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं
सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य ॥
verses.transliteration:

etacchrutvā vacanaṃ keśavasya kṛtāñjalirvepamānaḥ kirīṭī.

जगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च ।
रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति
सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः ॥

sthāne hṛṣīkeśa tava prakīrtyā jagatprahṛṣyatyanurajyate ca.
rakṣāṃsi bhītāni diśo dravanti sarve namasyanti ca siddhasaṅghāḥ

कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्
गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे ।
अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास
त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत् ॥

ananta deveśa jagannivāsa tvamakṣaraṃ sadasattatparaṃ yat

न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः ।
एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके

verses.transliteration:

व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं
तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य ॥
verses.transliteration:

इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा

आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं
भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा ॥
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca.
ityarjunaṃ vāsudevastathoktvā svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa bhūyaḥ.
āśvāsayāmāsa ca bhītamenaṃ bhūtvā punaḥ saumyavapurmahātmā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sanjaya ne kahaa -- bhagavaan vaasudeva ne Arjun se isa prakaara kahakara, puna: apane (poorva) roopa ko darshaayaa, aura phira, saumyaroopa mahatma shreeKrishna ne isa bhayabheeta Arjun ko aashvasta kiyaa

verses.sanskrit:

इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca.
dṛṣṭvedaṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ tava saumyaṃ janārdana.
idānīmasmi saṃvṛttaḥ sacetāḥ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम ।
देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः ॥
verses.transliteration:

sudurdarśamidaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭavānasi yanmama.
devā apyasya rūpasya nityaṃ darśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- meraa yaha roopa dekhane ko milanaa ati durlabha hai, jisako ki tumane dekhaa hai. devataagana bhee sadaa isa roopa ke darshana ke ichchhuka rahate hain

verses.sanskrit:
नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया ।
शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा ॥
verses.transliteration:

śakya evaṃvidho draṣṭuṃ dṛṣṭavānasi māṃ yathā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Na vedon se, na tapa se, na daana se aura na yajnya se hee main isa prakaara dekhaa jaa sakataa hoon, jaisaa ki tumane mujhey dekhaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Na vedon se, na tapa se, na daana se aura na yajnya se hee main isa prakaara dekhaa jaa sakataa hoon, jaisaa ki tumane mujhey dekhaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्य अहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन ।
ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परन्तप ॥
verses.transliteration:

jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca parantapa
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parantu hey parantapa Arjun! ananya bhakti ke dvaaraa main tattvata: 'jaanane', 'dekhane' aura 'pravesha' karane ke lie (ekee bhaava se praapta hone ke lie) bhee, shakya hoon!
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Parantu hey parantapa Arjun! ananya bhakti ke dvaaraa main tattvata: 'jaanane', 'dekhane' aura 'pravesha' karane ke lie (ekee bhaava se praapta hone ke lie) bhee, shakya hoon!. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 11 ke mool vishay se juda hai: vishvaroop ke darshan se Ishwar ki anant shakti aur kaal-tattva samajh aata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः ।
निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव ॥
verses.transliteration:

nirvairaḥ sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ sa māmeti pāṇḍava
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paandava! jo purusha mere lie hee karma karane vaalaa hai, aura mujhey hee parama lakshya maanataa hai, jo meraa bhakta hai tathaa sangarahita hai, jo bhootamaatra ke prati nirvaira hai, vaha mujhey praapta hotaa hai

summary: The twelfth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Bhakti Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna emphasizes the superiority of Bhakti Yoga (the path of devotion) over all other types of spiritual disciplines and reveals various aspects of devotion. He further explains that the devotees who perform pure devotional service to Him, with their consciousness, merged in Him and all their actions dedicated to Him, are quickly liberated from the cycle of life and death. He also describes the various qualities of the devotees who are very dear to Him.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।

ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca.
evaṃ satatayuktā ye bhaktāstvāṃ paryupāsate.
ye cāpyakṣaramavyaktaṃ teṣāṃ ke yogavittamāḥ

श्रद्धया परयोपेताः ते मे युक्ततमा मताः ॥

ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते ।

ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥

अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते ॥

भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम् ॥

verses.sanskrit:

verses.hinglishMeaning: Yadi tuma abhyaasa men bhee asamartha ho to matkarma paraayana bano; isa prakaara mere lie karmon ko karate hue bhee tuma siddhi ko praapta karoge

verses.sanskrit:

सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान् ॥
verses.transliteration:

मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥

verses.sanskrit:

verses.sanskrit:

verses.sanskrit:

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 12 ke mool vishay se juda hai: saral, nishtha-bhari bhakti aur dayalu jeevan ko uttam marg batata hai.

verses.sanskrit:

श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः ॥

summary: The thirteenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga. The word kshetra means the field, and the kshetrajna means the knower of the field. We can think of our material body as the field and our immortal soul as the knower of the field. In this chapter, Krishna discriminates between the physical body and the immortal soul. He explains that the physical body is temporary and perishable whereas the soul is permanent and eternal. The physical body can be destroyed but the soul can never be destroyed. The chapter then describes God, who is the Supreme Soul. All the individual souls have originated from the Supreme Soul. One who clearly understands the difference between the body, the Soul and the Supreme Soul attains the realization of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते ।
एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः ॥

verses.sanskrit:

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक्च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत् ।
स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे शृणु ॥
verses.transliteration:

sa ca yo yatprabhāvaśca tatsamāsena me śṛṇu
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isaliye, vaha kshetra jo hai aura jaisaa hai tathaa jina vikaaron vaalaa hai, aura jisa (kaarana) se jo (kaarya) huaa hai tathaa vaha (kshetrajnya) bhee jo hai aura jisa prabhaava vaalaa hai, vaha sankshepa men mujhase suno

ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्चितैः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛṣibhirbahudhā gītaṃ chandobhirvividhaiḥ pṛthak.
brahmasūtrapadaiścaiva hetumadbhirviniścitaiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: (kshetra-kshetrajnya ke vishaya men) rishiyon dvaaraa vibhinna aura vividha chhandon men bahuta prakaara se gaayaa gayaa hai, tathaa samyak prakaara se nishchita kiye huye yuktiyukta brahmasootra ke padon dvaaraa (arthaat brahma ke soochaka shabdon dvaaraa) bhee (vaise hee kahaa gayaa hai)

verses.sanskrit:
महाभूतान्यहंकारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च ।
इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः ॥
verses.transliteration:

indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca pañca cendriyagocarāḥ

इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं संघातश्चेतना धृतिः ।

verses.sanskrit:
अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम् ।
आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहंकार एव च ।

verses.transliteration:

verses.sanskrit:

verses.transliteration:

nityaṃ ca samacittatvamiṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu

verses.sanskrit:
मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी ।
विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि ॥
verses.transliteration:
mayi cānanyayogena bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī.
viviktadeśasevitvamaratirjanasaṃsadi
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ananyayoga ke dvaaraa mujhamen avyabhichaarinee bhakti; ekaanta sthaana men rahane kaa svabhaava aura (asanskrita) janon ke samudaaya men aruchi

verses.sanskrit:
अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम् ।
एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोऽन्यथा ॥
verses.transliteration:
adhyātmajñānanityatvaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanam.
etajjñānamiti proktamajñānaṃ yadato.anyathā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Adhyaatmajnyaana men nityatva arthaat sthirataa tathaa tattvajnyaana ke artha roopa paramatma kaa darshana, yaha saba to jnyaana kahaa gayaa hai, aura jo isase vipareeta hai, vaha ajnyaana hai

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते ।
अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
jñeyaṃ yattatpravakṣyāmi yajjñātvāmṛtamaśnute.
anādi matparaṃ brahma na sattannāsaducyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Main usa jnyeya vastu ko spashta kahoongaa jise jaanakara manushya amritatva ko praapta karataa hai. vaha jnyeya hai - anaadi, parama brahma, jo na sat aura na asat hee kahaa jaa sakataa hai

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् ।
सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tatsarvato.akṣiśiromukham.
sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vaha saba ora haatha-paira vaalaa hai aura saba ora se netra, shira aura mukhavaalaa tathaa saba ora se shrotravaalaa hai; vaha jagat men sabako vyaapta karake sthita hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Vaha saba ora haatha-paira vaalaa hai aura saba ora se netra, shira aura mukhavaalaa tathaa saba ora se shrotravaalaa hai; vaha jagat men sabako vyaapta karake sthita hai. verses.sanskrit:
सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् ।
असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam.
asaktaṃ sarvabhṛccaiva nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vaha samasta indriyon ke guno (kaaryon) ke dvaaraa prakaashita hone vaalaa, parantu (vastuta:) samasta indriyon se rahita hai; aasakti rahita tathaa guna rahita hote hue bhee sabako dhaaranaposhana karane vaalaa aura gunon kaa bhoktaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Vaha samasta indriyon ke guno (kaaryon) ke dvaaraa prakaashita hone vaalaa, parantu (vastuta:) samasta indriyon se rahita hai; aasakti rahita tathaa guna rahita hote hue bhee sabako dhaaranaposhana karane vaalaa aura gunon kaa bhoktaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne gunon aur pravrittiyon ko pehchaan kar unse upar uthna hi vikas hai.

verses.sanskrit:
बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च ।
सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bahirantaśca bhūtānāmacaraṃ carameva ca.
sūkṣmatvāttadavijñeyaṃ dūrasthaṃ cāntike ca tat
verses.hinglishMeaning: (vaha brahma) bhoota maatra ke antarbaahya sthita hai; vaha chara hai aura achara bhee. sookshma hone se vaha avijnyeya hai; vaha sudoora aura atyanta sameepastha bhee hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: (vaha brahma) bhoota maatra ke antarbaahya sthita hai; vaha chara hai aura achara bhee. sookshma hone se vaha avijnyeya hai; vaha sudoora aura atyanta sameepastha bhee hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम् ।
भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च ॥
verses.transliteration:
avibhaktaṃ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitam.
bhūtabhartṛ ca tajjñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aura vaha avibhakta hai, tathaapi vaha bhooton men vibhakta ke samaana sthita hai. vaha jnyeya brahma bhootamaatra kaa bhartaa, sanhaarakartaa aura utpatti kartaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Aura vaha avibhakta hai, tathaapi vaha bhooton men vibhakta ke samaana sthita hai. vaha jnyeya brahma bhootamaatra kaa bhartaa, sanhaarakartaa aura utpatti kartaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते ।
ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
jyotiṣāmapi tajjyotistamasaḥ paramucyate.
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam
verses.hinglishMeaning: (vaha brahma) jyotiyon kee bhee jyoti aura (ajnyaana) andhakaara se pare kahaa jaataa hai. vaha jnyaana (chaitanyasvaroopa) jnyeya aura jnyaana ke dvaaraa jaanane yogya (jnyaanagamya) hai. vaha sabhee ke hridaya men sthita hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: (vaha brahma) jyotiyon kee bhee jyoti aura (ajnyaana) andhakaara se pare kahaa jaataa hai. vaha jnyaana (chaitanyasvaroopa) jnyeya aura jnyaana ke dvaaraa jaanane yogya (jnyaanagamya) hai. vaha sabhee ke hridaya men sthita hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः ।
मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
iti kṣetraṃ tathā jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ coktaṃ samāsataḥ.
madbhakta etadvijñāya madbhāvāyopapadyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isa prakaara, (mere dvaaraa) kshetra, jnyaana aura jnyeya ko sankshepata: kahaa gayaa. ise tattva se jaanakara (vijnyaaya) meraa bhakta mere svaroopa ko praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Isa prakaara, (mere dvaaraa) kshetra, jnyaana aura jnyeya ko sankshepata: kahaa gayaa. ise tattva se jaanakara (vijnyaaya) meraa bhakta mere svaroopa ko praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि ।
विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसम्भवान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva viddhyanādi ubhāvapi.
vikārāṃśca guṇāṃścaiva viddhi prakṛtisambhavān
verses.hinglishMeaning: Prakriti aura purusha ina donon ko hee tuma anaadi jaano. aura tuma yaha bhee jaano ki sabhee vikaara aura guna prakriti se hee utpanna hue hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Prakriti aura purusha ina donon ko hee tuma anaadi jaano. aura tuma yaha bhee jaano ki sabhee vikaara aura guna prakriti se hee utpanna hue hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते ।
पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
kāryakāraṇakartṛtve hetuḥ prakṛtirucyate.
puruṣaḥ sukhaduḥkhānāṃ bhoktṛtve heturucyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kaarya aura kaarana ke utpanna karane men hetu prakriti kahee jaatee hai aura purusha sukha-du:kha ke bhoktritva men hetu kahaa jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Kaarya aura kaarana ke utpanna karane men hetu prakriti kahee jaatee hai aura purusha sukha-du:kha ke bhoktritva men hetu kahaa jaataa hai. पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान् ।
कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु ॥
verses.transliteration:
puruṣaḥ prakṛtistho hi bhuṅkte prakṛtijānguṇān.
kāraṇaṃ guṇasaṅgo.asya sadasadyonijanmasu
verses.hinglishMeaning: Prakriti men sthita purusha prakriti se utpanna gunon ko bhogataa hai. ina gunon kaa sanga hee isa purusha (jeeva) ke shubha aura ashubha yoniyon men janma lene kaa kaarana hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Prakriti men sthita purusha prakriti se utpanna gunon ko bhogataa hai. ina gunon kaa sanga hee isa purusha (jeeva) ke shubha aura ashubha yoniyon men janma lene kaa kaarana hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः ।
परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः ॥
verses.transliteration:
upadraṣṭānumantā ca bhartā bhoktā maheśvaraḥ.
paramātmeti cāpyukto dehe.asminpuruṣaḥ paraḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parama purusha hee isa deha men upadrashtaa, anumantaa ,bhartaa, bhoktaa, maheshvara aura paramatma kahaa jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Parama purusha hee isa deha men upadrashtaa, anumantaa ,bhartaa, bhoktaa, maheshvara aura paramatma kahaa jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैः सह ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya evaṃ vetti puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca guṇaiḥ saha.
sarvathā vartamāno.api na sa bhūyo.abhijāyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isa prakaara purusha aura gunon ke sahita prakriti ko jo manushya jaanataa hai, vaha saba prakaara se rahataa huaa (vyavahaara karataa huaa) bhee puna: naheen janmataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Isa prakaara purusha aura gunon ke sahita prakriti ko jo manushya jaanataa hai, vaha saba prakaara se rahataa huaa (vyavahaara karataa huaa) bhee puna: naheen janmataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.
