verses.sanskrit:
ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना ।
अन्ये साङ्ख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhyānenātmani paśyanti kecidātmānamātmanā.
anye sāṅkhyena yogena karmayogena cāpare
verses.hinglishMeaning: Koee purusha dhyaana ke abhyaasa se atma ko atma (hridaya) men atma (shuddha buddhi) ke dvaaraa dekhate hain; anya loga saankhya yoga ke dvaaraa tathaa koee saadhaka karmayoga se (atma ko dekhate hain )
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Koee purusha dhyaana ke abhyaasa se atma ko atma (hridaya) men atma (shuddha buddhi) ke dvaaraa dekhate hain; anya loga saankhya yoga ke dvaaraa tathaa koee saadhaka karmayoga se (atma ko dekhate hain ). Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वान्येभ्य उपासते ।
तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
anye tvevamajānantaḥ śrutvānyebhya upāsate.
te.api cātitarantyeva mṛtyuṃ śrutiparāyaṇāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Parantu, anya loga jo svayan isa prakaara na jaanate hue, doosaron se (aachaaryon se) sunakara hee upaasanaa karate hain, ve shrutiparaayana (arthaat shravana hee jinake lie parama saadhana hai) loga bhee mrityu ko ni:sandeha tara jaate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Parantu, anya loga jo svayan isa prakaara na jaanate hue, doosaron se (aachaaryon se) sunakara hee upaasanaa karate hain, ve shrutiparaayana (arthaat shravana hee jinake lie parama saadhana hai) loga bhee mrityu ko ni:sandeha tara jaate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यावत्सञ्जायते किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम् ।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāvatsañjāyate kiñcitsattvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam.
kṣetrakṣetrajñasaṃyogāttadviddhi bharatarṣabha
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bharata shreshtha ! yaavanmaatra jo kuchha bhee sthaavara jangama (charaachara) vastu utpanna hotee hai, usa sabako tuma kshetra aura kshetrajnya ke sanyoga se utpanna huee jaano
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey bharata shreshtha ! yaavanmaatra jo kuchha bhee sthaavara jangama (charaachara) vastu utpanna hotee hai, usa sabako tuma kshetra aura kshetrajnya ke sanyoga se utpanna huee jaano. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम् ।
विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
samaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantaṃ parameśvaram.
vinaśyatsvavinaśyantaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha samasta nashvara bhooton men anashvara parameshvara ko samabhaava se sthita dekhataa hai, vahee (vaastava men) dekhataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha samasta nashvara bhooton men anashvara parameshvara ko samabhaava se sthita dekhataa hai, vahee (vaastava men) dekhataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम् ।
न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

यः पश्यति तथात्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:

yaḥ paśyati tathātmānamakartāraṃ sa paśyati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha samasta karmon ko sarvasha: prakriti dvaaraa hee kiye gaye dekhataa hai tathaa atma ko akartaa dekhataa hai, vahee (vaastava men) dekhataa hai

verses.sanskrit:
यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति ।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.sanskrit:
अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः ।
शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:

śarīrastho.api kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kaunteya ! anaadi aura nirguna hone se yaha paramatma avyaya hai. shareera men sthita huaa bhee, vastuta:, vaha na (karma) karataa hai aura na (phalon se) lipta hotaa hai

verses.sanskrit:
यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते ।
सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथात्मा नोपलिप्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:

sarvatrāvasthito dehe tathātmā nopalipyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jisa prakaara sarvagata aakaasha sookshma hone ke kaarana lipta naheen hotaa, usee prakaara sarvatra deha men sthita atma lipta naheen hotaa

verses.sanskrit:
यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः ।
क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत ॥
verses.transliteration:

kṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bhaarata ! jisa prakaara eka hee soorya isa sampoorna loka ko prakaashita karataa hai, usee prakaara eka hee kshetree (kshetrajnya) sampoorna kshetra ko prakaashita karataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey bhaarata ! jisa prakaara eka hee soorya isa sampoorna loka ko prakaashita karataa hai, usee prakaara eka hee kshetree (kshetrajnya) sampoorna kshetra ko prakaashita karataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 13 ke mool vishay se juda hai: shareer kshetra hai aur atma kshetrajna; dono ka vivek mukti ki disha deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा ।
भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kṣetrakṣetrajñayorevamantaraṃ jñānacakṣuṣā.
bhūtaprakṛtimokṣaṃ ca ye viduryānti te param
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isa prakaara, jo purusha jnyaanachakshu ke dvaaraa kshetra aura kshetrajnya ke bheda ko tathaa prakriti ke vikaaron se moksha ko jaanate hain, ve parama brahma ko praapta hote hain

summary: The fourteenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna reveals the three gunas (modes) of the material nature - goodness, passion and ignorance which everything in the material existence is influenced by. He further explains the essential characteristics of each of these modes, their cause and how they influence a living entity affected by them. He then reveals the various characteristics of the persons who have gone beyond these gunas. The chapter ends with Krishna reminding us of the power of pure devotion to God and how attachment to God can help us transcend these gunas.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम् ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
paraṃ bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi jñānānāṃ jñānamuttamam.
yajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shree bhagavaan ne kahaa -- samasta jnyaanon men uttama parama jnyaana ko main puna: kahoongaa, jisako jaanakara sabhee munijana isa (loka) se jaakara (isa jeevanoparaanta) parama siddhi ko praapta hue hain

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः ।
सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च ॥
verses.transliteration:

सम्भवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bhaarata ! meree mahad brahmaroopa prakriti, (bhooton kee) yoni hai, jisamen main garbhaadhaana karataa hoon; isase samasta bhooton kee utpatti hotee hai

सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः ।
निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey mahaabaaho ! sattva, raja aura tama ye prakriti se utpanna teenon guna dehee atma ko deha ke saatha baandha dete hain

सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ ॥
verses.transliteration:

sukhasaṅgena badhnāti jñānasaṅgena cānagha

तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kaunteya ! rajoguna ko raagasvaroopa jaano, jisase trishnaa aura aasakti utpanna hotee hai. vaha dehee atma ko karmon kee aasakti se baandhataa hai

verses.hinglishMeaning: Aura hey bhaarata ! tamoguna ko ajnyaana se utpanna jaano; jo samasta dehadhaariyon (jeevon) ko mohita karane vaalaa hai. vaha pramaada, aalasya aura nidraa ke dvaaraa jeeva ko baandhataa hai

ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत ॥
verses.transliteration:

jñānamāvṛtya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayatyuta
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bhaarata ! sattvaguna sukha men aasakta kara detaa hai aura rajoguna karma men, kintu tamoguna jnyaana ko aavritta karake jeeva ko pramaada se yukta kara detaa hai

verses.transliteration:

rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamaścaiva tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajastathā

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते ।
ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvadvāreṣu dehe.asminprakāśa upajāyate.
jñānaṃ yadā tadā vidyādvivṛddhaṃ sattvamityuta
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaba isa deha ke dvaaron arthaat samasta indriyon men jnyaanaroopa prakaasha utpanna hotaa hai, taba sattvaguna ko pravriddha huaa jaano

रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ ॥
verses.transliteration:

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च ।
तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन ॥
verses.transliteration:
aprakāśo.apravṛttiśca pramādo moha eva ca.
tamasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe kurunandana
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kurunandana ! tamoguna ke pravriddha hone para aprakaasha, apravritti, pramaada aura moha ye saba utpanna hote hain

verses.lifeLesson: Apne gunon aur pravrittiyon ko pehchaan kar unse upar uthna hi vikas hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत् ।
तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadā sattve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṃ yāti dehabhṛt.
tadottamavidāṃ lokānamalānpratipadyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaba yaha jeeva (dehabhrit) sattvaguna kee pravriddhi men mrityu ko praapta hotaa hai, taba uttama karma karane vaalon ke nirmala arthaat svargaadi lokon ko praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jaba yaha jeeva (dehabhrit) sattvaguna kee pravriddhi men mrityu ko praapta hotaa hai, taba uttama karma karane vaalon ke nirmala arthaat svargaadi lokon ko praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते ।
तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते ॥
verses.transliteration:
rajasi pralayaṃ gatvā karmasaṅgiṣu jāyate.
tathā pralīnastamasi mūḍhayoniṣu jāyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Rajoguna ke pravriddha kaala men mrityu ko praapta hokara karmaasakti vaale (manushya) loka men vaha janma letaa hai tathaa tamoguna ke pravriddhakaala men (marana hone para) moodhayoni men janma letaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Rajoguna ke pravriddha kaala men mrityu ko praapta hokara karmaasakti vaale (manushya) loka men vaha janma letaa hai tathaa tamoguna ke pravriddhakaala men (marana hone para) moodhayoni men janma letaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम् ।
रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṃ nirmalaṃ phalam.
rajasastu phalaṃ duḥkhamajñānaṃ tamasaḥ phalam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shubha karma kaa phala saatvika aura nirmala kahaa gayaa hai; rajoguna kaa phala du;kha aura tamoguna kaa phala ajnyaana hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shubha karma kaa phala saatvika aura nirmala kahaa gayaa hai; rajoguna kaa phala du;kha aura tamoguna kaa phala ajnyaana hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च ।
प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च ॥
verses.transliteration:
sattvātsañjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca.
pramādamohau tamaso bhavato.ajñānameva ca
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sattvaguna se jnyaana utpanna hotaa hai. rajoguna se lobha tathaa tamoguna se pramaada, moha aura ajnyaana utpanna hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Sattvaguna se jnyaana utpanna hotaa hai. rajoguna se lobha tathaa tamoguna se pramaada, moha aura ajnyaana utpanna hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः ।
जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ.
jaghanyaguṇavṛttisthā adho gacchanti tāmasāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sattvaguna men sthita purusha uchcha (lokon ko) jaate hain; raajasa purusha madhya (manushya loka) men rahate hain aura tamoguna kee atyanta heena pravrittiyon men sthita taamasa loga adhogati ko praapta hote hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Sattvaguna men sthita purusha uchcha (lokon ko) jaate hain; raajasa purusha madhya (manushya loka) men rahate hain aura tamoguna kee atyanta heena pravrittiyon men sthita taamasa loga adhogati ko praapta hote hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति ।
गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
nānyaṃ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṃ yadā draṣṭānupaśyati.
guṇebhyaśca paraṃ vetti madbhāvaṃ so.adhigacchati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jaba drashtaa (saadhaka) purusha teenon gunon ke atirikta kisee anya ko kartaa naheen dekhataa, arthaat naheen samajhataa hai aura teenon gunon se pare mere tatva ko jaanataa hai, taba vaha mere svaroopa ko praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jaba drashtaa (saadhaka) purusha teenon gunon ke atirikta kisee anya ko kartaa naheen dekhataa, arthaat naheen samajhataa hai aura teenon gunon se pare mere tatva ko jaanataa hai, taba vaha mere svaroopa ko praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान् ।
जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते ॥
verses.transliteration:
guṇānetānatītya trīndehī dehasamudbhavān.
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhairvimukto.amṛtamaśnute
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yaha dehee purusha shareera kee utpatti ke kaaranaroopa teenon gunon se ateeta hokara janma, mrityu, jaraa aura du:khon se vimukta huaa amritatva ko praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Yaha dehee purusha shareera kee utpatti ke kaaranaroopa teenon gunon se ateeta hokara janma, mrityu, jaraa aura du:khon se vimukta huaa amritatva ko praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
कैर्लिङ्गैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो ।
किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते ॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca.
kairliṅgaistrīnguṇānetānatīto bhavati prabho.
kimācāraḥ kathaṃ caitāṃstrīnguṇānativartate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kahaa -- hey prabho ! ina teeno gunon se ateeta huaa purusha kina lakshanon se yukta hotaa hai ? vaha kisa prakaara ke aacharana vaalaa hotaa hai ? aura, vaha kisa upaaya se ina teenon gunon se ateeta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Arjun ne kahaa -- hey prabho ! ina teeno gunon se ateeta huaa purusha kina lakshanon se yukta hotaa hai ? vaha kisa prakaara ke aacharana vaalaa hotaa hai ? aura, vaha kisa upaaya se ina teenon gunon se ateeta hotaa hai. verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव ।
न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
prakāśaṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca mohameva ca pāṇḍava.
na dveṣṭi sampravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- hey paandava ! (jnyaanee purusha) prakaasha, pravritti aura moha ke pravritta hone para bhee unakaa dvesha naheen karataa tathaa nivritta hone para unakee aakaankshaa naheen karataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shreebhagavaan ne kahaa -- hey paandava ! (jnyaanee purusha) prakaasha, pravritti aura moha ke pravritta hone para bhee unakaa dvesha naheen karataa tathaa nivritta hone para unakee aakaankshaa naheen karataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते ।
गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येवं योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते ॥
verses.transliteration:
udāsīnavadāsīno guṇairyo na vicālyate.
guṇā vartanta ityevaṃ yo.avatiṣṭhati neṅgate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo udaaseena ke samaana aaseena hokara gunon ke dvaaraa vichalita naheen kiyaa jaa sakataa aura "guna hee vyavahaara karate hain" aisaa jaanakara sthita rahataa hai aura usa sthiti se vichalita naheen hotaa

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ।
तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
samaduḥkhasukhaḥ svasthaḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ.
tulyapriyāpriyo dhīrastulyanindātmasaṃstutiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo svastha (svaroopa men sthita), sukha-du:kha men samaana rahataa hai tathaa mittee, patthara aura svarna men samadrishti rakhataa hai; aisaa veera purusha priya aura apriya ko tathaa nindaa aura aatmastuti ko tulya samajhataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo svastha (svaroopa men sthita), sukha-du:kha men samaana rahataa hai tathaa mittee, patthara aura svarna men samadrishti rakhataa hai; aisaa veera purusha priya aura apriya ko tathaa nindaa aura aatmastuti ko tulya samajhataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः ।
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
mānāpamānayostulyastulyo mitrāripakṣayoḥ.
sarvārambhaparityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa ucyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo maana aura apamaana men sama hai; shatru aura mitra ke paksha men bhee sama hai, aisaa sarvaarambha parityaagee purusha gunaateeta kahaa jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo maana aura apamaana men sama hai; shatru aura mitra ke paksha men bhee sama hai, aisaa sarvaarambha parityaagee purusha gunaateeta kahaa jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.

verses.sanskrit:
मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते ।
स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान्ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥
verses.transliteration:
māṃ ca yo.avyabhicāreṇa bhaktiyogena sevate.
sa guṇānsamatītyaitānbrahmabhūyāya kalpate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha avyabhichaaree bhaktiyoga ke dvaaraa meree sevaa arthaat upaasanaa karataa hai, vaha ina teenon gunon ke ateeta hokara brahma banane ke liye yogya ho jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha avyabhichaaree bhaktiyoga ke dvaaraa meree sevaa arthaat upaasanaa karataa hai, vaha ina teenon gunon ke ateeta hokara brahma banane ke liye yogya ho jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च ।
शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhāhamamṛtasyāvyayasya ca.
śāśvatasya ca dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya ca
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kyonki main amrita, avyaya, brahma, shaashvata dharma aura aikaantika arthaat paaramaarthika sukha kee pratishthaa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Kyonki main amrita, avyaya, brahma, shaashvata dharma aura aikaantika arthaat paaramaarthika sukha kee pratishthaa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 14 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sattva, rajas aur tamas ko samajhkar unse upar uthne ki seekh deta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Dharma ka sahara lekar kathin faisle bhi shuddh bhav se liye ja sakte hain.

summary: The fifteenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Purushottama Yoga. In Sanskrit, Purusha means the All-pervading God, and Purushottam means the timeless & transcendental aspect of God. Krishna reveals that the purpose of this Transcendental knowledge of the God is to detach ourselves from the bondage of the material world and to understand Krishna as the Supreme Divine Personality, who is the eternal controller and sustainer of the world. One who understands this Ultimate Truth surrenders to Him and engages in His devotional service.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम् ।
छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhamaśvatthaṃ prāhuravyayam.
chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shree bhagavaan ne kahaa -- (jnyaanee purusha isa sansaara vriksha ko) oordhvamoola aura adha:shaakhaa vaalaa ashvattha aura avyaya kahate hain; jisake parna chhanda arthaat veda hain, aise (sansaara vriksha) ko jo jaanataa hai, vaha vedavit hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shree bhagavaan ne kahaa -- (jnyaanee purusha isa sansaara vriksha ko) oordhvamoola aura adha:shaakhaa vaalaa ashvattha aura avyaya kahate hain; jisake parna chhanda arthaat veda hain, aise (sansaara vriksha) ko jo jaanataa hai, vaha vedavit hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा
गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः ।
अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानि
कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके ॥
verses.transliteration:
adhaścordhvaṃ prasṛtāstasya śākhā guṇapravṛddhā viṣayapravālāḥ.
adhaśca mūlānyanusantatāni karmānubandhīni manuṣyaloke
verses.hinglishMeaning: Usa vriksha kee shaakhaaen gunon se pravriddha hueen neechey aura oopara phailee hueen hain; (pancha) vishaya isake ankura hain; manushya loka men karmon kaa anusarana karane vaalee isakee anya jaden neechey phailee hueen hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Usa vriksha kee shaakhaaen gunon se pravriddha hueen neechey aura oopara phailee hueen hain; (pancha) vishaya isake ankura hain; manushya loka men karmon kaa anusarana karane vaalee isakee anya jaden neechey phailee hueen hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 15 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sansar-vriksha, jeev aur Purushottam ke sambandh ko spasht karta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते
नान्तो न चादिर्न च सम्प्रतिष्ठा ।
अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूलं
असङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
na rūpamasyeha tathopalabhyate nānto na cādirna ca sampratiṣṭhā.
aśvatthamenaṃ suvirūḍhamūlaṃ asaṅgaśastreṇa dṛḍhena chittvā

summary: The sixteenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Daivasura Sampad Vibhaga Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna describes explicitly the two kinds of natures among human beings - divine and demoniac. Those who possess demonaic qualities associate themselves with the modes of passion and ignorance do not follow the regulations of the scriptures and embrace materialistic views. These people attain lower births and further material bondage. But people who possess divine qualities, follow the instructions of the scriptures, associate themselves with the mode of goodness and purify the mind through spiritual practices. This leads to the enhancement of divine qualities and they eventually attain spiritual realization.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः ।
दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
abhayaṃ sattvasaṃśuddhirjñānayogavyavasthitiḥ.
dānaṃ damaśca yajñaśca svādhyāyastapa ārjavam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shree bhagavaan ne kahaa -- abhaya, anta:karana kee shuddhi, jnyaanayoga men dridha sthiti, daana, dama, yajnya, svaadhyaaya, tapa aura aarjava
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shree bhagavaan ne kahaa -- abhaya, anta:karana kee shuddhi, jnyaanayoga men dridha sthiti, daana, dama, yajnya, svaadhyaaya, tapa aura aarjava. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम् ।
दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahiṃsā satyamakrodhastyāgaḥ śāntirapaiśunam.
dayā bhūteṣvaloluptvaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīracāpalam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ahinsaa, satya, krodha kaa abhaava, tyaaga, shaanti, apaishunam (kisee kee nindaa na karanaa), bhootamaatra ke prati dayaa, alolupataa , maardava (komalataa), lajjaa, achanchalataa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Ahinsaa, satya, krodha kaa abhaava, tyaaga, shaanti, apaishunam (kisee kee nindaa na karanaa), bhootamaatra ke prati dayaa, alolupataa , maardava (komalataa), lajjaa, achanchalataa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Asakti kam karne se karm halka, spasht aur shant ho jata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता ।
भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत ॥
verses.transliteration:
tejaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ śaucamadroho nātimānitā.
bhavanti sampadaṃ daivīmabhijātasya bhārata
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bhaarata ! teja, kshamaa, dhairya, shaucha (shuddhi), adroha aura atimaana (garva) kaa abhaava ye saba daivee sanpadaa ko praapta purusha ke lakshana hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey bhaarata ! teja, kshamaa, dhairya, shaucha (shuddhi), adroha aura atimaana (garva) kaa abhaava ye saba daivee sanpadaa ko praapta purusha ke lakshana hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har sthiti mein vivek, kartavya aur antar ki shuddhata ko banaye rakhna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च ।
अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dambho darpo.abhimānaśca krodhaḥ pāruṣyameva ca.
ajñānaṃ cābhijātasya pārtha sampadamāsurīm
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! dambha, darpa, abhimaana, krodha, kathora vaanee (paarushya) aura ajnyaana yaha saba aasuree sampadaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey paartha ! dambha, darpa, abhimaana, krodha, kathora vaanee (paarushya) aura ajnyaana yaha saba aasuree sampadaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता ।
मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव ॥
verses.transliteration:
daivī sampadvimokṣāya nibandhāyāsurī matā.
mā śucaḥ sampadaṃ daivīmabhijāto.asi pāṇḍava
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paandava ! daivee sampadaa moksha ke lie aura aasuree sampadaa bandhana ke lie maanee gayee hai, tuma shoka mata karo, kyonki tuma daivee sampadaa ko praapta hue ho
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey paandava ! daivee sampadaa moksha ke lie aura aasuree sampadaa bandhana ke lie maanee gayee hai, tuma shoka mata karo, kyonki tuma daivee sampadaa ko praapta hue ho. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har sthiti mein vivek, kartavya aur antar ki shuddhata ko banaye rakhna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन्दैव आसुर एव च ।
दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे शृणु ॥
verses.transliteration:
dvau bhūtasargau loke.asmindaiva āsura eva ca.
daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śṛṇu
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! isa loka men do prakaara kee bhootisrishti hai, daivee aura aasuree. unamen devon kaa svabhaava (daivee sampadaa) vistaarapoorvaka kahaa gayaa hai; aba asuron ke svabhaava ko vistarasha: mujhase suno
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey paartha ! isa loka men do prakaara kee bhootisrishti hai, daivee aura aasuree. unamen devon kaa svabhaava (daivee sampadaa) vistaarapoorvaka kahaa gayaa hai; aba asuron ke svabhaava ko vistarasha: mujhase suno. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har sthiti mein vivek, kartavya aur antar ki shuddhata ko banaye rakhna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः ।
न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca janā na vidurāsurāḥ.
na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāro na satyaṃ teṣu vidyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aasuree svabhaava ke loga na pravritti ko; jaanate hain aura na nivritti ko unamen na shuddhi hotee hai, na sadaachaara aura na satya hee hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Aasuree svabhaava ke loga na pravritti ko; jaanate hain aura na nivritti ko unamen na shuddhi hotee hai, na sadaachaara aura na satya hee hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har sthiti mein vivek, kartavya aur antar ki shuddhata ko banaye rakhna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम् ।
अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
asatyamapratiṣṭhaṃ te jagadāhuranīśvaram.
aparasparasambhūtaṃ kimanyatkāmahaitukam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ve kahate hain ki yaha jagat aashrayarahita, asatya aura eeshvara rahita hai, yaha (streepurusha ke) paraspara kaamuka sanbandha se hee utpanna huaa hai, aura (isakaa kaarana) kyaa ho sakataa hai?
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Ve kahate hain ki yaha jagat aashrayarahita, asatya aura eeshvara rahita hai, yaha (streepurusha ke) paraspara kaamuka sanbandha se hee utpanna huaa hai, aura (isakaa kaarana) kyaa ho sakataa hai?. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः ।
प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
etāṃ dṛṣṭimavaṣṭabhya naṣṭātmāno.alpabuddhayaḥ.
prabhavantyugrakarmāṇaḥ kṣayāya jagato.ahitāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isa drishti kaa avalambana karake nashtasvabhaava ke alpa buddhi vaale, ghora karma karane vaale loga jagat ke shatru (ahita chaahane vaale) ke roopa men usakaa naasha karane ke lie utpanna hote hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Isa drishti kaa avalambana karake nashtasvabhaava ke alpa buddhi vaale, ghora karma karane vaale loga jagat ke shatru (ahita chaahane vaale) ke roopa men usakaa naasha karane ke lie utpanna hote hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः ।
मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
kāmamāśritya duṣpūraṃ dambhamānamadānvitāḥ.
mohādgṛhītvāsadgrāhānpravartante.aśucivratāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Dambha, maana aura mada se yukta kabhee na poorna hone vaalee kaamanaaon kaa aashraya liye, mohavasha mithyaa dhaaranaaon ko grahana karake ye ashuddha sankalpon ke loga jagat men kaarya karate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Dambha, maana aura mada se yukta kabhee na poorna hone vaalee kaamanaaon kaa aashraya liye, mohavasha mithyaa dhaaranaaon ko grahana karake ye ashuddha sankalpon ke loga jagat men kaarya karate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः ।
कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्चिताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
cintāmaparimeyāṃ ca pralayāntāmupāśritāḥ.
kāmopabhogaparamā etāvaditi niścitāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Maranaparyanta rahane vaalee aparimita chintaaon se grasta aura vishayopabhoga ko hee parama lakshya maanane vaale ye aasuree loga isa nishchita mata ke hote hain ki "itanaa hee (satya, aananda) hai"
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Maranaparyanta rahane vaalee aparimita chintaaon se grasta aura vishayopabhoga ko hee parama lakshya maanane vaale ye aasuree loga isa nishchita mata ke hote hain ki "itanaa hee (satya, aananda) hai". Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har sthiti mein vivek, kartavya aur antar ki shuddhata ko banaye rakhna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः ।
ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
āśāpāśaśatairbaddhāḥ kāmakrodhaparāyaṇāḥ.
īhante kāmabhogārthamanyāyenārthasañcayān
verses.hinglishMeaning: Saikadon aashaapaashon se bandhey huye, kaama aura krodha ke vasha men ye loga vishayabhogon kee poorti ke liye anyaayapoorvaka dhana kaa sangraha karane ke liye cheshtaa karate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Saikadon aashaapaashon se bandhey huye, kaama aura krodha ke vasha men ye loga vishayabhogon kee poorti ke liye anyaayapoorvaka dhana kaa sangraha karane ke liye cheshtaa karate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम् ।
इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
idamadya mayā labdhamimaṃ prāpsye manoratham.
idamastīdamapi me bhaviṣyati punardhanam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Mainne aaja yaha paayaa hai aura isa manoratha ko bhee praapta karoongaa, mere paasa yaha itanaa dhana hai aura isase bhee adhika dhana bhavishya men hogaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Mainne aaja yaha paayaa hai aura isa manoratha ko bhee praapta karoongaa, mere paasa yaha itanaa dhana hai aura isase bhee adhika dhana bhavishya men hogaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि ।
ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी ॥
verses.transliteration:
asau mayā hataḥ śatrurhaniṣye cāparānapi.
īśvaro.ahamahaṃ bhogī siddho.ahaṃ balavānsukhī
verses.hinglishMeaning: "yaha shatru mere dvaaraa maaraa gayaa hai aura doosare shatruon ko bhee main maaroongaa", "main eeshvara hoon aura bhogee hoon", "main siddha purusha hoon", "main balavaana aura sukhee hoon",
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: "yaha shatru mere dvaaraa maaraa gayaa hai aura doosare shatruon ko bhee main maaroongaa", "main eeshvara hoon aura bhogee hoon", "main siddha purusha hoon", "main balavaana aura sukhee hoon",. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har sthiti mein vivek, kartavya aur antar ki shuddhata ko banaye rakhna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया ।
यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
āḍhyo.abhijanavānasmi ko.anyo.asti sadṛśo mayā.
yakṣye dāsyāmi modiṣya ityajñānavimohitāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: "main dhanavaan aura shreshthakula men janmaa hoon. mere samaana doosaraa kauna hai?",'main yajnya karoongaa', 'main daana doongaa', 'main mauja karoongaa' - isa prakaara ke ajnyaana se ve mohita hote hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: "main dhanavaan aura shreshthakula men janmaa hoon. mere samaana doosaraa kauna hai?",'main yajnya karoongaa', 'main daana doongaa', 'main mauja karoongaa' - isa prakaara ke ajnyaana se ve mohita hote hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः ।
प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
anekacittavibhrāntā mohajālasamāvṛtāḥ.
prasaktāḥ kāmabhogeṣu patanti narake.aśucau
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aneka prakaara se bhramita chitta vaale, moha jaala men phanse tathaa vishayabhogon men aasakta ye loga ghora, apavitra naraka men girate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Aneka prakaara se bhramita chitta vaale, moha jaala men phanse tathaa vishayabhogon men aasakta ye loga ghora, apavitra naraka men girate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har sthiti mein vivek, kartavya aur antar ki shuddhata ko banaye rakhna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः ।
यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ātmasambhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhanamānamadānvitāḥ.
yajante nāmayajñaiste dambhenāvidhipūrvakam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Apane aapa ko hee shreshtha maanane vaale, stabdha (garvayukta), dhana aura maana ke mada se yukta loga shaastravidhi se rahita kevala naamamaatra ke yajnyon dvaaraa dambhapoorvaka yajana karate hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Apane aapa ko hee shreshtha maanane vaale, stabdha (garvayukta), dhana aura maana ke mada se yukta loga shaastravidhi se rahita kevala naamamaatra ke yajnyon dvaaraa dambhapoorvaka yajana karate hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः ।
मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ.
māmātmaparadeheṣu pradviṣanto.abhyasūyakāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ahankaara, bala, darpa, kaama aura krodha ke vasheebhoota hue paranindaa karane vaale ye loga apane aura doosaron ke shareera men sthita mujha (paramatma) se dvesha karane vaale hote hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Ahankaara, bala, darpa, kaama aura krodha ke vasheebhoota hue paranindaa karane vaale ye loga apane aura doosaron ke shareera men sthita mujha (paramatma) se dvesha karane vaale hote hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Har sthiti mein vivek, kartavya aur antar ki shuddhata ko banaye rakhna chahiye.

verses.sanskrit:
तानहं द्विषतः क्रुरान्संसारेषु नराधमान् ।
क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु ॥
verses.transliteration:
tānahaṃ dviṣataḥ krurānsaṃsāreṣu narādhamān.
kṣipāmyajasramaśubhānāsurīṣveva yoniṣu
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aise una dvesha karane vaale, kroorakarmee aura naraadhamon ko main sansaara men baarambaara (ajasram) aasuree yoniyon men hee giraataa hoon arthaat utpanna karataa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Aise una dvesha karane vaale, kroorakarmee aura naraadhamon ko main sansaara men baarambaara (ajasram) aasuree yoniyon men hee giraataa hoon arthaat utpanna karataa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 16 ke mool vishay se juda hai: daivi aur asuri gunon ke bhed se charitra ki disha sudharta hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
आसुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि ।
मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
āsurīṃ yonimāpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani.
māmaprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yāntyadhamāṃ gatim
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kaunteya ! ve moodha purusha janmajanmaantara men aasuree yoni ko praapta hote hain aura ( isa prakaara) mujhey praapta na hokara adhama gati ko praapta hote hai

summary: The seventeenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Sraddhatraya Vibhaga Yoga. In this chapter, Krishna describes the three types of faith corresponding to the three modes of the material nature. Lord Krishna further reveals that it is the nature of faith that determines the quality of life and the character of living entities. Those who have faith in passion and ignorance perform actions that yield temporary, material results while those who have faith in goodness perform actions in accordance with scriptural instructions and hence their hearts get further purified.

summary: The eighteenth chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Moksha Sanyas Yoga. Arjuna requests the Lord to explain the difference between the two types of renunciations - sanyaas(renunciation of actions) and tyaag(renunciation of desires). Krishna explains that a sanyaasi is one who abandons family and society in order to practise spiritual discipline whereas a tyaagi is one who performs their duties without attachment to the rewards of their actions and dedicating them to the God. Krishna recommends the second kind of renunciation - tyaag. Krishna then gives a detailed analysis of the effects of the three modes of material nature. He declares that the highest path of spirituality is pure, unconditional loving service unto the Supreme Divine Personality, Krishna. If we always remember Him, keep chanting His name and dedicate all our actions unto Him, take refuge in Him and make Him our Supreme goal, then by His grace, we will surely overcome all obstacles and difficulties and be freed from this cycle of birth and death.

verses.sanskrit:

verses.sanskrit:
नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते ।
मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः ॥
verses.transliteration:

mohāttasya parityāgastāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ

verses.sanskrit:
दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत् ।
स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
duḥkhamityeva yatkarma kāyakleśabhayāttyajet.
sa kṛtvā rājasaṃ tyāgaṃ naiva tyāgaphalaṃ labhet
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo manushya, karma ko du:kha samajhakara shaareerika kashta ke bhaya se tyaaga detaa hai, vaha purusha usa raajasika tyaaga ko karake kadaapi tyaaga ke phala ko praapta naheen hotaa hai

verses.sanskrit:
कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन ।
सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
kāryamityeva yatkarma niyataṃ kriyate.arjuna.
saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun ! "karma karanaa kartavya hai" aisaa samajhakara jo niyata karma aasakti aura phala ko tyaagakara kiyaa jaataa hai, vahee saattvika tyaaga maanaa gayaa hai

verses.sanskrit:
न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते ।
त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
na dveṣṭyakuśalaṃ karma kuśale nānuṣajjate.
tyāgī sattvasamāviṣṭo medhāvī chinnasaṃśayaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha akushala (ashubha) karma se dvesha naheen karataa aura kushala (shubha) karma men aasakta naheen hotaa, vaha sattvaguna se sampanna purusha sanshayarahita, medhaavee (jnyaanee) aura tyaagee hai

verses.sanskrit:
न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः ।
यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते ॥
verses.transliteration:
na hi dehabhṛtā śakyaṃ tyaktuṃ karmāṇyaśeṣataḥ.
yastu karmaphalatyāgī sa tyāgītyabhidhīyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Kyonki dehadhaaree purusha ke dvaaraa ashesha karmon kaa tyaaga sanbhava naheen hai, isalie jo karmaphala tyaagee hai, vahee purusha tyaagee kahaa jaataa hai

verses.sanskrit:
अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम् ।
भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aniṣṭamiṣṭaṃ miśraṃ ca trividhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam.
bhavatyatyāgināṃ pretya na tu saṃnyāsināṃ kvacit
verses.hinglishMeaning: Karmon ke shubha, ashubha aura mishra ye trividha phala kevala atyaagee janon ko marana ke pashchaat bhee praapta hote hain; parantu sannyaasee purushon ko kadaapi naheen

verses.sanskrit:
पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे ।
साङ्ख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pañcaitāni mahābāho kāraṇāni nibodha me.
sāṅkhye kṛtānte proktāni siddhaye sarvakarmaṇām
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey mahaabaaho ! samasta karmon kee siddhi ke lie ye paancha kaarana saankhya siddhaanta men kahey gaye hain, jinako tuma mujhase bhaleebhaanti jaano

verses.transliteration:

verses.hinglishMeaning: Adhishthaana (shareera), kartaa ,vividha karana (indriyaadi) ,vividha aura prithak-prithak cheshtaaen tathaa paanchavaa hetu daiva hai

न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः ॥
verses.transliteration:

nyāyyaṃ vā viparītaṃ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ

पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः ॥

हत्वाऽपि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते ॥

yasya nāhaṃkṛto bhāvo buddhiryasya na lipyate.
hatvā.api sa imā.Nllokānna hanti na nibadhyate

karaṇaṃ karma karteti trividhaḥ karmasaṃgrahaḥ

अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम् ॥
verses.transliteration:

avibhaktaṃ vibhakteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi sāttvikam

वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pṛthaktvena tu yajjñānaṃ nānābhāvānpṛthagvidhān.
vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi rājasam

अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yattu kṛtsnavadekasminkārye saktamahaitukam.
atattvārthavadalpaṃ ca tattāmasamudāhṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aura jisa jnyaana ke dvaaraa manushya eka kaarya (shareera) men hee aasakta ho jaataa hai, maano vaha (kaarya hee) poorna vastu ho tathaa jo (jnyaana) heturahita (ayuktika), tattvaartha se rahita tathaa sankuchita (alpa) hai, vaha (jnyaana) taamasa hai

verses.sanskrit:
नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम् ।
अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
niyataṃ saṅgarahitamarāgadveṣataḥ kṛtam.
aphalaprepsunā karma yattatsāttvikamucyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo karma (shaastravidhi se) niyata aura sangarahita hai, tathaa phala ko na chaahane vaale purusha ke dvaaraa binaa kisee raaga dvesha ke kiyaa gayaa hai, vaha (karma) saattvika kahaa jaataa hai

verses.sanskrit:
यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहंकारेण वा पुनः ।
क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yattu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṃkāreṇa vā punaḥ.
kriyate bahulāyāsaṃ tadrājasamudāhṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aura jo karma bahuta parishrama se yukta hai tathaa phala kee kaamanaa vaale, ahankaarayukta purusha ke dvaaraa kiyaa jaataa hai, vaha karma raajasa kahaa gayaa hai

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम् ।
मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
anubandhaṃ kṣayaṃ hiṃsāmanapekṣya ca pauruṣam.
mohādārabhyate karma yattattāmasamucyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo karma parinaama, haani, hinsaa aura saarmathya (paurusham) kaa vichaara na karake kevala mohavasha aarambha kiyaa jaataa hai, vaha karma taamasa kahalaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo karma parinaama, haani, hinsaa aura saarmathya (paurusham) kaa vichaara na karake kevala mohavasha aarambha kiyaa jaataa hai, vaha karma taamasa kahalaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः ।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
muktasaṅgo.anahaṃvādī dhṛtyutsāhasamanvitaḥ.
siddhyasiddhyornirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika ucyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo kartaa sangarahita, ahanmanyataa se rahita, dhairya aura utsaaha se yukta evan kaarya kee siddhi (saphalataa) aura asiddhi (viphalataa) men nirvikaara rahataa hai, vaha kartaa saattvika kahaa jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo kartaa sangarahita, ahanmanyataa se rahita, dhairya aura utsaaha se yukta evan kaarya kee siddhi (saphalataa) aura asiddhi (viphalataa) men nirvikaara rahataa hai, vaha kartaa saattvika kahaa jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः ।
हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
rāgī karmaphalaprepsurlubdho hiṃsātmako.aśuciḥ.
harṣaśokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Raagee, karmaphala kaa ichchhuka, lobhee, hinsaka svabhaava vaalaa, ashuddha aura harshashoka se yukta kartaa raajasa kahalaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Raagee, karmaphala kaa ichchhuka, lobhee, hinsaka svabhaava vaalaa, ashuddha aura harshashoka se yukta kartaa raajasa kahalaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः ।
विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayuktaḥ prākṛtaḥ stabdhaḥ śaṭho naiṣkṛtiko.alasaḥ.
viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ayukta, praakrita, stabdha, shatha, naishkritika, aalasee, vishaadee aura deerghasootree kartaa taamasa kahaa jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Ayukta, praakrita, stabdha, shatha, naishkritika, aalasee, vishaadee aura deerghasootree kartaa taamasa kahaa jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne gunon aur pravrittiyon ko pehchaan kar unse upar uthna hi vikas hai.

verses.sanskrit:
बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं शृणु ।
प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय ॥
verses.transliteration:
buddherbhedaṃ dhṛteścaiva guṇatastrividhaṃ śṛṇu.
procyamānamaśeṣeṇa pṛthaktvena dhanañjaya
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey dhananjaya ! mere dvaaraa asheshata: aura prithakata: kahey jaane vaale, gunon ke kaarana utpanna hue buddhi aura dhriti ke trividha bheda ko suno
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey dhananjaya ! mere dvaaraa asheshata: aura prithakata: kahey jaane vaale, gunon ke kaarana utpanna hue buddhi aura dhriti ke trividha bheda ko suno. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये ।
बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ॥
verses.transliteration:
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye.
bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! jo buddhi pravritti aura nivritti, kaarya aura akaarya, bhaya aura abhaya tathaa bandha aura moksha ko tattvata jaanatee hai, vaha buddhi saatvikee hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey paartha ! jo buddhi pravritti aura nivritti, kaarya aura akaarya, bhaya aura abhaya tathaa bandha aura moksha ko tattvata jaanatee hai, vaha buddhi saatvikee hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च ।
अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी ॥
verses.transliteration:
yayā dharmamadharmaṃ ca kāryaṃ cākāryameva ca.
ayathāvatprajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! jisa buddhi ke dvaaraa manushya dharma aura adharma ko tathaa kartavya aura akartavya ko yathaavat naheen jaanataa hai, vaha buddhi raajasee hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey paartha ! jisa buddhi ke dvaaraa manushya dharma aura adharma ko tathaa kartavya aura akartavya ko yathaavat naheen jaanataa hai, vaha buddhi raajasee hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसावृता ।
सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥
verses.transliteration:
adharmaṃ dharmamiti yā manyate tamasāvṛtā.
sarvārthānviparītāṃśca buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! tamas (ajnyaana andha:kaara) se aavrita jo buddhi adharma ko hee dharma maanatee hai aura sabhee padaarthon ko vipareeta roopa se jaanatee hai, vaha buddhi taamasee hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey paartha ! tamas (ajnyaana andha:kaara) se aavrita jo buddhi adharma ko hee dharma maanatee hai aura sabhee padaarthon ko vipareeta roopa se jaanatee hai, vaha buddhi taamasee hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः ।
योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhṛtyā yayā dhārayate manaḥprāṇendriyakriyāḥ.
yogenāvyabhicāriṇyā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
verses.hinglishMeaning: Saattvikee hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Saattvikee hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यया तु धर्मकामार्थान्धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन ।
प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी ॥
verses.transliteration:
yayā tu dharmakāmārthāndhṛtyā dhārayate.arjuna.
prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey prithaaputra Arjun ! karmaphala kaa ichchhuka purusha ati aasakti (prasanga) se jisa dhriti ke dvaaraa dharma, artha aura kaama (ina teena purushaarthon) ko dhaarana karataa hai, vaha dhriti raajasee hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey prithaaputra Arjun ! karmaphala kaa ichchhuka purusha ati aasakti (prasanga) se jisa dhriti ke dvaaraa dharma, artha aura kaama (ina teena purushaarthon) ko dhaarana karataa hai, vaha dhriti raajasee hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च ।
न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥
verses.transliteration:
yayā svapnaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ viṣādaṃ madameva ca.
na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ho paartha ! durbuddhi purusha jisa dhaaranaa ke dvaaraa, svapna, bhaya, shoka, vishaada aura mada ko naheen tyaagataa hai, vaha dhriti taamasee hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Ho paartha ! durbuddhi purusha jisa dhaaranaa ke dvaaraa, svapna, bhaya, shoka, vishaada aura mada ko naheen tyaagataa hai, vaha dhriti taamasee hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ ।
अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha.
abhyāsādramate yatra duḥkhāntaṃ ca nigacchati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bharatashreshtha ! aba tuma trividha sukha ko mujhase suno, jisamen (saadhaka purusha) abhyaasa se ramataa hai aura du:khon ke anta ko praapta hotaa hai (jahaan usake du:khon kaa anta ho jaataa hai.)
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey bharatashreshtha ! aba tuma trividha sukha ko mujhase suno, jisamen (saadhaka purusha) abhyaasa se ramataa hai aura du:khon ke anta ko praapta hotaa hai (jahaan usake du:khon kaa anta ho jaataa hai.). verses.sanskrit:
यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम् ।
तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yattadagre viṣamiva pariṇāme.amṛtopamam.
tatsukhaṃ sāttvikaṃ proktamātmabuddhiprasādajam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo sukha prathama (praarambha men) visha ke samaana (bhaasataa) hai, parantu parinaama men amrita ke samaana hai, vaha aatmabuddhi ke prasaada se utpanna sukha saattvika kahaa gayaa hai

verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम् ।
परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
viṣayendriyasaṃyogādyattadagre.amṛtopamam.
pariṇāme viṣamiva tatsukhaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo sukha vishayon aura indriyon ke sanyoga se utpanna hotaa hai, vaha prathama to amrita ke samaana, parantu parinaama men visha tulya hotaa hai, vaha sukha raajasa kahaa gayaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo sukha vishayon aura indriyon ke sanyoga se utpanna hotaa hai, vaha prathama to amrita ke samaana, parantu parinaama men visha tulya hotaa hai, vaha sukha raajasa kahaa gayaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne gunon aur pravrittiyon ko pehchaan kar unse upar uthna hi vikas hai.

verses.sanskrit:
यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः ।
निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadagre cānubandhe ca sukhaṃ mohanamātmanaḥ.
nidrālasyapramādotthaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛtam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo sukha praarambha men aura parinaama (anubandha) men bhee atma (manushya) ko mohita karane vaalaa hotaa hai, vaha nidraa, aalasya aura pramaada se utpanna sukha taamasa kahaa jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo sukha praarambha men aura parinaama (anubandha) men bhee atma (manushya) ko mohita karane vaalaa hotaa hai, vaha nidraa, aalasya aura pramaada se utpanna sukha taamasa kahaa jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः ।
सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्त्रिभिर्गुणैः ॥
verses.transliteration:
na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ.
sattvaṃ prakṛtijairmuktaṃ yadebhiḥ syāttribhirguṇaiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Prithvee para athavaa svarga ke devataaon men aisaa koee praanee (sattvan arthaat vidyamaana vastu) naheen hai jo prakriti se utpanna ina teena gunon se mukta (rahita) ho
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Prithvee para athavaa svarga ke devataaon men aisaa koee praanee (sattvan arthaat vidyamaana vastu) naheen hai jo prakriti se utpanna ina teena gunon se mukta (rahita) ho. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apne gunon aur pravrittiyon ko pehchaan kar unse upar uthna hi vikas hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परन्तप ।
कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः ॥
verses.transliteration:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca parantapa.
karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāvaprabhavairguṇaiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey parantapa! braahmanon, kshatriyon, vaishyon aura shoodron ke karma, svabhaava se utpanna gunon ke anusaara vibhakta kiye gaye hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey parantapa! braahmanon, kshatriyon, vaishyon aura shoodron ke karma, svabhaava se utpanna gunon ke anusaara vibhakta kiye gaye hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śamo damastapaḥ śaucaṃ kṣāntirārjavameva ca.
jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ brahmakarma svabhāvajam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shama, dama, tapa, shaucha, kshaanti, aarjava, jnyaana, vijnyaana aura aastikya - ye braahmana ke svaabhaavika karma hain
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Shama, dama, tapa, shaucha, kshaanti, aarjava, jnyaana, vijnyaana aura aastikya - ye braahmana ke svaabhaavika karma hain. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम् ।
दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ yuddhe cāpyapalāyanam.
dānamīśvarabhāvaśca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Shaurya, teja, dhriti, daakshya (dakshataa), yuddha se palaayana na karanaa, daana aura eeshvara bhaava (svaamee bhaava) - ye saba kshatriya ke svaabhaavika karma hain

Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
