verses.sanskrit:
कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम् ।
परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kṛṣigaurakṣyavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyakarma svabhāvajam.
paricaryātmakaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāvajam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Krishi, gaupaalana tathaa vaanijya - ye vaishya ke svaabhaavika karma hain, aura shoodra kaa svaabhaavika karma hai paricharyaa arthaat sevaa karanaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Krishi, gaupaalana tathaa vaanijya - ye vaishya ke svaabhaavika karma hain, aura shoodra kaa svaabhaavika karma hai paricharyaa arthaat sevaa karanaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः ।
स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु ॥
verses.transliteration:
sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ.
svakarmanirataḥ siddhiṃ yathā vindati tacchṛṇu
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha saba karma brahma men arpana karake aura aasakti ko tyaagakara karataa hai, vaha purusha kamala ke patte ke sadrisha paapa se lipta naheen hotaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha saba karma brahma men arpana karake aura aasakti ko tyaagakara karataa hai, vaha purusha kamala ke patte ke sadrisha paapa se lipta naheen hotaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yena sarvamidaṃ tatam.
svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jisa (paramatma) se bhootamaatra kee pravritti arthaat utpatti huee hai aura jisase yaha sampoorna jagat vyaapta hai, usa (paramatma) kee svakarma dvaaraa poojaa karake manushya siddhi ko praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jisa (paramatma) se bhootamaatra kee pravritti arthaat utpatti huee hai aura jisase yaha sampoorna jagat vyaapta hai, usa (paramatma) kee svakarma dvaaraa poojaa karake manushya siddhi ko praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् ।
स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śreyānsvadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmātsvanuṣṭhitāt.
svabhāvaniyataṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Samyak anushthita paradharma kee apekshaa gunarahita svadharma shreshtha hai. (kyonki) svabhaava se niyata kiye gaye karma ko karate hue manushya paapa ko naheen praapta karataa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Samyak anushthita paradharma kee apekshaa gunarahita svadharma shreshtha hai. (kyonki) svabhaava se niyata kiye gaye karma ko karate hue manushya paapa ko naheen praapta karataa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत् ।
सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi na tyajet.
sarvārambhā hi doṣeṇa dhūmenāgnirivāvṛtāḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kaunteya ! doshayukta hone para bhee sahaja karma ko naheen tyaaganaa chaahie; kyonki sabhee karma dosha se aavrita hote hai, jaise dhuyen se agni
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey kaunteya ! doshayukta hone para bhee sahaja karma ko naheen tyaaganaa chaahie; kyonki sabhee karma dosha se aavrita hote hai, jaise dhuyen se agni. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः ।
नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration:
asaktabuddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigataspṛhaḥ.
naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ paramāṃ saṃnyāsenādhigacchati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sarvatra aasakti rahita buddhi vaalaa vaha purusha jo sprihaarahita tathaa jitatma hai, sannyaasa ke dvaaraa parama nairshkamya siddhi ko praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Sarvatra aasakti rahita buddhi vaalaa vaha purusha jo sprihaarahita tathaa jitatma hai, sannyaasa ke dvaaraa parama nairshkamya siddhi ko praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे ।
समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा ॥
verses.transliteration:
siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me.
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Siddhi ko praapta purusha kisa prakaara brahma ko praapta hotaa hai, tathaa jnyaana kee paraa nishthaa ko bhee tuma mujhase sankshepa men jaano
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Siddhi ko praapta purusha kisa prakaara brahma ko praapta hotaa hai, tathaa jnyaana kee paraa nishthaa ko bhee tuma mujhase sankshepa men jaano. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्यात्मानं नियम्य च ।
शब्दादीन्विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च ॥
verses.transliteration:
buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyātmānaṃ niyamya ca.
śabdādīnviṣayāṃstyaktvā rāgadveṣau vyudasya ca
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vishuddha buddhi se yukta, dhriti se aatmasanyama kara, shabdaadi vishayon ko tyaaga kara aura raaga-dvesha kaa parityaaga kara....৷৷৷৷
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Vishuddha buddhi se yukta, dhriti se aatmasanyama kara, shabdaadi vishayon ko tyaaga kara aura raaga-dvesha kaa parityaaga kara....৷৷৷৷. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः ।
ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
viviktasevī laghvāśī yatavākkāyamānasaḥ.
dhyānayogaparo nityaṃ vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vivikta sevee, laghvaashee (mitaahaaree) jisane apane shareera, vaanee aura mana ko sanyata kiyaa hai, dhyaanayoga ke abhyaasa men sadaiva tatpara tathaa vairaagya para samaashrita
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Vivikta sevee, laghvaashee (mitaahaaree) jisane apane shareera, vaanee aura mana ko sanyata kiyaa hai, dhyaanayoga ke abhyaasa men sadaiva tatpara tathaa vairaagya para samaashrita. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् ।
विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham.
vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto brahmabhūyāya kalpate
verses.hinglishMeaning: Ahankaara, bala, darpa, kaama, krodha aura parigraha ko tyaaga kara mamatvabhaava se rahita aura shaanta purusha brahma praapti ke yogya bana jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Ahankaara, bala, darpa, kaama, krodha aura parigraha ko tyaaga kara mamatvabhaava se rahita aura shaanta purusha brahma praapti ke yogya bana jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Asakti kam karne se karm halka, spasht aur shant ho jata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati.
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṃ labhate parām
verses.hinglishMeaning: Brahmabhoota (jo saadhaka brahma bana gayaa hai), prasanna mana vaalaa purusha na ichchhaa karataa hai aura na shoka, samasta bhooton ke prati sama hokara vaha meree paraa bhakti ko praapta karataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Brahmabhoota (jo saadhaka brahma bana gayaa hai), prasanna mana vaalaa purusha na ichchhaa karataa hai aura na shoka, samasta bhooton ke prati sama hokara vaha meree paraa bhakti ko praapta karataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः ।
ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhaktyā māmabhijānāti yāvānyaścāsmi tattvataḥ.
tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram
verses.hinglishMeaning: (usa paraa) bhakti ke dvaaraa mujhey vaha tattvata: jaanataa hai ki main kitanaa (vyaapaka) hoon tathaa main kyaa hoon. (isa prakaara) tattvata: jaanane ke pashchaat tatkaala hee vaha mujhamen pravesha kara jaataa hai, arthaat matsvaroopa bana jaataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: (usa paraa) bhakti ke dvaaraa mujhey vaha tattvata: jaanataa hai ki main kitanaa (vyaapaka) hoon tathaa main kyaa hoon. (isa prakaara) tattvata: jaanane ke pashchaat tatkaala hee vaha mujhamen pravesha kara jaataa hai, arthaat matsvaroopa bana jaataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः ।
मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvakarmāṇyapi sadā kurvāṇo madvyapāśrayaḥ.
matprasādādavāpnoti śāśvataṃ padamavyayam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha madaashrita hokara sadaiva samasta karmon ko karataa hai, vaha mere prasaada (anugraha) se shaashvata, avyaya pada ko praapta kara letaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha madaashrita hokara sadaiva samasta karmon ko karataa hai, vaha mere prasaada (anugraha) se shaashvata, avyaya pada ko praapta kara letaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः ।
बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव ॥
verses.transliteration:
cetasā sarvakarmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparaḥ.
buddhiyogamupāśritya maccittaḥ satataṃ bhava
verses.hinglishMeaning: Mana se samasta karmon kaa sannyaasa mujhamen karake matparaayana hokara buddhiyoga kaa aashraya lekara tuma satata machchitta bano
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Mana se samasta karmon kaa sannyaasa mujhamen karake matparaayana hokara buddhiyoga kaa aashraya lekara tuma satata machchitta bano. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि ।
अथ चेत्त्वमहंकारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
maccittaḥ sarvadurgāṇi matprasādāttariṣyasi.
atha cettvamahaṃkārānna śroṣyasi vinaṅkṣyasi
verses.hinglishMeaning: Machchitta hokara tuma meree kripaa se samasta kathinaaiyon (sarvadurgaani) ko paara kara jaaoge; aura yadi ahankaaravasha (isa upadesha ko) naheen sunoge, to tuma nashta ho jaaoge
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Machchitta hokara tuma meree kripaa se samasta kathinaaiyon (sarvadurgaani) ko paara kara jaaoge; aura yadi ahankaaravasha (isa upadesha ko) naheen sunoge, to tuma nashta ho jaaoge. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
यदहंकारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे ।
मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadahaṃkāramāśritya na yotsya iti manyase.
mithyaiṣa vyavasāyaste prakṛtistvāṃ niyokṣyati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Aura ahankaaravasha tuma jo yaha socha rahey ho, "main yuddha naheen karoongaa", yaha tumhaaraa nishchaya mithyaa hai, (kyonki) prakriti (tumhaaraa svabhaava) hee tumhen (balaat karma men) pravritta karegee
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Aura ahankaaravasha tuma jo yaha socha rahey ho, "main yuddha naheen karoongaa", yaha tumhaaraa nishchaya mithyaa hai, (kyonki) prakriti (tumhaaraa svabhaava) hee tumhen (balaat karma men) pravritta karegee. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा ।
कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोपि तत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
svabhāvajena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā.
kartuṃ necchasi yanmohātkariṣyasyavaśopi tat
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey kaunteya ! tuma apane svaabhaavika karmon se bandhey ho, (ata:) mohavashaat jisa karma ko tuma karanaa naheen chaahate ho, vahee tuma vivasha hokara karoge
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey kaunteya ! tuma apane svaabhaavika karmon se bandhey ho, (ata:) mohavashaat jisa karma ko tuma karanaa naheen chaahate ho, vahee tuma vivasha hokara karoge. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति ।
भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया ॥
verses.transliteration:
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛddeśe.arjuna tiṣṭhati.
bhrāmayansarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey Arjun (maanon kisee) yantra para aaroodha samasta bhooton ko eeshvara apanee maayaa se ghumaataa huaa (bhraamayan) bhootamaatra ke hridaya men sthita rahataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey Arjun (maanon kisee) yantra para aaroodha samasta bhooton ko eeshvara apanee maayaa se ghumaataa huaa (bhraamayan) bhootamaatra ke hridaya men sthita rahataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत ।
तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tameva śaraṇaṃ gaccha sarvabhāvena bhārata.
tatprasādātparāṃ śāntiṃ sthānaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey bhaarata ! tuma sampoorna bhaava se usee (eeshvara) kee sharana men jaao. usake prasaada se tuma parama shaanti aura shaashvata sthaana ko praapta karoge
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey bhaarata ! tuma sampoorna bhaava se usee (eeshvara) kee sharana men jaao. usake prasaada se tuma parama shaanti aura shaashvata sthaana ko praapta karoge. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया ।
विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ॥
verses.transliteration:
iti te jñānamākhyātaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ mayā.
vimṛśyaitadaśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru
verses.hinglishMeaning: Isa prakaara samasta gopaneeyon se adhika guhya jnyaana mainne tumase kahaa; isa para poorna vichaara (vimrishya) karane ke pashchaat tumhaaree jaisee ichchhaa ho, vaisaa tuma karo
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Isa prakaara samasta gopaneeyon se adhika guhya jnyaana mainne tumase kahaa; isa para poorna vichaara (vimrishya) karane ke pashchaat tumhaaree jaisee ichchhaa ho, vaisaa tuma karo. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः ।
इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ.
iṣṭo.asi me dṛḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Puna: eka baara tuma mujhase samasta guhyon men guhyatama parama vachana (upadesha) ko suno. tuma mujhey atishaya priya ho, isalie main tumhen tumhaare hita kee baata kahoongaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Puna: eka baara tuma mujhase samasta guhyon men guhyatama parama vachana (upadesha) ko suno. tuma mujhey atishaya priya ho, isalie main tumhen tumhaare hita kee baata kahoongaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु ।
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru.
māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo.asi me
verses.hinglishMeaning: Tuma machchita, madbhakta aura mere poojaka (madyaajee) bano aura mujhey namaskaara karo; (isa prakaara) tuma mujhey hee praapta hoge; yaha main tumhey satya vachana detaa hoon,(kyonki) tuma mere priya ho
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Tuma machchita, madbhakta aura mere poojaka (madyaajee) bano aura mujhey namaskaara karo; (isa prakaara) tuma mujhey hee praapta hoge; yaha main tumhey satya vachana detaa hoon,(kyonki) tuma mere priya ho. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज ।
अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvadharmānparityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja.
ahaṃ tvāṃ sarvapāpebhyo mokṣyayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Saba dharmon kaa parityaaga karake tuma eka meree hee sharana men aao, main tumhen samasta paapon se mukta kara doongaa, tuma shoka mata karo
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Saba dharmon kaa parityaaga karake tuma eka meree hee sharana men aao, main tumhen samasta paapon se mukta kara doongaa, tuma shoka mata karo. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Dharma ka sahara lekar kathin faisle bhi shuddh bhav se liye ja sakte hain.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन ।
न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana.
na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo.abhyasūyati
verses.hinglishMeaning: Yaha jnyaana aise purusha se naheen kahanaa chaahie, jo atapaska (taparahita) hai, aura na use jo abhakta hai; use bhee naheen jo ashushrushu (sevaa men atatpara) hai aura usa purusha se bhee naheen kahanaa chaahie, jo mujha (eeshvara) se asooyaa karataa hai, arthaat mujha men dosha dekhataa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Yaha jnyaana aise purusha se naheen kahanaa chaahie, jo atapaska (taparahita) hai, aura na use jo abhakta hai; use bhee naheen jo ashushrushu (sevaa men atatpara) hai aura usa purusha se bhee naheen kahanaa chaahie, jo mujha (eeshvara) se asooyaa karataa hai, arthaat mujha men dosha dekhataa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
य इदं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति ।
भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya idaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ madbhakteṣvabhidhāsyati.
bhaktiṃ mayi parāṃ kṛtvā māmevaiṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha mujhase parama prema (paraa bhakti) karake isa parama guhya jnyaana kaa upadesha mere bhakton ko detaa hai, vaha ni:sandeha mujhey hee praapta hotaa hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha mujhase parama prema (paraa bhakti) karake isa parama guhya jnyaana kaa upadesha mere bhakton ko detaa hai, vaha ni:sandeha mujhey hee praapta hotaa hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Shraddha aur prem se ki gayi chhoti kriya bhi Bhagavan tak pahunchti hai.

verses.sanskrit:
न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः ।
भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि ॥
verses.transliteration:
na ca tasmānmanuṣyeṣu kaścinme priyakṛttamaḥ.
bhavitā na ca me tasmādanyaḥ priyataro bhuvi
verses.hinglishMeaning: Na to usase badhakara meraa atishaya priya kaarya karane vaalaa manushyon men koee hai aura na usase badhakara meraa priya isa prithvee para doosaraa koee hogaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Na to usase badhakara meraa atishaya priya kaarya karane vaalaa manushyon men koee hai aura na usase badhakara meraa priya isa prithvee para doosaraa koee hogaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः ।
ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādamāvayoḥ.
jñānayajñena tenāhamiṣṭaḥ syāmiti me matiḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jo purusha, hama donon ke isa dharmamaya sanvaada kaa pathana karegaa, usake dvaaraa main jnyaanayajnya se poojita hooongaa - aisaa meraa mata hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jo purusha, hama donon ke isa dharmamaya sanvaada kaa pathana karegaa, usake dvaaraa main jnyaanayajnya se poojita hooongaa - aisaa meraa mata hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयादपि यो नरः ।
सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śraddhāvānanasūyaśca śṛṇuyādapi yo naraḥ.
so.api muktaḥ śubhā.Nllokānprāpnuyātpuṇyakarmaṇām
verses.hinglishMeaning: Tathaa jo shraddhaavaan aura anasuyu (doshadrishti rahita) purusha isakaa shravanamaatra bhee karegaa, vaha bhee (paapon se) mukta hokara punyakarmiyon ke shubha (shreshtha) lokon ko praapta kara legaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Tathaa jo shraddhaavaan aura anasuyu (doshadrishti rahita) purusha isakaa shravanamaatra bhee karegaa, vaha bhee (paapon se) mukta hokara punyakarmiyon ke shubha (shreshtha) lokon ko praapta kara legaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा ।
कच्चिदज्ञानसम्मोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय ॥
verses.transliteration:
kaccidetacchrutaṃ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa cetasā.
kaccidajñānasammohaḥ pranaṣṭaste dhanañjaya
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey paartha ! kyaa ise (mere upadesha ko) tumane ekaagrachitta hokara shravana kiyaa ? aura hey dhananyjaya ! kyaa tumhaaraa ajnyaana janita sanmoha poornatayaa nashta huaa ?
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey paartha ! kyaa ise (mere upadesha ko) tumane ekaagrachitta hokara shravana kiyaa ? aura hey dhananyjaya ! kyaa tumhaaraa ajnyaana janita sanmoha poornatayaa nashta huaa ?. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत ।
स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव ॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca.
naṣṭo mohaḥ smṛtirlabdhā tvatprasādānmayācyuta.
sthito.asmi gatasandehaḥ kariṣye vacanaṃ tava
verses.hinglishMeaning: Arjun ne kahaa -- hey achyuta ! aapake kripaaprasaada se meraa moha nashta ho gayaa hai, aura mujhey smriti (jnyaana) praapta ho gayee hai? aba main sanshayarahita ho gayaa hoon aura main aapake vachana (aajnyaa) kaa paalana karoongaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Arjun ne kahaa -- hey achyuta ! aapake kripaaprasaada se meraa moha nashta ho gayaa hai, aura mujhey smriti (jnyaana) praapta ho gayee hai? aba main sanshayarahita ho gayaa hoon aura main aapake vachana (aajnyaa) kaa paalana karoongaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Sahi gyaan ahankar ko kam karta hai aur drishti ko saaf banata hai.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः ।
संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca.
ityahaṃ vāsudevasya pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ.
saṃvādamimamaśrauṣamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Sanjaya ne kahaa -- isa prakaara mainne bhagavaan vaasudeva aura mahatma Arjun ke isa adbhuta aura romaanchaka sanvaada kaa varnana kiyaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Sanjaya ne kahaa -- isa prakaara mainne bhagavaan vaasudeva aura mahatma Arjun ke isa adbhuta aura romaanchaka sanvaada kaa varnana kiyaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Man ko saadhne se jeevan mein santulan, dhairya aur spashtata aati hai.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम् ।
योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vyāsaprasādācchrutavānetadguhyamahaṃ param.
yogaṃ yogeśvarātkṛṣṇātsākṣātkathayataḥ svayam
verses.hinglishMeaning: Vyaasa jee kee kripaa se mainne isa param guhya yoga ko saakshaat kahate hue svayan yogoshvara shreeKrishna bhagavaan se sunaa
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Vyaasa jee kee kripaa se mainne isa param guhya yoga ko saakshaat kahate hue svayan yogoshvara shreeKrishna bhagavaan se sunaa. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apni asli pehchaan shareer se pare samajhne par bhay aur moh kam hote hain.

verses.sanskrit:
राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम् ।
केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
rājansaṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya saṃvādamimamadbhutam.
keśavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṃ hṛṣyāmi ca muhurmuhuḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey raajan ! bhagavaan keshava aura Arjun ke isa adbhuta aura punya (pavitra) sanvaada ko smarana karake main baarambaara harshita hotaa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey raajan ! bhagavaan keshava aura Arjun ke isa adbhuta aura punya (pavitra) sanvaada ko smarana karake main baarambaara harshita hotaa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः ।
विस्मयो मे महान् राजन्हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tacca saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya rūpamatyadbhutaṃ hareḥ.
vismayo me mahān rājanhṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.hinglishMeaning: Hey raajana ! shree hari ke ati adbhuta roopa ko bhee puna: puna: smarana karake mujhey mahaan vismaya hotaa hai aura main baarambaara harshita ho rahaa hoon
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Hey raajana ! shree hari ke ati adbhuta roopa ko bhee puna: puna: smarana karake mujhey mahaan vismaya hotaa hai aura main baarambaara harshita ho rahaa hoon. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः ।
तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ.
tatra śrīrvijayo bhūtirdhruvā nītirmatirmama
verses.hinglishMeaning: Jahaan yogeshvara shreeKrishna hain aura jahaan dhanurdhaaree Arjun hai vaheen para shree, vijaya, vibhooti aura dhruva neeti hai, aisaa meraa mata hai
verses.simpleExplanation: Saral bhav: Jahaan yogeshvara shreeKrishna hain aura jahaan dhanurdhaaree Arjun hai vaheen para shree, vijaya, vibhooti aura dhruva neeti hai, aisaa meraa mata hai. Iska sandarbh Adhyay 18 ke mool vishay se juda hai: sampoorna Gita ka saar dekar kartavya, tyag, bhakti aur sharanagati ka marg batata hai.
verses.lifeLesson: Apna kartavya imaandari se karo, par phal ki chinta mein apni shanti mat khona.
